// consumerAppScheme is the deep-link a printed pack QR encodes, so ONLY the
// consumer app (registered for parag://) can open it — a generic scanner can't.
const consumerAppScheme = "parag://trace/"

// appKeyOK enforces the consumer-app-only gate: the request must carry an
// X-Parag-App-Key matching CONSUMER_APP_KEY (constant-time). FAIL-CLOSED: an
// unset server key denies everyone rather than opening the gate — traceability
// and the PDF label are for the PARAG app only, and a missing env var on a
// deployment must not silently make them public. Local dev sets
// CONSUMER_APP_KEY in .env (see .env.example) to the same value the app ships
// as EXPO_PUBLIC_CONSUMER_APP_KEY.
func (s *service) appKeyOK(r *http.Request) bool {
	if s.appKey == "" {
		s.log.Warn("consumer traceability denied: CONSUMER_APP_KEY is not configured on this deployment (fail-closed)")
		return false
	}
	got := r.Header.Get("X-Parag-App-Key")
	return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(got), []byte(s.appKey)) == 1
}

// code that doesn't resolve returns 404 and the app falls back to its offline

// The bridge reads operator provenance and touches NO operator business flow,

// increment inside ScanQR — a consumer scan legitimately IS a public scan, and
// this is the exact behaviour the operator's own /public/qr endpoint already
// performs (best-effort, async, a bare counter). No new mutation is introduced.

// tokens, lowercase hex) AND product-lot pack QRs (PRG-...). Case-insensitive,
// because the app uppercases scanned codes while consignment tokens are stored
// lowercase.
func (s *service) traceByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*milkBatchView, error) {
	code = strings.TrimSpace(code)
	if code == "" {
		return nil, errBadRequest("a batch/QR code is required")
	}
	for _, c := range []string{code, strings.ToLower(code), strings.ToUpper(code)} {
		res, err := s.trace.ResolvePublicQR(ctx, c)
		if err != nil || res == nil {
			continue // try the next case variant; unknown/integrity-failed → fall through
		}
		switch v := res.(type) {
		case *publictrace.QRScanResponse:
			mb := mapToMilkBatch(code, v)
			return &mb, nil
		case *publictrace.BatchQualityReport:
			mb := mapReportToMilkBatch(code, v)
			return &mb, nil
		}
	}
	// Not resolvable — 404 so the app falls back to its offline seed.
	return nil, errNotFound("no traceability found for this code")
}

    12	// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
    13	// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
    14	// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
    15	// itself is async and adds no request latency.
    16	//
    17	// This middleware mounts OUTSIDE the per-module Authenticate middleware, so
    18	// the actor installed on the inner request context never propagates back to
    19	// this frame. An actor holder is installed on the context before the chain
    20	// runs; auth.WithActor fills it, and the identity is read back here so the
    21	// who-did-what contract holds for every HTTP mutation.
    22	func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
    23		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
    24			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    25				if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
    26					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
    27					return
    28				}
    29				r = r.WithContext(auth.WithActorHolder(r.Context()))
    30				ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
    31				next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
    32	
    33				entry := audit.Entry{
    34					Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
    35					Status:    ww.Status(),
    36					IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
    37					RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),

    39				if actor, ok := auth.HeldActor(r.Context()); ok {

    41					entry.ActorRole = actor.RoleCode

    43				rec.Record(r.Context(), entry)

```text
func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
	r.mu.Unlock()
}

// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
	if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
		return true, nil
	}
	target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
		if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
		return nil
	}
	if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
		return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
	}
	scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
	}
	ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !ok {
		return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
	}
	return nil
}
```
</details></tool-use>

package mongodb

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
)

// Collection names — single source of truth so modules never typo a name.
const (
	CollParties          = "parties"
	CollOTPChallenges    = "otp_challenges"
	CollRefreshTokens    = "refresh_tokens"
	CollRoleAssignments  = "role_assignments"
	CollOrgUnits         = "org_units"
	CollKYCRecords       = "kyc_records"
	CollConsents         = "consents"
	CollAnimals          = "animals"
	CollHealthEvents     = "health_events"
	CollMVUCases         = "mvu_cases"
	CollEducation        = "education_content"
	CollRateCharts       = "rate_charts"
	CollAnalyzerReadings = "analyzer_readings"
	CollMilkPours        = "milk_pours"
	CollInvoices         = "invoices"
	CollConsignments     = "dcs_consignments"
	CollRouteTrips       = "route_trips"
	CollBMCLots          = "bmc_lots"
	CollBatches          = "processing_batches"
	CollQCResults        = "qc_results"
	CollProductLots      = "product_lots"
	CollBatchQRs         = "batch_qrs"
	CollSettlements      = "settlement_batches"
	CollPayouts          = "payout_instructions"
	CollDBTRequests      = "dbt_requests"
	CollNotifications    = "notifications"
	CollProvenance       = "provenance_events"
	CollAuditLogs        = "audit_logs"
	CollFeatureFlags     = "feature_flags"
	CollCounters         = "counters"
	CollProducts         = "products"
	CollOnboarding       = "onboarding_requests"
	CollCMSContent       = "cms_content"
	CollQCCertificates   = "qc_certificates"
	CollSettings         = "app_settings"
	// Per-samiti batch flow (F7/F8): the batch QC results and the auto-minted
	// public batch QRs (distinct from product-lot batch_qrs).
	CollConsignmentQC       = "consignment_qc"
	CollConsignmentBatchQRs = "consignment_batch_qrs"
)

// EnsureIndexes creates every index the query paths rely on. Idempotent —
// safe to run on every boot. Each hot read path below has a covering or
// prefix index so no collection scan sits on a user-facing request.
func EnsureIndexes(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database) error {
	asc, desc := int32(1), int32(-1)
	_ = desc

	specs := map[string][]mongo.IndexModel{
		CollParties: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			// People directory: newest-first paging (GET /support/parties).
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollOTPChallenges: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetExpireAfterSeconds(0)),
		},
		CollRefreshTokens: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetExpireAfterSeconds(0)),
		},
		CollRoleAssignments: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "role_code", Value: asc}, {Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollOrgUnits: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollKYCRecords: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollConsents: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "purpose", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollAnimals: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "pashu_aadhaar", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "owner_party_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollHealthEvents: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "animal_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "occurred_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "bp_sync_status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollMVUCases: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "requested_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollEducation: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "topic", Value: asc}, {Key: "language", Value: asc}, {Key: "published", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollRateCharts: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "active", Value: asc}, {Key: "effective_from", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollAnalyzerReadings: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollMilkPours: {
			// Offline-first idempotency: device-generated event IDs are unique.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "client_event_id", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "pour_date", Value: asc}, {Key: "shift", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "pour_date", Value: desc}}, nil),
			// Sort-covering indexes for the pour listings (poured_at sort).
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "poured_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "poured_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollInvoices: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			// One invoice per farmer per DCS per day.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "invoice_date", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "invoice_date", Value: asc}, {Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
			// Settlement lifecycle reads (initiate/execute/reject) filter on
			// the claimed batch — partial: only claimed invoices carry it.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: asc}},
				options.Index().SetPartialFilterExpression(bson.D{
					{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$exists", Value: true}}},
				})),
			// Multikey: pour freeze checks (supersede) look up the invoice by
			// contained pour ID.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "pour_ids", Value: asc}}, nil),
			// Sort-covering indexes for the invoice listings (issued_at sort).
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "issued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "issued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollConsignments: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: asc}, {Key: "shift", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			// The per-samiti batch code minted at pickup — unique where present
			// (partial: pre-pickup consignments carry no batch_code).
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_code", Value: asc}},
				options.Index().SetUnique(true).SetPartialFilterExpression(bson.D{
					{Key: "batch_code", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$exists", Value: true}}},
				})),
		},
		CollRouteTrips: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "van_rider_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "union_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "union_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "van_rider_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollBMCLots: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "bmc_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: desc}, {Key: "shift", Value: asc}}, nil),
			// Listing sort (date desc, created_at desc), bare and per-status.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: desc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: desc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollBatches: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_number", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "plant_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "started_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollQCResults: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "subject_type", Value: asc}, {Key: "subject_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "recorded_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollProductLots: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "sku", Value: asc}, {Key: "mfg_date", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollBatchQRs: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "qr_code", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			// QR listing sorts on issued_at, optionally narrowed to one lot.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "product_lot_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "issued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "issued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollSettlements: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "date", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollPayouts: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_id", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
		},
		CollDBTRequests: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "created_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollNotifications: {
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: asc}, {Key: "queued_at", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: asc}, {Key: "queued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),
			// The party-scoped inbox read (GET /notifications/me), newest first.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "queued_at", Value: desc}}, nil),

		CollProvenance: {

			idx(bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: asc}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: asc}, {Key: "seq", Value: asc}}, nil),

		CollAuditLogs: {

			idx(bson.D{{Key: "target_type", Value: asc}, {Key: "target_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollFeatureFlags: {

		CollProducts: {

			idx(bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: asc}, {Key: "published", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "region_scope", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollQCCertificates: {
			// One regulatory certificate per batch is enforced in the service
			// (findCertificateByBatch → 409 ALREADY_ISSUED before insert). The
			// batch_id index stays non-unique so a boot over historical data that
			// predates the guard (possible duplicate certs) never fails index
			// creation; certificate_number remains globally unique.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_id", Value: asc}}, nil),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "certificate_number", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
		},
		CollSettings: {
			// `_id` is the setting key (e.g. "sachiv_cap") — a small keyed store
			// for governance knobs that are neither boolean flags nor counters.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
		},
		CollConsignmentQC: {
			// One QC record per per-samiti batch (consignment).
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "consignment_id", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_code", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
		CollConsignmentBatchQRs: {
			// The public scan resolves by batch_code OR token.
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "batch_code", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "consignment_id", Value: asc}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)),
			idx(bson.D{{Key: "token", Value: asc}}, nil),
		},
	}

	for coll, models := range specs {
		if _, err := db.Collection(coll).Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, models); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("ensure indexes on %s: %w", coll, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func idx(keys bson.D, opts *options.IndexOptions) mongo.IndexModel {
	m := mongo.IndexModel{Keys: keys}
	if opts != nil {
		m.Options = opts
	}
	return m
}

   166	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.

   168	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {

   170		n, okN := kycRank[need]
   171		if !okH || !okN {
   172			return false
   173		}
   174		return h >= n

   247	// org-unit type. Roles with no entry in RoleAllowedOrgTypes are unrestricted.
   248	func RoleAllowedAtOrgType(roleCode, orgType string) bool {

    49	// Assurance levels (Developer Note §6.2) — how fat/SNF was captured. Every
    50	// pour carries one; every downstream aggregate (consignment, batch, lot)
    51	// inherits the WEAKEST assurance in its set, so capture quality is measurable
    52	// and drives societies toward instrument-linked capture.
    53	const (
    54		AssuranceInstrument = "A" // analyzer streamed the reading (RS-232/BLE) — strongest
    55		AssuranceOCRPhoto   = "B" // OCR of an analyzer-screen photo, photo retained as evidence
    56		AssuranceManual     = "C" // keyed by hand — weakest, drives supervisor sampling
    57	)
    58	
    59	// AssuranceForSource maps a reading/pour capture mode to its assurance level.
    60	func AssuranceForSource(source string) string {
    61		switch source {
    62		case ReadingModeDirect:
    63			return AssuranceInstrument
    64		case ReadingModePhotoOCR:
    65			return AssuranceOCRPhoto
    66		default:
    67			return AssuranceManual
    68		}
    69	}
    70	
    71	// AssuranceForCapture derives the pour's assurance from the capture EVIDENCE,
    72	// not just the claimed source (Developer Note §6.2/§12.3): A requires the
    73	// analyzer path WITH a device identity; B requires the retained analyzer-screen
    74	// photo — a stronger-than-manual claim backed by nothing downgrades to C.
    75	func AssuranceForCapture(source, deviceID, photoObjectKey string) string {
    76		switch source {
    77		case ReadingModeDirect:
    78			if deviceID != "" {
    79				return AssuranceInstrument
    80			}
    81			// Analyzer claimed but no device identity: photo evidence still earns B.
    82			if photoObjectKey != "" {
    83				return AssuranceOCRPhoto
    84			}
    85			return AssuranceManual
    86		case ReadingModePhotoOCR:
    87			if photoObjectKey != "" {
    88				return AssuranceOCRPhoto
    89			}
    90			return AssuranceManual // never B without the photo evidence
    91		default:
    92			return AssuranceManual
    93		}
    94	}
    95	
    96	// NormalizeReadingMode maps loose client spellings onto the canonical reading
    97	// modes ("analyzer" → ANALYZER_DIRECT, "ocr"/"photo" → PHOTO_OCR, "manual" →
    98	// MANUAL). Unknown values are returned upper-cased so validation still rejects
    99	// them explicitly.
   100	func NormalizeReadingMode(source string) string {
   101		switch v := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(source)); v {
   102		case "ANALYZER", "ANALYSER", "ANALYZER_DIRECT", "ANALYSER_DIRECT", "DIRECT":
   103			return ReadingModeDirect
   104		case "OCR", "PHOTO", "PHOTO_OCR":
   105			return ReadingModePhotoOCR
   106		case "MANUAL", "HAND", "KEYED":
   107			return ReadingModeManual
   108		default:
   109			return v
   110		}
   111	}
   112	
   113	// assuranceRank orders assurance so "weakest in a set" is a max-rank pick
   114	// (higher rank = weaker).
   115	var assuranceRank = map[string]int{AssuranceInstrument: 0, AssuranceOCRPhoto: 1, AssuranceManual: 2}
   116	
   117	// WeakestAssurance returns the weakest (lowest-trust) assurance among the
   118	// given levels — the value an aggregate inherits (§6.2). Empty input → "".
   119	func WeakestAssurance(levels ...string) string {
   120		weakest, seen := "", -1
   121		for _, l := range levels {
   122			if r, ok := assuranceRank[l]; ok && r > seen {
   123				weakest, seen = l, r
   124			}
   125		}
   126		return weakest
   127	}

   129	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
   130	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
   131		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
   132		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
   133		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100

   179	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns

   181	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {

   183		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
   184			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
   185			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)

   244	// Invoice statuses through the same-day payment loop (blueprint §8.1).
   245	const (
   246		InvoiceStatusIssued            = "ISSUED"
   247		InvoiceStatusSettlementPending = "SETTLEMENT_PENDING"
   248		InvoiceStatusPaid              = "PAID"
   249		InvoiceStatusHold              = "HOLD" // e.g. safety-gate payment hold
   250	)
   251	
   252	// Invoice aggregates one farmer's pours at one DCS for one day — the artefact
   253	// behind "same-day farmer payment". InvoiceNumber is the human-readable
   254	// unique business key; relations use ObjectIDs.
   255	type Invoice struct {
   256		ID                  primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
   257		InvoiceNumber       string               `bson:"invoice_number" json:"invoice_number"` // unique, e.g. INV-DCS01842-20260706-0001
   258		FarmerPartyID       primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"farmer_party_id" json:"farmer_party_id"`
   259		DCSID               primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"dcs_id"        json:"dcs_id"`
   260		InvoiceDate         string               `bson:"invoice_date"  json:"invoice_date"` // YYYY-MM-DD
   261		PourIDs             []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"pour_ids"      json:"pour_ids"`
   262		TotalQuantityLitres float64              `bson:"total_quantity_litres" json:"total_quantity_litres"`
   263		TotalAmount         float64              `bson:"total_amount"  json:"total_amount"`
   264		Status              string               `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
   265		SettlementBatchID   *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty" json:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty"`
   266		IssuedAt            time.Time            `bson:"issued_at"     json:"issued_at"`
   267		ProvenanceSeq       int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
   268	}
   269	
   270	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
   271	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
   272		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
   273		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
   274	}
   275	
   276	// InvoiceNumberFor builds the human-readable invoice number.
   277	func InvoiceNumberFor(dcsCode, dateKey string, seq int) string {
   278		return fmt.Sprintf("INV-%s-%s-%04d", dcsCode, dateKey, seq)
   279	}

     9	// BMC lot statuses. A lot cannot advance past QC_PENDING without a passing
    10	// QC result — the safety gate is enforced in software (blueprint §8.3).
    11	const (
    12		BMCLotStatusOpen        = "OPEN"        // accepting deliveries
    13		BMCLotStatusQCPending   = "QC_PENDING"  // closed, awaiting rapid tests
    14		BMCLotStatusPassed      = "PASSED"      // rapid tests within limits
    15		BMCLotStatusBlocked     = "BLOCKED"     // failed — quarantined, cannot advance
    16		BMCLotStatusQuarantined = "QUARANTINED" // QC HOLD — held pending analyst resolution (§13.5)
    17		BMCLotStatusDispatched  = "DISPATCHED"  // tankered to plant
    18		BMCLotStatusPooled      = "POOLED"      // terminal: consumed by a processing batch
    19	)

    21	// BMCLot pools consignments delivered to one bulk-milk-cooler for a date+shift.

    49	}

     1	package domain

     3	import (

    10	
    11	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
    12	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
    13	// never only at the finished product.
    14	const (
    15		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
    16		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
    17		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
    18	)
    19	
    20	// QC test names.
    21	const (
    22		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
    23		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
    24		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
    25		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
    26		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
    27		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
    28		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
    29	)
    30	
    31	// QC stages.
    32	const (
    33		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
    34		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
    35	)
    36	
    37	// QC subject types.
    38	const (
    39		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
    40		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
    41		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
    42	)
    43	
    44	// QC verdicts (Developer Note §6.5/§13.5): the Note's machine is
    45	// SAMPLED→HOLD→PASS/REJECT. HOLD quarantines the subject pending a re-test or
    46	// an analyst resolution — it is distinct from a terminal REJECT.
    47	const (
    48		QCVerdictPass   = "PASS"
    49		QCVerdictHold   = "HOLD"
    50		QCVerdictReject = "REJECT"
    51	)
    52	
    53	// EffectiveQCVerdict returns the stored verdict, deriving PASS/REJECT from the
    54	// legacy two-state overall_pass for results recorded before HOLD existed.
    55	func EffectiveQCVerdict(stored string, overallPass bool) string {
    56		if stored != "" {
    57			return stored
    58		}
    59		if overallPass {
    60			return QCVerdictPass
    61		}
    62		return QCVerdictReject
    63	}
    64	
    65	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
    66	type QCTest struct {
    67		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
    68		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
    69		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
    70		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
    71	}
    72	
    73	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
    74	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
    75	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
    76	type QCResult struct {
    77		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
    78		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
    79		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
    80		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
    81		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
    82		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
    83		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
    84		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
    85		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
    86		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
    87		// Verdict is PASS | HOLD | REJECT (§13.5). Empty on legacy documents —
    88		// read paths derive it from OverallPass via EffectiveQCVerdict.
    89		Verdict string `bson:"verdict,omitempty" json:"verdict,omitempty"`
    90		// HOLD resolution (POST /quality/qc-results/{id}/resolve): who resolved the
    91		// quarantine, when, and with what notes.
    92		ResolvedBy      *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"resolved_by,omitempty"      json:"resolved_by,omitempty"`
    93		ResolvedAt      *time.Time          `bson:"resolved_at,omitempty"      json:"resolved_at,omitempty"`
    94		ResolutionNotes string              `bson:"resolution_notes,omitempty" json:"resolution_notes,omitempty"`
    95		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
    96		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
    97		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
    98		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
    99		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
   100	}
   101	
   102	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
   103	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
   104	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
   105	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
   106	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
   107		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
   108		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
   109			return TestAflatoxinM1
   110		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
   111			return TestColiform
   112		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
   113			return TestTPC
   114		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
   115			return TestAntibiotic
   116		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
   117			return TestPhosphatase
   118		case "FAT":
   119			return TestFat
   120		case "SNF":
   121			return TestSNF
   122		default:
   123			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
   124		}
   125	}
   126	
   127	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
   128	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
   129	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
   130	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
   131	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
   132		overallPass = true
   133		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
   134		for _, t := range tests {
   135			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
   136			pass := true
   137			switch t.Name {
   138			case TestAflatoxinM1:
   139				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
   140					pass = false
   141					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
   142						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
   143				}
   144			case TestColiform:
   145				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
   146					pass = false
   147					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
   148						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
   149				}
   150			case TestAntibiotic:
   151				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
   152					pass = false
   153					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
   154						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
   155				}
   156			case TestPhosphatase:
   157				if t.Value != 0 {
   158					pass = false
   159					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
   160				}
   161			}
   162			t.Pass = pass
   163			if !pass {
   164				overallPass = false
   165			}
   166			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
   167		}
   168		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
   169	}

     9	// Product is one entry in the platform product master (blueprint §12 admin
    10	// control tower). It is the catalogue backbone the consumer-commerce and store
    11	// modules will read from once those phases land; here it is managed only
    12	// through the admin master surface.
    13	//
    14	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
    15	// SKU is the human-readable unique business key used for upsert idempotency —
    16	// PUT /admin/products keys on SKU, never on the ObjectID.
    17	type Product struct {
    18		ID       primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
    19		SKU      string             `bson:"sku"        json:"sku"` // unique business key, e.g. "MILK-TP-500"
    20		Name     string             `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
    21		NameHi   string             `bson:"name_hi,omitempty" json:"name_hi,omitempty"`   // vernacular display name
    22		Category string             `bson:"category,omitempty" json:"category,omitempty"` // MILK|DAHI|PANEER|GHEE|BUTTER|OTHER
    23		MRP      float64            `bson:"mrp"        json:"mrp"`
    24		UnitSize string             `bson:"unit_size"  json:"unit_size"` // e.g. "500ml", "1L", "200g"
    25		// ShelfLifeDays lets a product-lot mint derive expiry when the pack sheet
    26		// omits it (expiry = mfg_date + ShelfLifeDays); 0 falls back to a safe default.
    27		ShelfLifeDays int       `bson:"shelf_life_days,omitempty" json:"shelf_life_days,omitempty"`
    28		Active        bool      `bson:"active"     json:"active"`
    29		CreatedAt     time.Time `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
    30		UpdatedAt     time.Time `bson:"updated_at" json:"updated_at"`
    31	}
    32	
    33	// ProductCategories is the closed set of product-master categories (mirrors the
    34	// frontend Product.category union). Empty/unknown normalises to OTHER on upsert.
    35	var ProductCategories = map[string]struct{}{
    36		"MILK": {}, "DAHI": {}, "PANEER": {}, "GHEE": {}, "BUTTER": {}, "OTHER": {},
    37	}
    38	
    39	// NormalizeProductCategory validates a category, defaulting to OTHER when empty
    40	// or outside the closed set.
    41	func NormalizeProductCategory(c string) string {
    42		if c == "" {
    43			return "OTHER"
    44		}
    45		if _, ok := ProductCategories[c]; ok {
    46			return c
    47		}
    48		return "OTHER"
    49	}

     9	// QCCertificate is a first-class, issued safety-gate certificate for a
    10	// processing batch whose PLANT_LAB QC has PASSED (blueprint §8.3). Unlike the
    11	// certificate number stamped inline on a passing QCResult, this is a durable,
    12	// independently addressable document: it rosters the underlying test-result
    13	// IDs, records the issuing analyst and the plant's FSSAI licence, and can be
    14	// presented as the compliance artefact for the batch's finished product.
    15	type QCCertificate struct {
    16		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"      json:"id"`
    17		BatchID           primitive.ObjectID `bson:"batch_id"           json:"batch_id"`
    18		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number" json:"certificate_number"` // unique business key
    19		// TestResultIDs is the roster of QCResult documents this certificate
    20		// attests to (the batch's recorded results at issuance time).
    21		TestResultIDs   []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"test_result_ids"       json:"test_result_ids"`
    22		FSSAILicNo      string               `bson:"fssai_lic_no,omitempty" json:"fssai_lic_no,omitempty"`
    23		IssuedByPartyID primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"issued_by_party_id"    json:"issued_by_party_id"`
    24		IssuedAt        time.Time            `bson:"issued_at"             json:"issued_at"`
    25	}

     8	
     9	// Per-samiti batch QC parameters (F7). These are the MOCK criteria the
    10	// PLANT_LAB_ANALYST records manually per delivered batch — configurable later.
    11	// AFLATOXIN_M1 keeps its hard FSSAI ceiling (0.5 µg/kg) server-side: a value
    12	// over the limit can never be recorded as a pass, whatever the client sent.
    13	const (
    14		BatchTestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1" // µg/kg, limit 0.5
    15		BatchTestAddedWater  = "ADDED_WATER"  // freezing-point depression check
    16		BatchTestAdulterants = "ADULTERANTS"  // neutralisers/detergents/urea/starch — pass/fail
    17		BatchTestAntibiotics = "ANTIBIOTICS"  // pass/fail
    18		BatchTestFatPct      = "FAT_PCT"      // %
    19		BatchTestSNFPct      = "SNF_PCT"      // %
    20	)
    21	
    22	// BatchQCParameters is the closed vocabulary of recordable batch QC
    23	// parameters. Anything else is rejected instead of silently recorded.
    24	var BatchQCParameters = map[string]struct{}{
    25		BatchTestAflatoxinM1: {},
    26		BatchTestAddedWater:  {},
    27		BatchTestAdulterants: {},
    28		BatchTestAntibiotics: {},
    29		BatchTestFatPct:      {},
    30		BatchTestSNFPct:      {},
    31	}
    32	
    33	// BatchQCTest is one manually recorded measurement of a per-samiti batch.
    34	// Value is a pointer so pass/fail-only parameters (ADULTERANTS, ANTIBIOTICS)
    35	// can omit a numeric reading instead of fabricating a zero.
    36	type BatchQCTest struct {
    37		Parameter string   `bson:"parameter"       json:"parameter"`
    38		Value     *float64 `bson:"value,omitempty" json:"value,omitempty"`
    39		Unit      string   `bson:"unit,omitempty"  json:"unit,omitempty"`
    40		Pass      bool     `bson:"pass"            json:"pass"`
    41	}
    42	
    43	// ConsignmentQC is the per-batch (per-samiti consignment) QC result recorded
    44	// at the plant lab (F7). Overall pass = every test passed; a pass auto-mints
    45	// the batch QR, a fail rejects the consignment (no QR).
    46	type ConsignmentQC struct {
    47		ID            primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"   json:"id"`
    48		ConsignmentID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consignment_id"  json:"consignment_id"`
    49		BatchCode     string             `bson:"batch_code"      json:"batch_code"`
    50		Tests         []BatchQCTest      `bson:"tests"           json:"tests"`
    51		OverallPass   bool               `bson:"overall_pass"    json:"overall_pass"`
    52		// Verdict is PASS | HOLD | REJECT (§13.5). Empty on legacy documents — read
    53		// paths derive it from OverallPass via EffectiveQCVerdict. A HOLD keeps the
    54		// consignment ACCEPTED with qc_hold=true and may be re-tested.
    55		Verdict       string             `bson:"verdict,omitempty" json:"verdict,omitempty"`
    56		Notes         string             `bson:"notes,omitempty" json:"notes,omitempty"`
    57		TestedBy      primitive.ObjectID `bson:"tested_by"       json:"tested_by"`
    58		TestedAt      time.Time          `bson:"tested_at"       json:"tested_at"`
    59		// History keeps the prior HOLD attempts when the batch is re-tested — the
    60		// document stays one-per-consignment (unique index) but no attempt is lost.
    61		History       []ConsignmentQCAttempt `bson:"history,omitempty" json:"history,omitempty"`
    62		ProvenanceSeq int64              `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
    63	}
    64	
    65	// ConsignmentQCAttempt is one superseded (HOLD) test attempt retained on the
    66	// consignment's QC document when the batch is re-tested.
    67	type ConsignmentQCAttempt struct {
    68		Tests    []BatchQCTest      `bson:"tests"           json:"tests"`
    69		Verdict  string             `bson:"verdict"         json:"verdict"`
    70		Notes    string             `bson:"notes,omitempty" json:"notes,omitempty"`
    71		TestedBy primitive.ObjectID `bson:"tested_by"       json:"tested_by"`
    72		TestedAt time.Time          `bson:"tested_at"       json:"tested_at"`
    73	}
    74	
    75	// ConsignmentBatchQR is the public QR minted automatically when a per-samiti
    76	// batch passes QC (F7): code == the consignment's batch_code, token is a
    77	// short HMAC over the batch code (signed with the QR secret) so a scan can
    78	// verify the record was minted by this server. Resolved publicly at
    79	// GET /public/qr/{batch_code or token} into the batch quality report (F8).
    80	type ConsignmentBatchQR struct {
    81		ID            primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"  json:"id"`
    82		ConsignmentID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consignment_id" json:"consignment_id"`
    83		BatchCode     string             `bson:"batch_code"     json:"batch_code"`
    84		Token         string             `bson:"token"          json:"token"`
    85		IssuedAt      time.Time          `bson:"issued_at"      json:"issued_at"`
    86	}

     9	// CMS content types (blueprint §6.1). The set is deliberately open for
    10	// extension: a future type (e.g. a "maps" content item) is a new constant +
    11	// AllCMSTypes entry — the module's storage, delta pull and RBAC are all

    13	const (

    16		CMSTypeArticle  = "article"
    17		CMSTypeHelpline = "helpline"

    19	
    20	// AllCMSTypes is the closed set of authored content types (extend here).
    21	var AllCMSTypes = []string{
    22		CMSTypeScheme, CMSTypeVideo, CMSTypeArticle, CMSTypeHelpline,
    23	}
    24	
    25	// CMS region scopes: the org tier a content item is targeted at. "all" is the
    26	// unconditional default (shown everywhere); the others narrow to the org unit
    27	// named by RegionRef.
    28	const (
    29		CMSScopeState    = "state"
    30		CMSScopeDistrict = "district"
    31		CMSScopeSociety  = "society"
    32		CMSScopeAll      = "all"
    33	)
    34	
    35	// AllCMSScopes is the closed set of region scopes (extend here).
    36	var AllCMSScopes = []string{
    37		CMSScopeState, CMSScopeDistrict, CMSScopeSociety, CMSScopeAll,
    38	}
    39	
    40	var cmsTypeSet = sliceSet(AllCMSTypes)
    41	var cmsScopeSet = sliceSet(AllCMSScopes)
    42	
    43	func sliceSet(vals []string) map[string]struct{} {
    44		s := make(map[string]struct{}, len(vals))
    45		for _, v := range vals {
    46			s[v] = struct{}{}
    47		}
    48		return s
    49	}
    50	
    51	// IsValidCMSType reports whether t is one of the content types.
    52	func IsValidCMSType(t string) bool {
    53		_, ok := cmsTypeSet[t]
    54		return ok
    55	}
    56	
    57	// IsValidCMSScope reports whether s is one of the region scopes.
    58	func IsValidCMSScope(s string) bool {
    59		_, ok := cmsScopeSet[s]
    60		return ok
    61	}

    63	// CMSContent is one authored content item served to the field app — a scheme
    64	// card, an explainer video, an article or a Get-Help helpline entry
    65	// (blueprint §6.1). Titles and descriptions are keyed by language code so a
    66	// single item serves every locale. Version is a monotonic cursor: the app
    67	// pulls only items with a version greater than the one it last saw
    68	// (versioned delta sync), and every author write bumps it.
    69	type CMSContent struct {

    76		PhoneNumbers    []string            `bson:"phone_numbers,omitempty"      json:"phone_numbers,omitempty"`
    77		Languages       []string            `bson:"languages,omitempty"          json:"languages,omitempty"`
    78		RegionScope     string              `bson:"region_scope"                 json:"region_scope"`
    79		RegionRef       *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"region_ref,omitempty"         json:"region_ref,omitempty"`
    80		Category        string              `bson:"category,omitempty"           json:"category,omitempty"`
    81		Order           int                 `bson:"order"                        json:"order"`
    82		Published       bool                `bson:"published"                    json:"published"`
    83		Version         int64               `bson:"version"                      json:"version"`
    84		ValidFrom       *time.Time          `bson:"valid_from,omitempty"         json:"valid_from,omitempty"`
    85		ValidTo         *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"           json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
    86		CreatedAt       time.Time           `bson:"created_at"                   json:"created_at"`

    88	
    89	// MarshalJSON flattens the doorstep Preferences (receiver_name, ring_bell,
    90	// call_before, instructions, door_photo_uri, geo_label) onto the address wire
    91	// object — the app reads them top-level, and an address book that never sends
    92	// them back silently blanked every saved doorstep profile on hydration.
    93	func (a address) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
    94		type plain address // method-free alias, avoids recursion
    95		raw, err := json.Marshal(plain(a))
    96		if err != nil {
    97			return nil, err
    98		}
    99		if len(a.Preferences) == 0 {
   100			return raw, nil
   101		}
   102		var m map[string]any
   103		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
   104			return nil, err
   105		}
   106		for _, k := range []string{"receiver_name", "geo_label", "ring_bell", "call_before", "instructions", "door_photo_uri"} {
   107			if v, ok := a.Preferences[k]; ok {
   108				m[k] = v
   109			}
   110		}
   111		return json.Marshal(m)
   112	}

   141		Bucket       string             `bson:"bucket"            json:"bucket"` // CASH|REWARDS
   142		Amount       float64            `bson:"amount"            json:"amount"`

   144		RewardsAfter float64            `bson:"rewards_after"     json:"rewards_after"`
   145		RefType      string             `bson:"ref_type,omitempty" json:"ref_type,omitempty"`

   152	// paymentOrder is a wallet top-up order whose amount is BOUND server-side at
   153	// creation, so a tampered client cannot pay ₹1 for a ₹500 top-up (§ razorpay.ts
   154	// security model). Verified before the wallet is credited.
   155	type paymentOrder struct {
   156		ID          primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"`
   157		OrderID     string             `bson:"order_id"`    // Razorpay order id (or dev pseudo id) — unique

   159		AmountPaise int64              `bson:"amount_paise"`
   160		Receipt     string             `bson:"receipt,omitempty"`

   164		Purpose   string     `bson:"purpose,omitempty"` // topup | order
   165		RefID     string     `bson:"ref_id,omitempty"`  // linked consumer order id when purpose=order
   166		Status    string     `bson:"status"`            // CREATED | PAID

     1	package consumer
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"context"

     9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
    10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
    11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
    12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
    13	)
    14	
    15	type repository struct {
    16		accounts      *mongo.Collection
    17		otp           *mongo.Collection
    18		refresh       *mongo.Collection
    19		addresses     *mongo.Collection
    20		wallets       *mongo.Collection
    21		walletTxns    *mongo.Collection
    22		consents      *mongo.Collection
    23		payOrders     *mongo.Collection
    24		mandates      *mongo.Collection
    25		subscriptions *mongo.Collection
    26		trials        *mongo.Collection
    27		orders        *mongo.Collection
    28		deliveries    *mongo.Collection
    29		riderPresence *mongo.Collection
    30		catalog       *mongo.Collection
    31		storeZones    *mongo.Collection
    32		waitlist      *mongo.Collection
    33		// Operator collections — READ-mostly for the delivery flow (store/rider
    34		// resolution). Deliveries are consumer_*; these are shared Saathi identity.
    35		orgUnits        *mongo.Collection
    36		parties         *mongo.Collection
    37		roleAssignments *mongo.Collection
    38		notifications   *mongo.Collection
    39	}
    40	
    41	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
    42		return &repository{
    43			accounts:        db.Collection(collAccounts),
    44			otp:             db.Collection(collOTP),
    45			refresh:         db.Collection(collRefresh),
    46			addresses:       db.Collection(collAddresses),
    47			wallets:         db.Collection(collWallets),
    48			walletTxns:      db.Collection(collWalletTxns),
    49			consents:        db.Collection(collConsents),
    50			payOrders:       db.Collection(collPayOrders),
    51			mandates:        db.Collection(collMandates),
    52			subscriptions:   db.Collection(collSubscriptions),
    53			trials:          db.Collection(collConsumerTrials),
    54			orders:          db.Collection(collOrders),
    55			deliveries:      db.Collection(collDeliveries),
    56			riderPresence:   db.Collection(collRiderPresence),
    57			catalog:         db.Collection(collCatalog),
    58			storeZones:      db.Collection(collStoreZones),
    59			waitlist:        db.Collection(collConsumerWaitlist),
    60			orgUnits:        db.Collection("org_units"),
    61			parties:         db.Collection("parties"),
    62			roleAssignments: db.Collection("role_assignments"),
    63			notifications:   db.Collection("notifications"),
    64		}
    65	}
    66	
    67	// ensureIndexes creates the consumer collections' indexes at startup — the
    68	// consumer module owns its own indexes so it never touches shared Saathi infra.
    69	func (r *repository) ensureIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
    70		specs := []struct {
    71			c    *mongo.Collection
    72			keys bson.D
    73			opts *options.IndexOptions
    74		}{
    75			{r.accounts, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
    76			{r.accounts, bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}, nil},
    77			{r.otp, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: 1}}, nil},
    78			{r.otp, bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetExpireAfterSeconds(0)},
    79			{r.refresh, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
    80			{r.refresh, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
    81			{r.addresses, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
    82			{r.wallets, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
    83			{r.walletTxns, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "seq", Value: -1}}, nil},
    84			// EXACTLY-ONCE money gate: a (consumer, ref, type) may exist at most once,
    85			// so a duplicate/concurrent same-ref movement can never double-credit.
    86			// Partial — only enforced for rows that actually carry a ref.
    87			{r.walletTxns, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "ref_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "type", Value: 1}},
    88				options.Index().SetUnique(true).SetPartialFilterExpression(bson.D{{Key: "ref_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: ""}}}})},
    89			// A payment order id is globally unique — the top-up idempotency anchor.
    90			{r.payOrders, bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
    91			{r.payOrders, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
    92		}
    93		for _, s := range specs {
    94			if _, err := s.c.Indexes().CreateOne(ctx, mongo.IndexModel{Keys: s.keys, Options: s.opts}); err != nil {
    95				return fmt.Errorf("consumer index (%v): %w", s.keys, err)
    96			}
    97		}
    98		if err := r.ensureOrderIndexes(ctx); err != nil {
    99			return fmt.Errorf("consumer order indexes: %w", err)
   100		}
   101		if err := r.ensureDeliveryIndexes(ctx); err != nil {
   102			return fmt.Errorf("consumer delivery indexes: %w", err)
   103		}
   104		if err := r.ensureCatalogIndexes(ctx); err != nil {
   105			return fmt.Errorf("consumer catalog indexes: %w", err)

   125	func (r *repository) insertWalletTxnGate(ctx context.Context, t walletTxn) (dup bool, err error) {

   200	func (r *repository) deleteAccountCascade(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) error {
   201		// DPDP erasure: drop the consumer's PII rows. Financial ledgers would, in
   202		// production, be re-keyed to a pseudonymous id and retained (§21); for the
   203		// pilot we remove the consumer-scoped rows.
   204		filter := bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: id}}
   205		for _, c := range []*mongo.Collection{r.addresses, r.wallets, r.walletTxns, r.consents, r.refresh, r.payOrders} {
   206			if _, err := c.DeleteMany(ctx, filter); err != nil {
   207				return errInternal("erasure failed")
   208			}
   209		}
   210		// Orders carry raw PII (name, phone, precise geo, address) and are keyed by
   211		// user_id (the consumer hex), not consumer_id — erase them too.
   212		if _, err := r.orders.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "user_id", Value: id.Hex()}}); err != nil {
   213			return errInternal("erasure failed")
   214		}
   215		// OTP challenges are keyed by phone, not consumer_id — clear by phone too so
   216		// no auth material or phone-number PII survives the erasure.
   217		if acct, err := r.findAccountByID(ctx, id); err == nil && acct != nil {
   218			phone := acct.Phone
   219			phone = phone[len(phone)-10:] // stored as +91XXXXXXXXXX → the OTP phone is the 10-digit
   220			_, _ = r.otp.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}})
   221		}
   222		if _, err := r.accounts.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}); err != nil {
   223			return errInternal("erasure failed")
   224		}
   225		return nil
   226	}

   404			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {

   406			}

   408		}

   411	
   412	// incWallet ATOMICALLY increments the balances + seq via $inc and returns the
   413	// fresh doc. Because $inc is atomic in Mongo, two concurrent money movements
   414	// can never corrupt the balance (last-writer-wins is impossible) — the balance
   415	// is the append-only ledger's materialised sum. Upserts so a missing wallet is
   416	// created race-safe. seqDelta reserves the ledger seqs this movement will use.
   417	func (r *repository) incWallet(ctx context.Context, consumerID primitive.ObjectID, cashDelta, rewardsDelta, heldDelta float64, seqDelta int64) (*wallet, error) {
   418		after := options.After
   419		var wl wallet
   420		err := r.wallets.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
   421			bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: consumerID}},
   422			bson.D{
   423				{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{
   424					{Key: "cash_balance", Value: cashDelta},
   425					{Key: "rewards_balance", Value: rewardsDelta},
   426					{Key: "held_amount", Value: heldDelta},
   427					{Key: "seq", Value: seqDelta},
   428				}},
   429				{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
   430					{Key: "_id", Value: primitive.NewObjectID()},
   431					{Key: "consumer_id", Value: consumerID},
   432					{Key: "currency", Value: "INR"},
   433				}},
   434			},
   435			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(after).SetUpsert(true),
   436		).Decode(&wl)
   437		if err != nil {
   438			return nil, errInternal("wallet update failed")
   439		}
   440		return &wl, nil
   441	}
   442	
   443	// debitWalletAtomic spends `amount` PROMO-FIRST (rewards preserved as spendable
   444	// but real cash conserved last) in a SINGLE atomic guarded pipeline update. The
   445	// $expr filter admits the update only when cash+rewards >= amount, so a
   446	// concurrent debit can never overdraw and the insufficient-funds check is
   447	// race-free. ok=false means insufficient funds (or no wallet) — nothing changed.
   448	func (r *repository) debitWalletAtomic(ctx context.Context, consumerID primitive.ObjectID, amount float64, seqDelta int64) (*wallet, bool, error) {
   449		after := options.After
   450		var wl wallet
   451		err := r.wallets.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
   452			bson.D{
   453				{Key: "consumer_id", Value: consumerID},
   454				{Key: "$expr", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: bson.A{
   455					bson.D{{Key: "$add", Value: bson.A{"$cash_balance", "$rewards_balance"}}}, amount,
   456				}}}},
   457			},
   458			mongo.Pipeline{
   459				// __fp = amount taken from rewards (promo) first.
   460				bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "__fp", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$min", Value: bson.A{amount, "$rewards_balance"}}}}}}},
   461				bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
   462					{Key: "rewards_balance", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$subtract", Value: bson.A{"$rewards_balance", "$__fp"}}}},
   463					{Key: "cash_balance", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$subtract", Value: bson.A{"$cash_balance", bson.D{{Key: "$subtract", Value: bson.A{amount, "$__fp"}}}}}}},
   464					{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$add", Value: bson.A{"$seq", seqDelta}}}},
   465				}}},
   466				bson.D{{Key: "$unset", Value: "__fp"}},
   467			},
   468			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(after),
   469		).Decode(&wl)
   470		if isNoDocs(err) {
   471			return nil, false, nil // insufficient funds (or no wallet)
   472		}
   473		if err != nil {
   474			return nil, false, errInternal("wallet debit failed")
   475		}
   476		return &wl, true, nil
   477	}
   478

package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
)

// Orders — the consumer purchase aggregate. Mirrors the shipped FE Order shape
// (lib/api.ts) exactly so the app's placeOrder/listOrders/getOrder/cancelOrder/
// reviewOrder seams compose without any FE change. The backend OWNS the order;
// money is debited on DELIVERY via the server wallet (the FE's
// settleDeliveredOrders sweep calls /wallet/debit, idempotent by order id), so
// creation never moves money. All rows are scoped to the authenticated shopper.

const collOrders = "consumer_orders"

// Delivery-fee policy — kept identical to the FE (lib/api.ts).
const freeDeliveryOver = 199.0
const deliveryFee = 15.0

// Fair-use order caps — kept identical to the FE (lib/pricing.ts).
const maxQtyPerProduct = 10
const maxItemsPerOrder = 30

func deliveryFeeFor(subtotal float64) float64 {
	if subtotal >= freeDeliveryOver || subtotal == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return deliveryFee
}

// Statuses a placed order may still be cancelled from. "assigned" is included so a
// customer can still cancel AFTER a rider claims/accepts but BEFORE pickup — once the
// order is picked up (out_for_delivery) it can no longer be cancelled or returned.
var cancellableStatuses = map[string]bool{"placed": true, "confirmed": true, "assigned": true}

// ── Documents (bson) + wire shape (json matches the FE Order) ────────────────

type orderItem struct {
	ID        string  `bson:"id"         json:"id"`
	ProductID string  `bson:"product_id" json:"product_id"`
	Name      string  `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
	Variant   string  `bson:"variant"    json:"variant"`
	Price     float64 `bson:"price"      json:"price"`
	Qty       int     `bson:"qty"        json:"qty"`
}

type rider struct {
	ID         string   `bson:"id"          json:"id"`

	PlacedAt       time.Time          `bson:"placed_at"               json:"placed_at"`

	DeliveryWindow string             `bson:"delivery_window,omitempty" json:"delivery_window,omitempty"`

	// wallet or the hold. Absent (omitempty) on every normal order.
	TrialFree bool         `bson:"trial_free,omitempty"    json:"trial_free,omitempty"`

	Rider     *rider       `bson:"riders,omitempty"        json:"riders"`

	Phone        string    `bson:"phone,omitempty"         json:"-"`
	Geo          *geoPoint `bson:"geo,omitempty"           json:"-"`
	CreatedAt    time.Time `bson:"created_at"              json:"-"`

	// ScheduledFor is the IST day it delivers — surfaced as delivery_date (the

	// the moment it is scheduled. SubLockedAt is stamped at the midnight lock:
	// before it, the order is a modifiable preview (subscription edits
	// reconcile it, the shopper may cancel it); after it, the delivery task

	SubscriptionID string `bson:"subscription_id,omitempty" json:"-"`
	ScheduledFor   string `bson:"scheduled_for,omitempty"   json:"delivery_date,omitempty"`

func newOrderID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "ord_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}
func newItemID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "item_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)

func (r *repository) ensureOrderIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
	specs := []mongo.IndexModel{
		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "user_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "placed_at", Value: -1}}},
	}
	if _, err := r.orders.Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, specs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *repository) insertOrder(ctx context.Context, o *order) error {
	if _, err := r.orders.InsertOne(ctx, o); err != nil {
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
			return errConflict("ORDER_EXISTS", "order already exists")
		}
		return errInternal("order create failed")
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *repository) listOrders(ctx context.Context, userID string) ([]order, error) {
	cur, err := r.orders.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "user_id", Value: userID}},
		options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "placed_at", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(200))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errInternal("orders lookup failed")
	}
	out := []order{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, errInternal("orders decode failed")
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (r *repository) findOrder(ctx context.Context, orderID, userID string) (*order, error) {
	var o order
	err := r.orders.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: orderID}, {Key: "user_id", Value: userID}}).Decode(&o)
	if isNoDocs(err) {
		return nil, errNotFound("order not found")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errInternal("order lookup failed")
	}
	return &o, nil
}

// findOrderAnyUser — internal lookup with no ownership filter (delivery-side
// guards that need the parent order's status). Never exposed on a route.
func (r *repository) findOrderAnyUser(ctx context.Context, orderID string) (*order, error) {
	var o order
	err := r.orders.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: orderID}}).Decode(&o)
	if isNoDocs(err) {
		return nil, errNotFound("order not found")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errInternal("order lookup failed")
	}
	return &o, nil
}

package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
)

// SERVER-OWNED SUBSCRIPTIONS — the backend twin of the consumer app's local
// subscription rows (lib/subscriptions.ts), so the DAILY MORNING ORDER exists
// even when nobody opens the app.
//
// Model (mirrors the FE exactly):
//   one subscription = ONE product line (product, variant, qty, unit price) +
//   a cadence (daily | alternate | weekly) anchored at start_date, minus any
//   vacation ranges (a skip is a one-day vacation, start == end).
//
// MONEY MODEL — no charge at creation. The worker only CREATES the order
// (payment_method "wallet"); money moves exactly once ON DELIVERY through the
// existing settle path (deliverDelivery → debit "delivery:<orderID>"), which
// also applies the Taaza 2-paid-2-free welcome trial. Charging here as well
// would double-debit — the AutoPay mandate (mandate.go) remains the wallet
// top-up backstop, not the per-delivery charge.
//
// ADDRESS MODEL — a subscription NEVER carries its own address. Every order the
// worker creates resolves the consumer's CURRENT default saved address (with
// lat/lng, so geofence routes it to the serving store). One saved address feeds
// every subscription — new subscriptions never re-ask for a location, and an
// address edit re-points every future delivery automatically.
//
// EXACTLY-ONCE — at most one order per (subscription, IST day), enforced by an
// atomic last_order_date claim (UpdateOne guarded on $ne day), the same pattern
// as advanceMandateCharge. A crashed tick after the claim skips that day rather
// than ever double-ordering milk.

const collSubscriptions = "consumer_subscriptions"

// subscriptionDeliveryFee is the delivery fee on a SUBSCRIPTION morning delivery:
// always 0. The consumer app quotes and debits the bare subtotal on the Subscribe
// button, so the server-side recurring debit must match (never subtotal + ₹15).
const subscriptionDeliveryFee = 0.0

// NOTE: cadence math and day-claims use IST (istZone, shared with trial.go),
// matching the FE's local calendar dates, never UTC (UTC is "yesterday" until
// 05:30 IST).

// subscriptionFrequencies is the supported cadence set (FE Frequency minus the
// purely-local one_time/custom modes, which the app fulfils immediately itself).
var subscriptionFrequencies = map[string]bool{"daily": true, "alternate": true, "weekly": true}

// subscriptionTransitions — same shape as the mandate state machine.
var subscriptionTransitions = map[string]map[string]bool{
	"active":    {"paused": true, "cancelled": true},
	"paused":    {"active": true, "cancelled": true},
	"cancelled": {},
}

func subscriptionActionTarget(action string) (string, bool) {
	switch action {
	case "pause":
		return "paused", true
	case "resume":
		return "active", true
	case "cancel":
		return "cancelled", true
	default:
		return "", false
	}
}

// ── Documents + wire shapes (json mirrors the FE Subscription fields) ────────

type vacationRange struct {
	Start string `bson:"start" json:"start"` // YYYY-MM-DD inclusive
	End   string `bson:"end"   json:"end"`   // YYYY-MM-DD inclusive
}

type subscription struct {
	MongoID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"            json:"-"`
	SubscriptionID string             `bson:"subscription_id"          json:"id"` // public "sub_…"
	ConsumerID     primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consumer_id"              json:"-"`
	ProductID      string             `bson:"product_id"               json:"product_id"`
	Name           string             `bson:"name"                     json:"name"`
	Variant        string             `bson:"variant,omitempty"        json:"variant"`
	Qty            int                `bson:"qty"                      json:"qty"`
	UnitPrice      float64            `bson:"unit_price"               json:"unit_price"`
	Frequency      string             `bson:"frequency"                json:"frequency"` // daily|alternate|weekly
	DeliverySlot   string             `bson:"delivery_slot,omitempty"  json:"delivery_slot,omitempty"`
	Status         string             `bson:"status"                   json:"status"`     // active|paused|cancelled
	StartDate      string             `bson:"start_date"               json:"start_date"` // YYYY-MM-DD (IST)
	Vacations      []vacationRange    `bson:"vacations,omitempty"      json:"vacations,omitempty"`
	// LastOrderDate is the exactly-once day claim (YYYY-MM-DD IST) — the worker
	// creates at most one order per subscription per day.
	LastOrderDate string    `bson:"last_order_date,omitempty" json:"last_order_date,omitempty"`
	LastOrderID   string    `bson:"last_order_id,omitempty"   json:"last_order_id,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time `bson:"created_at"                json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     time.Time `bson:"updated_at"                json:"updated_at"`
}

func newSubscriptionID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "sub_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

// istToday returns the current IST calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD.
func istToday(now time.Time) string { return now.In(istZone).Format("2006-01-02") }

// parseDay parses a YYYY-MM-DD into an IST-midnight time (cadence anchor).
func parseDay(iso string) (time.Time, bool) {
	t, err := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", iso, istZone)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, false
	}
	return t, true
}

// subscriptionDeliversOn — the cadence law, IDENTICAL to the FE
// (lib/subscriptions.ts): daily every day, alternate every 2nd day, weekly
// every 7th, all counted from start_date. Days before the start never deliver.
func subscriptionDeliversOn(frequency, startDate, dayISO string) bool {
	from, ok1 := parseDay(startDate)
	to, ok2 := parseDay(dayISO)
	if !ok1 || !ok2 {
		return false
	}
	d := int(to.Sub(from).Hours() / 24)
	if d < 0 {
		return false
	}
	switch frequency {
	case "daily":
		return true
	case "alternate":
		return d%2 == 0
	case "weekly":
		return d%7 == 0
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// subscriptionDueOn — cadence AND not inside any vacation/skip range (dates are
// YYYY-MM-DD so string compare is chronological; the FE rule verbatim).
func subscriptionDueOn(sub *subscription, dayISO string) bool {
	if sub.Status != "active" || !subscriptionDeliversOn(sub.Frequency, sub.StartDate, dayISO) {
		return false
	}
	for _, v := range sub.Vacations {
		if dayISO >= v.Start && dayISO <= v.End {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// ── Repo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (r *repository) ensureSubscriptionIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
	specs := []mongo.IndexModel{
		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "subscription_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}},
		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: 1}}}, // the worker scans active subs
	}
	_, err := r.subscriptions.Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, specs)
	return err
}

func (r *repository) insertSubscription(ctx context.Context, s *subscription) error {
	if _, err := r.subscriptions.InsertOne(ctx, s); err != nil {
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
			return errConflict("SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS", "subscription already exists")
		}
		return errInternal("subscription create failed")
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *repository) findSubscription(ctx context.Context, subID string, consumerID primitive.ObjectID) (*subscription, error) {
	var s subscription
	err := r.subscriptions.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "subscription_id", Value: subID}, {Key: "consumer_id", Value: consumerID}}).Decode(&s)

package consumer

import (

// Consumer home-delivery (last mile). The store manager and delivery rider are
// SAATHI operators (onboarded via KYC, STORE-scoped roles) — these routes reuse
// Saathi's operator auth (Authenticate + RequireRoles) and the operator wire
// format ({data} envelope, camelCase, {error} on failure) because they are
// consumed by the Saathi FE client (delivery.ts / store.ts, service:'consumer').
//
// Flow: consumer places an order (consumer app) → a delivery task is created for
// the nearest Parag Store → the store manager assigns a rider (nearest 15/30/60
// km tier; distance behind a maps seam) → the rider accepts → picks up (out for
// delivery, streams location) → delivers with photo+geo proof → the consumer's
// wallet is debited EXACTLY ONCE (same order-derived ref as settleDeliveredOrders)
// and the consumer sees the order 'delivered'. Riders are salaried — no
// delivery-payment logic here.

const collDeliveries = "consumer_deliveries"

// collRiderPresence — the rider's LIVE duty position: upserted from the fix the
// rider app sends with every offer poll (~8 s while the app is open), so the
// 15-km offer fence and the manager's assign ranking judge the rider where they
// are RIGHT NOW, not where their last delivery ended.
const collRiderPresence = "consumer_rider_presence"

// Distance tiers (km) a store manager escalates through when picking riders.
var riderTiersKm = []float64{15, 30, 60}

type geoPt struct {
	Lat float64 `bson:"lat" json:"lat"`
	Lng float64 `bson:"lng" json:"lng"`
}

type deliveryItem struct {
	Name string `bson:"name" json:"name"`

// delivery is the last-mile task. bson = storage; json = the camelCase FE
// Delivery shape (src/core/types/domain.ts) the Saathi client reads verbatim.
type delivery struct {
	MongoID      primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"        json:"-"`
	ID           string             `bson:"delivery_id"          json:"id"`
	OrderID      string             `bson:"order_id"             json:"-"`
	OrderCode    string             `bson:"order_code"           json:"orderCode"`
	StoreID      string             `bson:"store_id"             json:"storeId"`
	RiderPartyID string             `bson:"rider_party_id"       json:"riderPartyId"`

	ConsumerName string             `bson:"consumer_name"        json:"consumerName"`
	PhoneMasked  string             `bson:"phone_masked"         json:"phoneMasked"`
	Phone        string             `bson:"phone,omitempty"      json:"phone,omitempty"`
	AddressLabel string             `bson:"address_label"        json:"addressLabel"`
	AddressLine  string             `bson:"address_line"         json:"addressLine"`
	Landmark     string             `bson:"landmark,omitempty"   json:"landmark,omitempty"`
	Geo          geoPt              `bson:"geo"                  json:"geo"`
	Items        []deliveryItem     `bson:"items"                json:"items"`
	Amount       float64            `bson:"amount"               json:"amount"`
	PaymentMode  string             `bson:"payment_mode"         json:"paymentMode"`
	// TrialEligible is set at creation when the order is a PYAAS Taaza subscription
	// item — only then may the 2-paid/2-free welcome trial waive its settle charge.
	TrialEligible bool   `bson:"trial_eligible,omitempty" json:"-"`
	Perishable    bool   `bson:"perishable"           json:"perishable"`
	Slot          string `bson:"slot"                 json:"slot"`
	// Lane mirrors the order's delivery lane: "instant" (≈20-min doorstep run,
	// nearby-rider ranked) or "morning" (the 5-7:30 AM subscription run).
	Lane string `bson:"lane,omitempty"       json:"lane,omitempty"`

	OfferedAt        string    `bson:"offered_at,omitempty"    json:"offeredAt,omitempty"`

	RejectedBy       []string  `bson:"rejected_by,omitempty"   json:"-"`

	LastLocationAt   string    `bson:"last_location_at,omitempty" json:"lastLocationAt,omitempty"`
	FailureReason    string    `bson:"failure_reason,omitempty" json:"failureReason,omitempty"`
	DeliveryEventID  string    `bson:"delivery_event_id,omitempty" json:"deliveryEventId,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time `bson:"created_at"           json:"-"`
	UpdatedAt        time.Time `bson:"updated_at"           json:"-"`
}

// riderSummary mirrors the FE RiderSummary (store roster).
type riderSummary struct {
	PartyID          string  `json:"partyId"`
	Name             string  `json:"name"`
	PhoneMasked      string  `json:"phoneMasked"`
	VehicleNo        string  `json:"vehicleNo"`
	ActiveDeliveries int     `json:"activeDeliveries"`

}

func newDeliveryID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "del_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

func maskPhone(p string) string {
	d := p
	if len(d) >= 10 {
		d = d[len(d)-10:]
		return d[:2] + "XXXXX" + d[7:]
	}
	return "XXXXXXXXXX"
}

// haversineKm — great-circle distance between two lat/lng points (the maps seam
// currently uses this on-device coords; a real maps/distance API drops in later).
func haversineKm(a, b geoPt) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	dLat := (b.Lat - a.Lat) * math.Pi / 180
	dLng := (b.Lng - a.Lng) * math.Pi / 180
	la1 := a.Lat * math.Pi / 180
	la2 := b.Lat * math.Pi / 180
	h := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) + math.Cos(la1)*math.Cos(la2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)
	return 2 * R * math.Asin(math.Sqrt(h))
}

func (r *repository) upsertRiderPresence(ctx context.Context, partyID string, g geoPt, at time.Time) {

		bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "lat", Value: g.Lat},
			{Key: "lng", Value: g.Lng},
			{Key: "at", Value: at.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)},
		}}},
		&options.UpdateOptions{Upsert: &upsert})
}

func (r *repository) findRiderPresence(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (geoPt, string, bool) {
	var doc struct {
		Lat float64 `bson:"lat"`
		Lng float64 `bson:"lng"`

	}
