every scope decision in this area goes through it (Invalidate on org change).","key_fields":["org id → OrgUnit{type, code, parent_id, path}"]}],"crm_relevant":[{"observation":"'pour.recorded' and 'invoice.issued' are published by collection/service.go:602, :1026, :1143 but NOTHING subscribes to them — the only Bus.Subscribe calls in the repo are in internal/modules/platformops/module.go:109-116.","why_it_matters":"These are the two highest-volume, highest-value farmer lifecycle events (litres poured, ₹ earned) and the bus seam is completely free. A CRM sync can subscribe without touching collection code at all. Payloads are the full domain.MilkPour / domain.Invoice structs (JSON keys: id, farmer_party_id, dcs_id, quantity_litres, rate_per_litre, amount, invoice_number, total_amount).","file":"internal/modules/collection/service.go"},{"observation":"There is NO Dolibarr/ERP touchpoint anywhere in cattle, collection or logistics. internal/platform/dolibarr is imported only by internal/modules/consumer (service.go, dolibarr_sync.go, leads.go, catalog_test.go).","why_it_matters":"Any farmer-side or supply-chain CRM/ERP push has to be built new. The consumer module's dolibarr_sync.go is the only existing pattern to copy for sync-state, retry and reconciliation.","file":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go"},{"observation":"Contact identity for this whole area is domain.Party: phone is the UNIQUE natural key (unique index on parties.phone), plus full_name, full_name_hi, village, preferred_language, kyc_tier, profile_photo_url, public_consent. There is NO email field anywhere in the Party model.","why_it_matters":"A CRM contact record must key on phone (or the party ObjectID), not email. public_consent (DPDP §6.7 opt-in for being NAMED publicly) is the consent flag already in the model and should gate any outward-facing naming.","file":"internal/domain/party.go"},{"observation":"'A farmer' is not a record type — it is a Party holding an ACTIVE FARMER RoleAssignment at a specific DCS org unit, validated by RoleAssignment.UsableAt(now) in collection/repo.go farmerIsActiveMember.","why_it_matters":"CRM 'account' membership is (party_id, org_unit_id, role_code=FARMER, status=ACTIVE, valid_from/valid_to). A farmer can churn by revocation without any record being deleted, and can in principle be a member of more than one DCS.","file":"internal/modules/collection/repo.go"},{"observation":"The idempotency pattern to copy: client_event_id is a device-minted STRING with a unique Mongo index; CreatePour short-circuits on it BEFORE any state-dependent business check, and replayStoredPour heals a half-completed saga (provenance_seq==0 → re-append the ledger event, re-publish, re-SMS) rather than blessing an orphan.","why_it_matters":"Any CRM sync writer should use the same shape: caller-supplied idempotency key + unique index + duplicate-key-as-replay + heal-on-replay, since the platform runs on a standalone Mongo with no transactions.","file":"internal/modules/collection/service.go"},{"observation":"The sync-state pattern to copy is health_events.bp_sync_status ∈ {PENDING, SYNCED, FAILED} with bp_sync_ref, plus an index on bp_sync_status; the push itself (SyncBharatPashudhan) is a MOCK that stamps 'BP-MOCK-<8 hex uuid>' and is explicitly documented as 'the real integration replaces this method body — API and data shapes stay put'.","why_it_matters":"A CRM sync can mirror this exact field triple (<x>_sync_status/<x>_sync_ref/index) on pours, invoices or parties, and the BP endpoint is a ready-made template for an outbound-push-with-state integration.","file":"internal/modules/cattle/service.go"},{"observation":"All outbound farmer messaging in this area is an OUTBOX WRITE ONLY: collection/service.go queueFarmerSMS inserts a notifications doc (status QUEUED, channel SMS, template POUR_RECEIPT / INVOICE_ISSUED, params map). Delivery only happens when someone calls POST /api/v1/notifications/worker/run, which is SUPER_ADMIN-only, and there is no cron or ticker for it anywhere.","why_it_matters":"Messages queued by pours and invoices are NOT sent automatically. Any CRM campaign relying on this outbox needs a scheduler; failures are logged and swallowed ('the receipt must not block the pour').","file":"internal/modules/collection/service.go"},{"observation":"Feature flags gating this area: flags.FlagCollarTelemetry ('collar_telemetry_enabled') hard-blocks POST /cattle/telemetry with 403 FEATURE_DISABLED, and flags.FlagPhotoOCR ('photo_ocr_enabled') hard-blocks PHOTO_OCR readings. Flags live in the feature_flags collection.","why_it_matters":"Same mechanism (deps.Flags.Enabled(ctx, name) + 403 FEATURE_DISABLED) is the sanctioned way to ship a dormant CRM integration behind a flag.","file":"internal/platform/flags/flags.go"},{"observation":"Money for the farmer leg is computed exactly once, at pour time, and pinned: rate_chart_id + rate_chart_version on every MilkPour (domain.RateChart.PricePour, round-to-paise on both rate and amount). Invoice totals are just Σ of pour amounts, and the DCS→Union B2B invoice is Σ of the same amounts with tax 0 (HSN 0401 fresh milk is GST-exempt).","why_it_matters":"A CRM/ERP must never re-derive prices; it must carry rate_chart_version through, and it must model the milk leg as zero-tax. Two distinct invoice numbering schemes exist: INV-<dcsCode>-<date>-<0001> (farmer, counter-backed) and <dcsCode>/<FY>/<idSuffix> (DCS→Union, id-derived, no shared counter).","file":"internal/domain/collection.go"},{"observation":"Consignment lifecycle events that a CRM could hook: consignment.plant_accepted / consignment.plant_rejected carry a clean flat DTO (ConsignmentPlantDecidedEvent{consignment_id, batch_code, dcs_id, plant_id, litres, reason}) with IDs as hex strings, deliberately shaped so subscribers decode structurally.","why_it_matters":"This is the template for any new event a CRM sync should consume — the cattle module's history notes that publishing a raw domain document (whose ID marshals as 'id') broke the SMS subscriber, so flat explicit-key DTOs are the convention.","file":"internal/modules/logistics/models.go"},{"observation":"There is no SSE push and no audit-visible hook from cattle/collection/logistics; cross-module reaction is exclusively the in-process eventbus (modules must never import each other — internal/httpapi/modules.go states this explicitly), and the bus runs each handler on its own goroutine with panic recovery.","why_it_matters":"A CRM module must be a new internal/modules/<name> package registered in RegisterModules with its own collections, reading state via Bus.Subscribe — not by importing collection/logistics.","file":"internal/httpapi/modules.go"},{"observation":"The org hierarchy that everything is scoped by: FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {BMC, PROCESSING_PLANT, STORE} → DCS, with OrgUnit.Path denormalised for containment checks and Code as the human business key ('DCS-01842'). RequireInScope passes SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR unconditionally; plant-tier roles need the sibling-safe requireSameUnion rule instead.","why_it_matters":"CRM territory/account hierarchy maps directly onto org_units; any CRM read endpoint must reuse Orgs.RequireInScope or it will leak across unions.","file":"internal/domain/orgunit.go"}],"gotchas":["Creating a consignment (status OPEN) instantly FREEZES the shift: collection/repo.go shiftConsigned counts any non-REJECTED dcs_consignments doc for (dcs_id, date, shift), so from the moment the sachiv presses 'create' — not 'dispatch' — every further pour is rejected 409 SHIFT_CONSIGNED and every correction 409 POUR_CONSIGNED. Operationally the consignment must be created only after the shift's last pour.","pourIsInvoiced deliberately excludes HOLD invoices ({status: {$ne: HOLD}}), so a pour sitting inside a HOLD invoice can still be superseded — the invoice keeps the stale pour_id and stale totals while a corrected pour exists elsewhere. There is no reconciliation for this.","mergeIntoExistingInvoice does a $inc on total_quantity_litres/total_amount, then re-reads, rounds, and $sets the rounded values. Two concurrent merges can interleave between the $inc and the $set, so the second $set can clobber the first's increment. The status guard only protects against settlement, not against a second generator.","nextInvoiceSeq is incremented BEFORE insertInvoice, so every duplicate-key (racing generator, or a second run in the same day) burns a sequence number — invoice numbers legitimately have gaps.","domain.DCSConsignment.ConsignmentCode is minted as CON-<last4 of dcs code>-<YYMMDD>-<M|E>, but consignmentInvoice.ConsignmentCode is RECOMPUTED by logistics/service.go consignmentCode() as CON-<full org code>-<YYYYMMDD>-<AM|PM> and never reads the stored field. The same consignment therefore prints two different 'codes'.","GET /logistics/consignments/{id}/invoice is routed to consignmentReaders (which includes PLANT_OPERATOR and PLANT_LAB_ANALYST) but getConsignmentInvoice only calls Orgs.RequireInScope(dcs_id) — it lacks the same-union branch that getConsignment has, so plant-tier readers always get 403 there.","approveForUnion writes no provenance event and publishes nothing — the DCS→Union B2B invoice is a bare field stamp on the consignment, invisible to the ledger and to any subscriber. createTrip likewise emits no provenance event; the trip only enters the ledger at first pickup.","Two independent code paths flip a consignment DELIVERED→ACCEPTED: logistics plantAccept (F6, sets accepted_plant_id) and plant/repo.go ClaimConsignments (BMC lot pooling, sets bmc_lot_id). Whichever runs first wins the status guard and the other 409s; nothing coordinates them.","RouteStop.TempC is a plain float64 while pickupRequest.TempC is *float64: when a rider omits the temperature at pickup the stop is written with temp_c = 0.0, indistinguishable from a genuine 0 °C reading — and the same 0.0 goes into the consignment.picked_up ledger payload.","The pour's analyzer_reading_id is stored and used as a provenance 'measured_by' ref but is NEVER validated: no check that the reading exists, belongs to the same DCS, or that its fat/SNF match the pour's. A MANUAL pour can cite an ANALYZER_DIRECT reading id.","GET /collection/readings filters ?date= against created_at (server receipt time, IST day window) while pours filter on pour_date. Late-synced readings therefore land on a different day than the pours they measured.","MVUCaseArrived ('ARRIVED') is a declared status with no endpoint that ever produces it — CloseMVUCase accepts DISPATCHED|ARRIVED but nothing transitions REQUESTED→…→ARRIVED. Dead state.","The cattle module is create-only: there is NO update, delete, or status-transition endpoint for an Animal. Status SOLD/DECEASED, lactation_no, avg_daily_yield_litres, birth_date and updated_at are modelled but unreachable through the API (RegisterAnimalRequest does not even accept birth_date).","Animal reads still have no DPDP consent check — canViewAnimal carries an explicit TODO(consent) and v1 ships the role + org-scope check only, so any in-scope VETERINARIAN / AI_TECH / MISSION_OFFICIAL reads a farmer's animal health PII without an artefact in the consents collection.","POST /cattle/telemetry persists nothing even when the flag is on — it just 202s. SyncBharatPashudhan is a mock that marks events SYNCED against a fabricated 'BP-MOCK-…' ref, so bp_sync_status=SYNCED means nothing left the building.","Cattle's appendLedger is BEST-EFFORT (errors only logged) while collection's and logistics' ledger appends are FATAL (500). Animal/health provenance can therefore be silently missing; pour/consignment provenance cannot.","SUPER_ADMIN bypasses every RequireRoles gate (middleware/rbac.go:32) and RequireInScope (orgscope resolver:199), so a SUPER_ADMIN token reaches DispatchMVUCase with neither vet_party_id nor driver_party_id pinned — the 'break-glass' path documented in the code.","GET /cattle/animals is gated only by RequireSession, so a plain (role-less) session token reaches it; the service compensates by pinning actor.Kind == auth.TokenKindSession to the caller's own herd. Any new list endpoint copying that route gate without the service-side pin would leak the registry.","BatchSyncPours calls the full CreatePour path per item — org scope check, membership query, consignment-freeze count and rate-chart resolution each time — for up to 500 items in one request, with no batching and no request-scoped cache.","pickupStop's batch-code collision retry advances the MINTED MINUTE (mintBatchCode(now + attempt*time.Minute)), so a collided batch_code carries a timestamp that is up to 4 minutes later than the real pickup; after 5 attempts it returns a 500.","logistics repo returns raw wrapped driver errors (not httpx errors) and the service maps only mongo.ErrNoDocuments; a duplicate-key from insertConsignment is caught in the service via mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError, so that error must stay %w-wrapped or the 409 CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS turns into a 500.","dispatchConsignment skips the re-aggregation entirely when the re-query returns zero RECORDED pours (len(rows)==0), leaving the creation-time totals in place while still minting a seal over the stale pour_ids.","Live tracking exposes the van rider's full name and PHONE NUMBER (tripTrack.VanRiderPhone, enrichTrackRider) to every entitled watcher — Sachiv, Adhyaksh, BMC operator, plant operator, auditors — with no consent check.","recordLocation accepts any lat/lng with no plausibility or rate limiting, and writes no ledger entry, so the live position is unauthenticated-quality data relative to the rest of the chain.","deliverTrip computes the consignment set from the in-memory trip read BEFORE the status-guarded update, and markConsignmentsDelivered is an unguarded-count UpdateMany — a consignment that left PICKED_UP in between is silently skipped with no error surfaced.","There is no cron/ticker anywhere in this area (the only tickers in the repo are consumer subscriptions, SSE heartbeat, ratelimit GC and the audit recorder). Invoice generation, consignment creation, dispatch and the SMS worker are all operator-triggered HTTP calls."],"entry_points":[{"path":"internal/modules/cattle/module.go:23","symbol":"cattle.Register","description":"Mounts /cattle under /api/v1; wires repo→service→handler and declares every route's RBAC gate."},{"path":"internal/modules/collection/module.go:24","symbol":"collection.Register","description":"Mounts /collection; package doc lists the two topics published (pour.recorded, invoice.issued)."},{"path":"internal/modules/logistics/module.go:20","symbol":"logistics.Register","description":"Mounts /logistics; the literal /trips/tracking route is registered before /{tripID} so chi matches it literally."},{"path":"internal/httpapi/modules.go:33","symbol":"RegisterModules","description":"Mounts all modules under /api/v1 and states the module contract: modules may import domain and platform but NEVER each other; cross-module reactions go through the event bus."},{"path":"internal/modules/collection/service.go:391","symbol":"(*service).CreatePour","description":"The core procurement entry point: idempotency, membership, plausibility gate, chart resolution, pricing, assurance derivation, provenance, bus, SMS."},{"path":"internal/domain/collection.go:126","symbol":"RateChart.PricePour","description":"The single money computation for the farmer leg: rate = base + fat*fatRate + snf*snfRate, both rate and amount rounded to paise."},{"path":"internal/modules/logistics/service.go:84","symbol":"(*service).createConsignment","description":"The pooling boundary — where a set of pours becomes one traceable consignment."},{"path":"internal/modules/logistics/service.go:650","symbol":"(*service).pickupStop","description":"Chain-of-custody handoff: seal verification plus the atomic per-samiti batch-code mint."},{"path":"internal/modules/collection/service.go:913","symbol":"(*service).GenerateInvoices","description":"Day-close: turns RECORDED pours into per-farmer invoices, including the late-pour merge/skip logic."},{"path":"internal/platform/mongodb/indexes.go:62","symbol":"EnsureIndexes specs map","description":"Authoritative list of collection names and every unique/partial index this area depends on for its concurrency guards."},{"path":"internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go:198","symbol":"(*Resolver).RequireInScope","description":"The scope rule every read/write in this area calls; SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR pass unconditionally."}],"domain_concepts":[{"term":"Pashu Aadhaar","meaning":"The 12-digit national livestock ear-tag ID (Bharat Pashudhan / NDLM). Unique business key on animals; _id stays an ObjectID."},{"term":"DCS / Samiti","meaning":"Dugdh Cooperative Society — the village-level milk collection society, an OrgUnit of type DCS under a MILK_UNION (or under a BMC). Run by the SAMITI_SACHEEV (paid secretary) with a SAMITI_ADHYAKSH (elected chairman)."},{"term":"Pour","meaning":"The atomic procurement unit: one farmer, one can, one shift, at one DCS. Priced at capture time and never edited in place."},{"term":"Shift","meaning":"MORNING or EVENING. Together with pour_date (IST YYYY-MM-DD) it keys the settlement day and the consignment."},{"term":"Parchi","meaning":"The paper slip handed to the farmer at pour time; its photo is stored as parchi_photo_uri — receipt-side evidence alongside the analyzer photo."},{"term":"Assurance A/B/C","meaning":"Capture-quality grade derived from EVIDENCE, not the claim: A = analyzer stream with a device identity, B = retained analyzer-screen photo, C = keyed by hand. Aggregates (consignment) inherit the WEAKEST level in the set."},{"term":"Fat / SNF / CLR","meaning":"Milk composition: fat %, solids-not-fat %, corrected lactometer reading. Fat and SNF drive the price; plausible ranges are fat 2.0–12.0, SNF 7.0–11.5, quantity 0.1–200 L per pour."},{"term":"Rate chart","meaning":"Org-scoped pricing policy (base + per-fat-point + per-SNF-point) with an immutable version string. Resolved to a DCS by walking its ancestor Path — nearest org wins, ties break to the latest effective_from."},{"term":"Consignment","meaning":"A DCS's date+shift pooled into the unit a van picks up. Past this point milk traces to a SET of contributors — the pooling boundary."},{"term":"Seal code","meaning":"SEAL-<consignment id suffix>-<CRC32 checksum over the frozen pour set>, minted at dispatch; the rider verifies it at pickup (anti-swap). Case-insensitive comparison because it is hand-typed."},{"term":"Container code","meaning":"The SHORT sharpie mark on the physical cans (<last 4 digits of the DCS code><M|E>, e.g. '1842M'), minted at creation so cans can be marked before the van arrives."},{"term":"Batch code","meaning":"PARAG-<DDMMYYYY>-<HHMM>-<distinct farmer count>-<samiti ref>, IST, minted by the backend at van pickup. Unique per samiti per pickup (unique partial index) and the key the public QR is later derived from."},{"term":"Route trip","meaning":"One van run for a union+date+shift: PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS (first pickup) → DELIVERED, carrying embedded stops and a cold-chain sample log."},{"term":"Cold chain","meaning":"Timestamped temperature+location samples logged in transit by the rider; temperature at PICKUP is optional (the BMC chills), temperature in the cold-chain log is required, both bounded -30..70 °C."},{"term":"BMC","meaning":"Bulk Milk Cooler / chilling centre — one of the two facility types a trip may deliver to; the other is a PROCESSING_PLANT (the F5 direct-to-plant branch)."},{"term":"MVU / 1962","meaning":"Mobile Veterinary Unit; the in-app 'call 1962' request tracked REQUESTED → DISPATCHED → (ARRIVED) → CLOSED with a visit log and linked health events."},{"term":"HSN 0401","meaning":"The GST tariff heading for fresh milk, which is GST-exempt — the DCS→Union B2B consignment invoice therefore has tax_amount 0 and total == taxable."},{"term":"Provenance seq","meaning":"The ledger sequence number of the latest append for a document, back-stamped onto the document (provenance_seq). A value of 0 on a RECORDED pour signals a half-completed saga that replay heals."},{"term":"Client event ID","meaning":"The device-minted STRING idempotency key on a pour, unique-indexed. They are produced by the collection module and published on eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued with the FULL domain.Invoice as the payload.","why_it_matters":"invoice.issued is an already-published bus topic carrying a complete financial document — the cheapest hook for an ERP invoice sync. The reusable pattern is consumer/dolibarr_sync.go's sync-state collection plus two polling loops.","file":"internal/platform/dolibarr/client.go:114-233; internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go:252-253,304"},{"observation":"Idempotency + sync-state conventions worth copying: (a) unique-index-as-idempotency (payout_instructions.invoice_id, consignment_qc.consignment_id, batch_qrs.qr_code, qc_certificates.certificate_number, consignment_batch_qrs.batch_code); (b) optimistic claim + compensating release (ClaimConsignments/ReleaseConsignments, ClaimBMCLots/ReleaseBMCLots, claimInvoices/releaseInvoices); (c) the execution LEASE (executing_at + executionLease = 2 minutes; claimExecution resumes only a stale lease); (d) counters via FindOneAndUpdate($inc, upsert) for gapless business numbers.","why_it_matters":"These are the house mechanisms for exactly-once-ish behaviour without transactions (the deployment is standalone MongoDB — no sessions/transactions anywhere). A CRM sync should reuse them rather than invent a new one.","file":"internal/modules/settlement/repo.go:201-223; internal/modules/plant/repo.go:184-313,361"},{"observation":"Outbound comms are entirely bus-driven and land in platformops: payout.credited → TemplatePayoutCredited SMS with amount+utr; qc.gate_blocked → SMS to every ACTIVE UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR at the union ancestor; qc.batch_recorded → app notification to SAMITI_SACHEEV + PLANT_OPERATOR; batch.qr_minted → app notification to the sachiv.","why_it_matters":"The existing notification seam. Adding a CRM notification means publishing on the bus and subscribing in platformops — modules never import each other and bus payloads are a JSON-shape contract decoded via decodeBusPayload.","file":"internal/modules/platformops/module.go:109-116; internal/modules/platformops/service.go:638-819"},{"observation":"SSE nudges are bridged in cmd/server/main.go: qc.recorded and qc.gate_blocked → 'quality.changed' (PLANT_LAB_ANALYST, BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_OPERATOR, UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR); payout.credited → 'settlement.changed' (SAMITI_SACHEEV, SAMITI_ADHYAKSH, UNION_PRESIDENT, FARMER). Topics TopicSettlementExecuted and TopicSettlementChanged are DECLARED but never published by anyone.","why_it_matters":"A settlement batch whose payouts all FAIL emits no payout.credited and therefore no live UI update at all. Two dead topic constants will mislead anyone wiring a CRM listener.","file":"cmd/server/main.go:124-137; internal/platform/eventbus/bus.go:24-26"},{"observation":"Identity throughout is party_id (an ObjectID hex string carried in JWT claims and parsed by httpx.ParseID). A CRM contact mapping must anchor on party_id and join to `parties` for phone — and there is no email at all on the farmer/cooperative side.","file":"internal/modules/settlement/repo.go:393-403"},{"observation":"Product lots carry sku/product_name/unit_size/mrp derived from the `products` master, but the consumer/D2C catalog does NOT read product_lots — grep for ProductLot in internal/modules/consumer returns nothing. Rotating QR_SIGNING_SECRET silently re-signs every historical QR; anything caching or externally mirroring token values will drift.","file":"internal/modules/consumer/qrresign.go:34-131; internal/modules/consumer/module.go:51"},{"observation":"QR_SIGNING_SECRET falls back to JWTSecret + \":qr\" when the env var is unset, with no production guard.","why_it_matters":"In any environment where QR_SIGNING_SECRET is not set, forging a product QR or a batch QR token reduces to knowing the JWT secret — the same secret that mints auth tokens.","file":"internal/config/config.go:82,109-110"},{"observation":"platformops.controlTowerStats aggregates the financial figures a CRM dashboard would want: PendingInvoices (ISSUED|SETTLEMENT_PENDING|HOLD), BlockedQCSubjects, OpenBatches, FailedBatches30d and SettledAmount30d (Σ total_amount over EXECUTED batches only).","why_it_matters":"An existing aggregate surface to reuse rather than re-derive — but note SettledAmount30d silently excludes PARTIAL batches, so it under-reports actually-disbursed money.","file":"internal/modules/platformops/repo.go:490-573"}],"gotchas":["ConsignmentStatusAccepted ('ACCEPTED') is overloaded by two different flows. plant.ClaimConsignments flips DELIVERED→ACCEPTED to pool a consignment into a BMC lot (internal/modules/plant/repo.go:184), while logistics.plantAccept flips DELIVERED→ACCEPTED for F6 plant intake and stamps accepted_plant_id (internal/modules/logistics/service.go:996). The F7 batch queue (listAcceptedPendingQC) filters on status ACCEPTED + a batch_code + untested — so a consignment merely pooled into a BMC lot appears in the PLANT_LAB_ANALYST's batch-QC queue with no accepted_plant_id, and the resulting qc.batch_recorded event publishes PlantID:\"\" so the plant operator is never notified. The domain constant's own comment says 'pooled into a BMC lot', contradicting the F6 usage.","The system runs on a STANDALONE MongoDB — no sessions, no transactions anywhere in the repo. Every multi-document mutation is an optimistic status-guarded UpdateOne/UpdateMany plus a hand-written compensating action. A crash between halves leaves recoverable-but-inconsistent state by design (the stated rule: extra auditable evidence is acceptable, a dangling status flip is not).","In quality.recordQCResult the mandatory-test check is guarded by `len(missing) > 0 && overallPass`, but overallPass has ALREADY been set to false when a HOLD was requested. A HOLD can therefore be recorded with zero mandatory tests on file. resolveQCResult re-checks them before a PASS resolution so the gate ultimately holds, but the ordering is subtle and reads the opposite way.","The plant's WRONG_DELIVERY_BMC integrity check silently SKIPS any consignment whose route_trip_id is nil ('no trip recorded — cannot attribute a destination'). A consignment that never went through the trip flow can be pooled at ANY BMC.","There are TWO unrelated 'certificate' concepts. (1) QCResult.certificate_number, minted inline on a PASS as 'QC-<STAGE>-%06d' from counters key 'qc_certificate:<stage>' — this is what publictrace exposes to consumers via latestPlantLabPass. (2) The qc_certificates collection with certificate_number 'QCC-%06d' from counters key 'qc_certificate:BATCH_CERT' — a separate, manually-issued document that the consumer QR scan NEVER reads. GET /plant/batches/{id} enriches only (2).","quality.issueCertificate appends a provenance event with the STRING LITERALS \"qc.certificate_issued\" and \"QC_CERTIFICATE\" — neither is declared in internal/domain/provenance_events.go, unlike every other event type in the codebase. Trace consumers switching on the domain constants will miss it.","The qc_certificates.batch_id index is deliberately NON-unique (indexes.go:236-243). One-cert-per-batch is enforced only by an application-level findCertificateByBatch check before insert — a check-then-act race: two concurrent issues can both pass the check and both insert, and since each draws a different certificate_number from the counter, the unique certificate_number index will not catch it.","F7 batch QC is a MOCK panel: the analyst supplies the pass/fail verdict per parameter themselves. The ONLY server-side override is AFLATOXIN_M1 above 0.5 µg/kg, and only when a numeric value was supplied — a null value with pass:true sails through. Contrast with the real gate in domain.EvaluateQCTests, which computes every verdict server-side. The two pipelines share almost no code.","BatchQCTest.Value is a *float64 so pass/fail-only parameters (ADULTERANTS, ANTIBIOTICS) can omit a reading, but validateBatchQCRequest never REQUIRES a value for the numeric parameters (AFLATOXIN_M1, ADDED_WATER, FAT_PCT, SNF_PCT) either.","recordBatchQC discards the matched flag from stampConsignmentQCVerdict (`if _, err := ...`). If the consignment left ACCEPTED between the load and the stamp, the QC document, the ledger event, the bus notifications and the minted QR all still happen while the consignment carries no verdict at all.","settlement.Reject appends NO provenance ledger event, unlike Initiate/Approve/Execute. A rejected batch is invisible on the tamper-evident chain.","repo.markInvoicesPaid (internal/modules/settlement/repo.go:127) is DEAD CODE — only markInvoicesPaidByIDs is called. If ever wired up it would mark every invoice in a batch PAID, including ones whose payout FAILED for want of a verified bank account.","platformops.sumSettledAmount only sums batches with status EXECUTED, so a PARTIAL batch's genuinely disbursed money is excluded from the control-tower 'settled in the last 30 days' figure.","eventbus.TopicSettlementExecuted and TopicSettlementChanged are declared but never published anywhere in the repo. The SSE 'settlement.changed' nudge is driven exclusively off payout.credited, so a wholly-failed batch produces no live update.","validateApproval checks dual control BEFORE status, deliberately — the unit test pins that even a SUPER_ADMIN initiator on an already-APPROVED batch gets 403 DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION rather than 409. Do not 'fix' the ordering.","No verified bank account is a SOFT failure, not a hard one: the payout is recorded FAILED with no UTR, the invoice is NOT marked PAID, and the batch ends PARTIAL and re-executable. latestBankMasked deliberately ignores PENDING/REJECTED KYC — only reviewer-approved evidence authorises money.","plant.ListBatches enforces org scope ONLY when plant_id is supplied. Likewise SettlementStatusInitiated is never persisted — Initiate writes PENDING_APPROVAL. It does not; the only subscriber is platformops.","httpx.ParsePage defaults to limit 50, caps at 200, offset 0. Every list endpoint in these modules uses it except the qc-queue and batch-queue endpoints noted above.","orgscope.RequireInScope auto-passes SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR before any ancestry check — so every 'scope-checked' read in this area is federation-wide for those two roles by design."],"domain_concepts":[{"term":"BMC lot","meaning":"Bulk-Milk-Cooler lot: the pooled set of DELIVERED consignments chilled at one BMC for a given date+shift. First gate subject. Read-time synthesised handle silo_lot_code = LOT-<YYYYMMDD>-<M|E>-<last 6 of id>."},{"term":"Processing batch","meaning":"One production run at a plant pooling DISPATCHED BMC lots. Business key batch_number = BATCH-<plant org code>-<YYYYMMDD>-<0000 seq>, printed on packs."},{"term":"Product lot","meaning":"A packaged SKU output of a COMPLETED batch, carrying Legal Metrology net quantity (unit_size), MRP, mfg_date and expiry_date."},{"term":"Safety gate (§8.3)","meaning":"The rule that no lot or batch may advance without a passing QC verdict, enforced at EVERY hop belt-and-braces because Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation. Refusals all carry the stable error code SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED."},{"term":"QC verdict machine (§13.5)","meaning":"SAMPLED→HOLD→PASS/REJECT. HOLD quarantines pending analyst resolution and is distinct from a terminal REJECT. A panel with a hard FSSAI failure can NEVER be softened to HOLD. Legacy documents without a verdict field derive one from overall_pass via domain.EffectiveQCVerdict."},{"term":"Superseded QC result","meaning":"A result that lost the conditional gate race — the subject's verdict came from a different, earlier result. Marked superseded:true rather than deleted so the evidence stays auditable, and excluded from recordedTestNames."},{"term":"Honest set-valued pooling (§7.4)","meaning":"Past the consignment boundary milk no longer traces to a single farmer or society, so a batch stores the DISTINCT SET of contributing DCS ids (contributing_dcs_ids), materialised at creation. The consumer trace says 'made from N samitis' — never per-farmer data."},{"term":"Per-samiti batch / batch_code (F7)","meaning":"The pickup-time identity minted by logistics: PARAG-<DDMMYYYY>-<HHMM>-<farmer count>-<samiti ref>, IST. It is the unit of the F7 QC pipeline and becomes the public QR code itself."},{"term":"Stage×role pairing","meaning":"BMC_RAPID results may only be recorded by BMC_OPERATOR; PLANT_LAB results only by PLANT_LAB_ANALYST. RequireRoles admits both; the exact pairing is enforced in the service (403 STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH). SUPER_ADMIN is additionally permitted on resolve, but not on record."},{"term":"Mandatory tests","meaning":"BMC_RAPID must measure {AFLATOXIN_M1, COLIFORM}; PLANT_LAB must additionally measure PHOSPHATASE (the pasteurisation proof). A PASS without them is 422 MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS; a FAIL on a partial panel is still recorded as a block — quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative."},{"term":"Dual control (§8.1/§18-B)","meaning":"Saathi computes and initiates; a DIFFERENT authorised human approves (initiator party id ≠ approver party id, checked before status); a licensed Payment Aggregator executes. Money never moves autonomously."},{"term":"Execution lease","meaning":"executing_at, stamped on the APPROVED→EXECUTING claim. A batch stuck EXECUTING longer than executionLease (2 minutes) may be resumed by another executor; a fresher lease blocks the steal."},{"term":"DBT / PFMS rail","meaning":"Scheme subsidy money routed to an Aadhaar-linked beneficiary account via PFMS, strictly separate from the milk-payment rail. Saathi only tracks status — it never disburses subsidies itself."},{"term":"Trace-back","meaning":"The root-cause tool for a (typically failed) batch: contributing societies enriched from the org directory with weighted volume_litres / volume_share (0..1) / pour_count / earliest collected_on, plus every QC result. An unresolvable society is still listed with resolved:false so the trace never silently drops a contributor."},{"term":"DateKeyIST","meaning":"domain.DateKeyIST formats a UTC time as the YYYY-MM-DD business-day key in IST (UTC+5:30). Every date default across these modules goes through it."},{"term":"Effective verdict","meaning":"domain.EffectiveQCVerdict(stored, overallPass) — returns the stored PASS|HOLD|REJECT, or derives PASS/REJECT from the legacy two-state overall_pass for documents written before HOLD existed. Only FARMER is forced to self; a SAMITI_SACHEEV, SAMITI_ADHYAKSH, UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR or UNION_PRESIDENT can read ANY farmer's summary (litres, amounts, pending invoice totals, animal count, assigned Sachiv) at any DCS in the federation. The code comment at internal/modules/dashboards/service.go:28-32 acknowledges the gap ('the farmer's DCS isn't on the summary'). The society route DOES call Orgs.RequireInScope.","GET /api/v1/uploads/view/* requires only an authenticated session — there is no per-object ownership or role check. Any logged-in party who learns a file name can fetch any file in the bucket, including KYC evidence and other people's profile photos. The only protection is the 32-hex random name. There is also no delete or list route.","GET /api/v1/public/qr/{qr_code} returns two structurally different JSON bodies from one route: *BatchQualityReport (F8, batch_code/samiti/collection/volume/quality/farmers/van/plant) when the code hits consignment_batch_qrs, otherwise *QRScanResponse (product/batch_number/plant/quality/sourcing/ledger/scan_count/recalled). ResolvePublicQR is typed `any`. Clients must discriminate on fields.","The per-samiti batch farmer roster (BatchQualityReport.Farmers.Roster) has NO public_consent filter — repo.partiesByIDs loads every contributing farmer by name and village, unlike the pooled product roster which hard-filters public_consent==true. batchreport.go:175-178 documents this as a deliberate owner decision, but it is a DPDP tension: a farmer who declined public naming is still named on a batch-code scan of an unauthenticated public endpoint.","classifyBatchQRScan makes a full batch-code scan ALWAYS serve — a stored-token mismatch only emits a drift WARN. Only short-token (/t/-style) scans are actually rejected with 409. UsableAt(t) = status ACTIVE AND t >= valid_from AND (valid_to nil OR t <= valid_to). Notification fan-out and the support view both filter on it."},{"term":"Samiti / DCS","meaning":"Dairy Cooperative Society — the village-level collection society. The honest public provenance grain: pooled milk traces to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers."},{"term":"Sachiv (SAMITI_SACHEEV)","meaning":"The paid DCS secretary who runs the collection console (UPCS Act §31). Governance caps how many a single DCS may appoint via the app_settings sachiv_cap knob (default 2)."},{"term":"Sachiv cap 'Appointed'","meaning":"NOT a federation-wide total — it is the tightest per-DCS occupancy, i.e. the count of ACTIVE SAMITI_SACHEEV at the single busiest org unit, computed by a $group/$sort/$limit-1 aggregation. The cap can be raised freely but never set below it (409 CAP_BELOW_APPOINTED)."},{"term":"Provenance ledger","meaning":"An append-only sha256 hash chain in provenance_events. Every event carries seq (globally unique), prev_hash and hash over prev_hash|seq|type|entity_type|entity_id|refs|actor|org_unit_id|json(payload)|ts(ms). Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded one; nothing is edited in place."},{"term":"Trace upstream vs downstream","meaning":"Upstream = recursive ref walk (what an entity was made from), via Ledger.Trace/TraceStopAt. Downstream = reverse lookup on refs.entity_id (what it went into), via DownstreamRefs. §8.3 recall: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs."},{"term":"Pooling boundary","meaning":"The consumer QR scan stops expanding at DCS_CONSIGNMENT entities — their events are included but their refs (hundreds of per-pour nodes, cross-route trip fan-out) are never followed."},{"term":"public_consent (§6.7)","meaning":"A DPDP opt-in on Party. On the POOLED product scan, non-consenting contributors are counted in farmers_total but never named; only public_consent==true parties enter farmers_public (capped at 200). The per-samiti BATCH report does not apply this filter."},{"term":"Batch code vs product QR code","meaning":"Per-samiti batch codes look like 'PARAG-11072026-2000-3-01842'; product-lot QR codes look like '[REDACTED:generic-api-key]'. The two namespaces never collide, which is what lets one public route dispatch between them."},{"term":"Signed token (two shapes)","meaning":"Product-lot QRs store 'base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id_hex|issued_unix).hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload))'. Consignment batch QRs store just HMAC(secret, batch_code)[:8]."},{"term":"CMS delta pull / version cursor","meaning":"Every content write mints the next value of a single global counter (counters/_id=cms_content_version). The app pulls items with version > its last cursor; max_version is the new cursor and truncated:true means pull again immediately."},{"term":"Region scope vs region ref","meaning":"region_scope is the org TIER a content item targets (state|district|society|all, 'all' = shown everywhere). region_ref is an optional ObjectID pin to a specific org unit — validated for author scope on write but never used as a read filter."},{"term":"Outbox pattern","meaning":"Write the message locally (notifications, status QUEUED), let a provider worker send it later. APP-channel rows bypass this: they are inserted already SENT because the in-app inbox IS the insert."},{"term":"IST day key","meaning":"domain.DateKeyIST formats a time in a fixed UTC+5:30 zone as YYYY-MM-DD. It is the partition key for milk_pours.pour_date and dcs_consignments.date, and drives every dashboard/adminStats 'today' figure."},{"term":"Control tower","meaning":"The GET /admin/stats read-only platform snapshot (blueprint §12) — every figure is a CountDocuments except today_litres and settled_amount_30d, which are bounded $group aggregations."},{"term":"GIGW/DPDP immutable audit export","meaning":"GET /audit/logs/export — a capped (5000-row) JSON attachment over the insert-only audit_logs collection. GET /consumer/catalog folds those rows into one app-key-gated response (`overrides` map + `additions` list + `version`) that the PARAG consumer app merges onto — or, with CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE=true, replaces — its bundled product list. The same rows are the server's money authority: catalog_price.go builds a (sku, variant) → price index that orders and subscriptions bill from, closing the old \"client-supplied ₹0 price\" hole. Product art lives in a private Backblaze B2 bucket and in the Dolibarr document store and is served through two public, prefix-scoped proxies so `<Image uri>` can load it with no auth header.","http_routes":[{"method":"GET","path":"/api/v1/consumer/catalog","purpose":"Consumer-facing catalog overlay: {overrides:{skuId:{price,in_stock,hidden,mrp}}, additions:[additionView], version:<max updated_at ms>}. handler.getCatalog → service.consumerCatalog → repository.catalogView(serveSeeded).","auth":"public route hard-gated by service.appKeyOK — header X-Parag-App-Key must constant-time match env CONSUMER_APP_KEY. Echoes storeAdditionView for kind=addition, else storeOverrideView.","auth":"Authenticate + RequireRoles(STORE_MANAGER) + assertStore"},{"method":"DELETE","path":"/api/v1/consumer/stores/{storeId}/skus/{skuId}","purpose":"?variantId= (or ?variant_id=) → $pull that one variant, base survives (404 if ModifiedCount==0). Non-blocking; concurrent kicks coalesce into one follow-up pass.","auth":"token: ?token= or X-Webhook-Token must equal DOLIBARR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN, falling back to DOLIBARR_API_KEY when that env is unset; both empty → 403"},{"method":"GET","path":"/api/v1/consumer/dolibarr/webhook","purpose":"Same handler as the POST — exists so the COO can force a catalog refresh from a browser bookmark.","auth":"same token gate"}],"key_flows":[{"name":"Assembling a consumer catalog entry (repository.catalogView)","trigger":"GET /consumer/catalog after the X-Parag-App-Key gate","steps":["catalog.Find(ctx, bson.D{}) with NO store filter — every row across every store — sorted updated_at ASCENDING (oldest→newest) so a later write wins on any cross-store sku collision (internal/modules/consumer/catalog.go:785).","Pass 1: build ovBySku — for every doc whose Kind is neither 'addition' nor 'product' (kind=override, or a kind-less legacy row), ovBySku[sku_id]=doc. Oldest→newest ordering means the newest override for a sku wins.","Pass 2 per doc: if Kind=='product' && !serveSeeded → `continue` BEFORE the version stamp, so with the flag off the response is byte-identical to the old overlay-only behaviour and Version stays 0 on a fresh DB.","Stamp maxT = max(updated_at) over every doc that survived the skip; Version = maxT.UnixMilli().","For Kind 'addition' or 'product': drop it if its own hidden==true, OR if its override row's hidden==true — a hidden SKU surfaces nowhere.","FOLD the override into the served entry (the key rule, added because a bare {price} override alongside a rich served entry made the app's first-patch-wins-per-sku merge REPLACE the entry and drop SKUs the app doesn't bundle — the withheld PYAAS cards vanished exactly this way): ov.Price→d.Price, ov.MRP→d.MRP, ov.InStock→d.InStock; consumed[sku]=true. Name/category/photo are never folded — an override cannot carry them.","Project via additionViewFromDoc: id=sku_id, baseId, name, category, variant, description, subscribable (nil → true only when category=='milk', see subscribableOrDairyDefault), price=valOrZero(d.Price), photo_url, in_stock = (d.InStock==nil || *d.InStock), variants[], physical{}, mrp, unit, tag, rating, ratingCount, mostOrdered, packCount, back_photo_url, compliance{}. stock_count is deliberately NOT in additionView.","Pass 3: every ovBySku entry not consumed becomes resp.Overrides[sku] = {price, in_stock, hidden, mrp} — all pointer-optional, so an unset key is simply absent and the app keeps its bundled value.","Net invariant: each sku id appears EXACTLY ONCE in the response — either as an additions[] entry with its override folded in, or as an overrides{} key."],"side_effects":"none — pure read. No events, no SSE, no notifications; the consumer module never touches d.Bus or d.SSE."},{"name":"Boot seeding of the 48 baseline products","trigger":"consumer.Register at process start (module.go:41), after repo.ensureIndexes","steps":["products_seed.json (48 rows, generated from the consumer app's constants/products.ts via the TS compiler so there is one source of truth) is go:embed'd into embeddedProductsSeed.","repository.seedConsumerProducts unmarshals into []seedProduct and builds one UpdateOneModel per product with filter {store_id:'_global', sku_id:<id>}, upsert=true.","$set (re-applied every boot, so the app's catalog is authoritative): name, category, variant, description, subscribable, price, in_stock = !out_of_stock, unit, tag, base_id, most_ordered, image_asset, back_image_asset, compliance, seed_version=1, updated_by='seed', updated_at=seedProductStamp (FIXED 2026-08-08T00:00:00Z, not time.Now(), so re-seeding identical data never churns the catalog cache Version). mrp/rating/rating_count/pack_count appended only when non-nil.","photo_url = catalogImagePath(image_asset) = 'catalog/img/<file>'; back_photo_url likewise, only when back_image_asset is set (18 of 48).","$setOnInsert (never overwritten by a re-seed): kind='product', stock_count=50 (defaultSeedStock), created_at=seedProductStamp.","Executed as ONE unordered BulkWrite — 48 sequential upserts blew the boot deadline against remote Atlas. Unordered so one bad row cannot abort the rest.","Failure is logged and swallowed (non-fatal, 60s own timeout) — unlike the wallet money-gate indexes, which panic the process."],"side_effects":"48 upserts into consumer_catalog and nothing else"},{"name":"Server-authoritative pricing for orders and subscriptions","trigger":"POST /consumer/orders (orders.go:252) and POST /consumer/subscriptions (subscriptions.go:349)","steps":["service.loadPriceIndex does catalog.Find(ctx, bson.D{}) sorted updated_at ASC — a full collection scan per order/subscription creation (comment says ~109 rows today).","buildPriceIndex folds rows oldest→newest into four maps: base[sku]→price, names[sku]→exact catalog name, variants[sku][lowercased variantId AND lowercased label]→price (variants with price 0 skipped), hidden[sku]→bool. kind=product and kind=addition contribute price+name+hidden+variants; kind=override contributes price+hidden ONLY (an override can never rename a product or add variants).","priceFor(productID, variant): hidden → (0,false) not sellable. A non-empty variant hits variants[productID][lower(variant)] first; a variant LABEL with no own price falls through to base. base miss OR base price <= 0 → (0,false).","createOrder: qty must be 1..maxQtyPerProduct(10); price := priceIx.priceFor(ProductID, Variant), !ok → 400 'unknown product in order: <id>'. Line name := priceIx.nameFor(ProductID), falling back to the client label only when the catalog row has no name. subtotal += price*qty; total units capped at maxItemsPerOrder(30). fee = deliveryFeeFor(subtotal) — ₹15 unless subtotal >= freeDeliveryOver(₹199) or subtotal == 0. total = round2(subtotal+fee). The client-sent total and per-line prices are ignored entirely.","createSubscription: unitPrice := priceIx.priceFor(ProductID, Variant); !ok → 400 'unknown product'. Stored as round2(unitPrice) on the subscription doc."],"side_effects":"none in the pricing step itself; the resulting order/subscription drives delivery and the wallet settle path"},{"name":"Dolibarr ERP → catalog mirror (inbound)","trigger":"service.dolibarrCatalogLoop — 15s boot delay, then every Cfg.DolibarrSyncEvery (20s at HEAD) or immediately on a webhook/manual KickDolibarrSync","steps":["cli.ListSellableProducts; each ref must match ^(?:PRG|PYS)-[A-Z0-9-]+$ or it is skipped as a legacy/test row (Parag_Gold, Full_Cream_Milk_FCM, … can never duplicate a product in the app).","price = dolibarrEffectivePrice = price_ttc × (1 + gst/100), where gst is tva_tx or the numeric suffix of default_vat_code ('C+S-5' → 5); values within 2 paise of a whole rupee snap to it (ERP stores 8 decimals ex-GST). price<=0 or empty label → skipped.","ref in the CURATED dolibarrRefToSeedSku (36 hand-verified pairs) → syncBaselinePrice: mirrors ERP stock_reel into the seeded row's stock_count via setSeededStockCount, then upsertOverride(DolibarrStoreID, seedSku, {price, mrp}) — price and MRP ONLY; the seeded name/photo/category belong to the app. MRP = dolibarrEffectiveMin (price_min under the same GST rule); if mrp < price it is written as an explicit 0, which CLEARS a stale bundled strikethrough.","otherwise → syncAddition: sku = 'dol-' + lower(ref). dolibarrSplitLabel splits the ERP label on a trailing pack size ('Parag Dahi (Sada) 80 GM' → name 'Parag Dahi (Sada)', variant '80 GM') so the app groups sizes onto one card instead of rendering a look-alike card per size. FIRST sight inserts kind=addition with in_stock=FALSE (pilot rule: visible immediately, unbuyable until the store manager flips the switch), subscribable=false, category from dolibarrCategoryBySegment, physical.volume_ml, stock_count = ERP on-hand, mrp only when price_min >= price. Later passes patchExisting ONLY the ERP-owned fields (name/variant/unit/description/price/stock_count/mrp/photos) — never in_stock.","Photos: full document sweeps run only on pass 1 and every 15th pass (dolibarrPhotoSweepEvery) because they cost ~72 extra ERP calls. First image attachment = front cover, second = back. An ERP image always wins; a photo already on the row (manager-set) is respected; only a photo-less card falls back to seeded family art via dolibarrFallbackSeedSku, and that fallback is PRG-* gated so a PYS house-brand card never wears a Parag pack shot.","Reaping: any ref in the dolibarr_sync state collection not seen this pass → additions get hidden=true, baseline-mapped seeded SKUs get an in_stock=false override; hidden_by_sync=true is stamped. When the ERP puts them back on sale, syncBaselinePrice/syncAddition restore in_stock / unhide.","Change detection is against the dolibarr_sync state row (_id=ref, mode/price/mrp/name/photo_url/stock/schema_v); a schema_v below dolibarrSyncSchemaV(4) forces one re-patch, so schema migrations ship with the code with no manual DB edits."],"side_effects":"writes consumer_catalog rows (kind=override and kind=addition under DOLIBARR_STORE_ID, stock_count on kind=product under _global) plus bookkeeping rows in the dolibarr_sync collection; log lines only, no events"},{"name":"Store-console stock read and low-stock alerting","trigger":"GET /consumer/stores/{id}/stock (console polls ~12s), then POST /consumer/stores/{id}/low-stock","steps":["service.storeStock asserts store ownership, reads repository.seededStock (store_id='_global', kind='product', sorted category asc then name asc) and repository.listOverridesAndAdditions(storeID).","Builds ovStock from this store's non-addition rows carrying in_stock, then for each seeded product uses effectiveInStock(sku, seededFlag, ovStock) — a store override beats the seeded flag; a nil seeded flag means in stock.","stock_count is taken as-is (GLOBAL — there is no per-store stock_count override). total_stock accumulates count only for effectively in-stock rows.","Non-hidden store additions (manager-added AND Dolibarr-synced) are appended with their own in_stock and stock_count, so an ERP-sourced product is visible in inventory and not missed by the low-stock derivation.","Items are stable-sorted in-stock-first, preserving the seeded category/name order within each group.","The DERIVATION of 'what is low' happens entirely in the Saathi store console front end (referenced as deriveStock in a catalog_price.go comment; no such function exists in this repo). The console reconciles inventory rows against order lines BY PRODUCT NAME — which is why catalogPriceIndex.nameFor stores the EXACT catalog name with no variant concatenation, and why mutating names would orphan sold/held counts.","The console POSTs {store_name, summary, item_count}; repository.raiseLowStock resolves adminRecipients (distinct ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN / PCDF_ADMIN party_ids from role_assignments, limit 50, joined to parties for phone) and upserts one notification per admin: template_key=STORE_LOW_STOCK, channel=APP (in-app inbox only, never SMS), language='hi', status=QUEUED, read_at=nil, params={store_id, store, summary, item_count}. Empty summary or item_count==0 → DeleteMany, clearing the alert."],"side_effects":"upserts/deletes rows in the shared `notifications` collection, surfaced on GET /notifications/me for platform admins"},{"name":"Product image resolution end to end","trigger":"App renders a card whose photo_url is a relative path","steps":["Catalog rows never carry absolute URLs. The FE joins these onto its API base.","Seeded path → GET /consumer/catalog/img/<asset>. b2DownloadClient authorizes against api.backblazeb2.com (account token cached 20h of a 24h life), resolves the bucket id via b2_list_buckets, then mints a b2_get_download_authorization scoped to fileNamePrefix 'catalog/' with validDurationInSeconds=86400 (cached 20h). signedURL builds '<downloadUrl>/file/<bucket>/catalog/<name>?Authorization=<prefixToken>' and the handler 302s to it.","Why the proxy exists: the bucket stays allPrivate because it also holds KYC/field photos; a signed URL baked into the seed would expire (B2 download auth ≤ 7 days); and <Image source={{uri}}> sends no auth header. The prefix-scoped token is safe in a client-facing URL — it can read product art and nothing else.","ERP path → GET /consumer/catalog/dolimg/<folder>/<file>, which STREAMS the bytes (not a redirect) through the 64-entry/24h dolibarrImages cache with MIME guessed from the extension (.png→image/png, .webp→image/webp, else image/jpeg).","Fallback chain for an ERP addition with no image: ERP attachment → photo already on the row (manager-set wins forever) → seeded family art from dolibarrFallbackSeedSku (PRG-* only) → empty, and the app renders its clean name-card."],"side_effects":"none; both proxies are read-only"}],"data_stores":[{"name":"consumer_catalog","kind":"mongo","purpose":"THE catalog collection (constant collCatalog in models.go). Holds all three row kinds in one namespace: kind='product' (48 seeded baseline SKUs, store_id='_global'), kind='override' (per-store price/in_stock/hidden/mrp overlay on any sku), kind='addition' (store-added or Dolibarr-mirrored SKUs with variants[] and physical{}).","key_fields":["_id","store_id","sku_id","kind","price","in_stock","hidden","name","category","variant","description","subscribable","photo_url","base_id","variants[] {variant_id,label,price,image_url,out_of_stock,volume_ml,unit,attributes}","physical {volume_ml,weight_g,dimensions}","mrp","unit","tag","rating","rating_count","most_ordered","pack_count","back_photo_url","image_asset","back_image_asset","compliance {hsn,gst_rate,net_quantity,veg,ingredients,nutrition,allergens,shelf_life,storage,country_of_origin,fssai_license,manufacturer,manufacturer_address}","stock_count","seed_version","updated_by","updated_at","created_at"],"indexes":"exactly one, from repository.ensureCatalogIndexes: UNIQUE compound {store_id:1, sku_id:1}. That pair IS the overlay's identity — it makes upsertOverride idempotent and makes insertAddition collide (409 SKU_EXISTS) on a duplicate. There is NO index on updated_at, kind, or category, yet catalogView and loadPriceIndex both sort the whole collection by updated_at."},{"name":"dolibarr_sync","kind":"mongo","purpose":"One bookkeeping row per ERP ref driving change detection and the off-sale reaper for the catalog mirror (constant collDolibarrSync).","key_fields":["_id (the ERP ref, e.g. PRG-TONED-500ML)","dolibarr_id","sku_id","mode ('baseline'|'addition')","price","mrp","name","photo_url","hidden_by_sync","stock","schema_v","updated_at"],"indexes":"none created by this module (_id only)"},{"name":"notifications","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Shared operator inbox collection; the low-stock path upserts/deletes STORE_LOW_STOCK rows here, one per platform admin, keyed on (party_id, template_key, params.store_id).","key_fields":["party_id","phone","channel ('APP')","template_key ('STORE_LOW_STOCK')","language ('hi')","params {store_id, store, summary, item_count}","status ('QUEUED')","queued_at","read_at"],"indexes":"owned by internal/platform/mongodb/indexes.go, not by this module"},{"name":"role_assignments / parties / org_units","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Read-only operator identity used by this area: storeForActor resolves the actor's ACTIVE STORE_MANAGER assignment's org_unit_id (the store id) for assertStore; adminRecipients resolves ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN/PCDF_ADMIN party ids (limit 50) and joins parties for phone.","key_fields":["party_id","role_code","status ('ACTIVE')","org_unit_id","phone"],"indexes":"shared platform indexes"},{"name":"b2DownloadClient token cache","kind":"memory","purpose":"Per-process, mutex-guarded cache of the B2 account authorization + bucket id (refreshed at 20h of a 24h life) and the catalog/-prefix-scoped download token (24h life, refreshed at 20h). Re-authorizing clears prefixTok so a stale prefix token cannot outlive its account auth.","key_fields":["apiURL","dlURL","token","authAt","bucketID","prefixTok","prefixAt"]},{"name":"dolibarrImages (package-level var)","kind":"memory","purpose":"Bounded ERP image byte cache behind /catalog/dolimg/*: max 64 entries, 24h TTL, O(n) evict-oldest on insert. Process-local, so N replicas each hold their own copy.","key_fields":["key '<folder>/<file>'","data []byte","mime","at"]},{"name":"products_seed.json","kind":"file","purpose":"go:embed'd 48-product seed generated from the consumer app's constants/products.ts. Regenerate AND bump seedProductVersion whenever the app catalog changes.","key_fields":["id","name","variant","base_id (null on all 48)","category","price","mrp (set on only 2 rows)","unit","tag","description","subscribable","rating","rating_count","most_ordered","pack_count","out_of_stock","image_asset","back_image_asset","compliance{}"]}],"domain_concepts":[{"term":"overlay","meaning":"The store-manager-owned layer over the app's shipped baseline. It NEVER replaces the baseline — an empty overlay leaves the app's own product list untouched, so a catalog read failure degrades gracefully."},{"term":"kind=product","meaning":"A seeded, store-agnostic baseline product under store_id='_global'. Inert (skipped entirely by catalogView) unless CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE=true; when served it projects exactly like an addition."},{"term":"kind=override","meaning":"A per-store patch on any sku id carrying only price / in_stock / hidden / mrp. Cannot rename, recategorise, re-photo, or add variants to a product."},{"term":"kind=addition","meaning":"A store-added base product with full identity (name/category/variant/photo), optional variants[] (sizes/packs each with their own price/photo/stock) and a physical{} envelope. Also the shape the Dolibarr mirror writes."},{"term":"base + variant","meaning":"A base product may be priced by its own top-level price OR entirely by its variants[]. A variant is looked up by variant_id or by (lowercased, trimmed) label; a variant label with no price of its own falls through to the base price."},{"term":"effective in_stock","meaning":"effectiveInStock(id, seededFlag, storeOverrides): a per-store override wins over the seeded default; a nil seeded flag means in stock. Used only for the store console's sorting and totals, never for the consumer response."},{"term":"MRP","meaning":"Strikethrough price, mirrored from the ERP's price_min under the same GST rule as the selling price. An explicit 0 is meaningful: it CLEARS a stale bundled strikethrough so an ERP price hike can never render under an out-of-date MRP."},{"term":"stock_count","meaning":"On-hand inventory number. STORE-CONSOLE-ONLY — deliberately absent from additionView and the consumer catalog; an integration test asserts the served JSON contains neither 'stock_count' nor 'stockCount'."},{"term":"in_stock vs stock_count","meaning":"Deliberately separated: the COUNT is ledger/ERP truth (mirrored from Dolibarr stock_reel), the in/out-of-stock SWITCH belongs to the store manager and the sync never touches it for additions."},{"term":"compliance block","meaning":"Per-SKU FSSAI / Legal Metrology / GST envelope (hsn, gstRate, netQuantity, veg, ingredients, nutrition, allergens, shelfLife, storage, countryOfOrigin, fssaiLicense, manufacturer, manufacturerAddress) resolved at seed-extract time from the app's category helpers plus per-SKU overrides. Surfaced on the product page and the invoice. Fresh milk is HSN 0401 at gstRate 0; paneer/khoya/sweets are HSN 0406 at 5."},{"term":"seeded product families","meaning":"48 SKUs across 12 categories: milk 10 (Taaza toned 500ml/1L, Gold full-cream 500ml/1L, Shakti standardised 500ml/1L, plus the PYAAS house brand — A2 1L carton ₹139/MRP ₹169, A2 500ml pouch, Toned 1L carton ₹66/MRP ₹79, Toned 500ml pouch), sweets 10 (besan ladoo, chhena kheer, peda, milk cake, rasgolla 200g/500g, gulab jamun 200g/500g, rice kheer, shri khand), dahi 8 (sweet 90g/200g cups, plain 90g/200g/400g pouches, plain PP 400g, low-fat 5kg/15kg buckets), ghee 5 (poly 200ml/500ml/1L, sika 500ml/1L), paneer 3 (1kg, vacuum 100g/200g), khoya 3 (250g/500g/1kg), butter 2 (100g/500g), mattha 2 (plain, masala), lassi 2 (200g, 160ml cup), super_tea 1 (Chai Special), chaach 1, flavoured_milk 1. Exactly 2 carry an MRP; 18 carry a back-of-pack image; 11 are subscribable (all 10 milk SKUs + Chai Special); 10 are most_ordered; 4 carry pack_count (dahi-plain-5kg 2, dahi-plain-15kg 3, paneer-1kg 2, khoya-1kg 2)."},{"term":"CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE","meaning":"The one flag deciding whether the backend is authoritative for the product list. false (default) → the response is byte-identical to the old overlay-only behaviour. true → the 48 seeded products are emitted as additions[] with images and compliance, and the app must ship EXPO_PUBLIC_CATALOG_BACKEND_AUTHORITATIVE=true."}],"entry_points":[{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog.go:785","symbol":"(*repository).catalogView","description":"THE assembly function. addition-only fields must target an existing row."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_images.go:216","symbol":"(*handler).catalogImage","description":"Public B2 art proxy — the reason seeded photo_url values are stable relative paths rather than expiring signed URLs."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/lowstock.go:51","symbol":"(*repository).raiseLowStock","description":"Fans a store's low-stock summary out to every platform admin's in-app inbox, idempotent per (admin, store)."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go:374","symbol":"(*service).syncBaselinePrice","description":"How ERP prices reach seeded SKUs: as a kind=override row under DOLIBARR_STORE_ID carrying price + mrp only."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go:422","symbol":"(*service).syncAddition","description":"How ERP-only products become catalog rows: kind=addition, sku 'dol-<lower ref>', in_stock=false on first sight."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/module.go:100","symbol":"Register","description":"Route table plus boot sequence: fatal index setup, non-fatal 60s catalog seed, then the Dolibarr workers (only when Cfg.DolibarrEnabled())."}],"external_integrations":[{"name":"Backblaze B2 (native API)","direction":"outbound","where":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_images.go","auth_mode":"Basic base64(B2_KEY_ID:B2_APP_KEY) → account authorizationToken; then a bucket-and-prefix-scoped download authorization token handed to clients","notes":"Download-only client (b2_authorize_account, b2_list_buckets, b2_get_download_authorization). Bucket defaults to 'pyaas-saathi-media' and stays allPrivate because it also holds KYC/field photos. 15s HTTP timeout. Never uploads — art is placed at catalog/<file> out of band. Env B2_KEY_ID / B2_APP_KEY / B2_BUCKET shared with internal/modules/uploads/b2.go."},{"name":"Dolibarr ERP (DoliCloud)","direction":"both","where":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go, internal/platform/dolibarr","auth_mode":"DOLAPIKEY header of a scoped saathi.sync user; the inbound webhook kick is gated by DOLIBARR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN falling back to DOLIBARR_API_KEY","notes":"Inbound: sellable-product pull every DOLIBARR_SYNC_EVERY (20s at HEAD) plus on webhook kick, mirroring price/MRP/name/variant/description/physical/photos/stock into consumer_catalog. Entirely OFF unless DOLIBARR_URL and DOLIBARR_API_KEY are both set. Dolibarr is also the natural CRM host — it already carries third-party (societe) records alongside products."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go:59-125","observation":"ERP→app mapping is a CURATED hand-verified table (dolibarrRefToSeedSku, 36 pairs) plus a regex allowlist (^(?:PRG|PYS)-[A-Z0-9-]+$) that keeps legacy/test ERP rows from ever reaching the app. Unmapped refs become additions with a deterministic id 'dol-<lower ref>'.","why_it_matters":"The same discipline is the model for CRM contact mapping: an explicit allowlist plus a deterministic derived id, so a junk record in the ERP can never create a phantom customer and a re-sync is idempotent on the derived id."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go:119-140","observation":"The instant-sync seam is a token-gated GET/POST /consumer/dolibarr/webhook that only calls KickDolibarrSync() — a non-blocking send on a buffered chan struct{} of size 1, so concurrent kicks coalesce into exactly one follow-up pass. Token = DOLIBARR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN falling back to DOLIBARR_API_KEY.","why_it_matters":"Ready-made pattern for a CRM webhook (contact created/updated → kick a sync pass): no new auth scheme, no queue, and it cannot be used to hammer the upstream."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go, internal/modules/consumer/geofence.go","observation":"Lead capture already exists: POST /consumer/partner-leads and POST /consumer/wishlist/leads (both app-key gated; the partner form is reachable signed-out, the wishlist tap carries the server-known uid), plus POST /consumer/waitlist for an out-of-area shopper, upserted BY PHONE into collConsumerWaitlist.","why_it_matters":"These three are the existing lead/prospect surfaces a CRM would sync outbound. A shopper is explicitly NOT a Party — the consumer module never writes the operator `parties` collection and consumer JWTs are cryptographically disjoint from operator tokens (HMAC domain separation on the shared JWT secret, kind='consumer').","why_it_matters":"PHONE is the only natural identity key for CRM matching (email is optional and nullable). A CRM must NOT try to unify shoppers with operator parties — they are separate identity spaces by design, and role/KYC/RBAC deliberately cannot apply to a shopper."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/repo.go:196-228","observation":"deleteAccountCascade is the DPDP erasure path: DeleteMany on addresses/wallets/wallet_txns/consents/refresh/payment_orders by consumer_id, orders by user_id (the consumer hex — a DIFFERENT key shape), OTP challenges by the trailing 10 digits of the phone, then the account itself.","why_it_matters":"Any CRM mirror becomes a new place PII lands and must be added to this cascade or erasure silently becomes incomplete. Note the key inconsistency (user_id hex string vs consumer_id ObjectID) — a CRM sync must not assume one key shape."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_price.go:50-56","observation":"catalogPriceIndex.names stores the EXACT catalog name with NO variant concatenation, and the comment states order-line names are the store inventory's reconciliation key (deriveStock matches rows BY NAME). createOrder overwrites the client-sent line name with this server name.","why_it_matters":"Product display names are load-bearing across order lines, store inventory reconciliation and low-stock summaries. A CRM that renames or normalises product names would orphan sold/held counts. Treat name as an immutable-ish join key and use sku_id for identity."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/lowstock.go:51-90","observation":"The notification fan-out pattern: resolve recipients from role_assignments (ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN/PCDF_ADMIN) joined to parties for phone, then UpdateOne+upsert one row per recipient keyed on (party_id, template_key, params.<entity_id>) with status=QUEUED and channel=APP; clearing is DeleteMany on the same filter.","why_it_matters":"Exact idempotent shape to copy for any CRM-triggered alert. channel=APP (domain.ChannelApp) means in-app inbox only via GET /notifications/me with NO SMS send; SMS would require domain.ChannelSMS and the outbox worker. MSG91 (MSG91_AUTHKEY / MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID) is the only SMS path in this module and is used solely for login OTP."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/module.go, internal/platform/deps/deps.go","observation":"The consumer module receives d.Bus (eventbus) and d.SSE (hub) but NEVER uses either — grepping Publish / SSE across internal/modules/consumer returns nothing. It must poll, or the first piece of work is publishing events from createOrder / createSubscription / account creation. Do not assume an event-bus contract exists here."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/orders.go:28-40 and 243-300, subscriptions.go:340-380","observation":"Order and subscription lifecycle: money is server-computed at creation (subtotal from priceFor; fee ₹15 unless subtotal >= ₹199 or 0; payment_method defaults to 'wallet', settled on delivery), and subscriptions become morning-lane orders via subscriptionOrderWorker every 15 minutes, exactly-once per (subscription, IST day). mandateAutoRenewalWorker charges due ACTIVE UPI-AutoPay mandates through the same idempotent money gate.","why_it_matters":"These are the revenue events a CRM would want, and the idempotency anchors are already in place and worth copying: the UNIQUE partial index on consumer_wallet_txns {consumer_id, ref_id, type} (the exactly-once money gate — the process PANICS at boot if it cannot be created), the unique consumer_payment_orders.order_id, and markPaymentOrderPaid's guarded CREATED→PAID transition that reports whether THIS call made the transition."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/service.go:73-102, internal/config/config.go:44-65","observation":"Feature-flag style in this module is env-var-on-the-service-struct read once in newService (catalogServeSeeded = os.Getenv(\"CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE\")==\"true\", appKey, rzpKeyID/Secret, MSG91 keys). The platform HAS a flags service (d.Flags) that the consumer module ignores. Dolibarr, by contrast, is gated by Cfg.DolibarrEnabled() — both URL and API key non-empty.","why_it_matters":"A CRM integration should follow Cfg.DolibarrEnabled()'s shape — a config-derived boolean that makes the feature a strict no-op when credentials are absent, so it has zero impact on every existing flow — rather than adding another loose os.Getenv on the service struct."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_images.go, dolibarr_sync.go:768-805","observation":"Two public unauthenticated asset proxies already exist, each defended at two layers (handler path guard plus a prefix-scoped upstream credential). Stored paths are always RELATIVE ('catalog/img/x.png', 'catalog/dolimg/<folder>/<file>') because a signed URL baked into data would expire.","why_it_matters":"If a CRM needs to surface any asset (contact avatar, document), reuse this shape: store a stable relative path, mint the credential per request, and scope the upstream authorization to a prefix so the route can serve one class of file and nothing else."}],"gotchas":["catalogView reads the ENTIRE consumer_catalog with no store filter — overrides and additions from ANY store apply to EVERY consumer. The live pricing path is loadPriceIndex/priceFor in catalog_price.go. Worse, the two now disagree: serverPriceFor checks view.Overrides FIRST, but catalogView FOLDS overrides into served entries, so with the seed served the Overrides map is usually empty and serverPriceFor would silently return the unfolded addition price. The other 40 seeded ids are NOT protected — a store manager can create an addition whose sku_id shadows a seeded product, producing two rows for one sku across two store_ids.","No HTTP write path for stock_count exists. catalog_seed.go and catalog.go both comment 'the store manager edits the real number', but patchSkuRequest has no stock_count field and nothing writes it except the seed's $setOnInsert (50) and the Dolibarr mirror. Same for mrp: no console field, only the seed and Dolibarr write it. Those comments are stale.","stock_count is GLOBAL, not per-store: seededStock reads store_id='_global' and no per-store stock override exists, so every store's console shows the same on-hand number and the same total_stock. Only the in_stock FLAG is per-store effective. storeStock says so in a comment; the UI implication is easy to miss.","With CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE=true, the Dolibarr sync bumps updated_at on seeded kind=product rows on every stock change (setSeededStockCount writes updated_at=time.Now()); at a 20-second poll cadence this churns the response `version` (max updated_at ms) constantly, defeating the client cache it exists for. The seed itself is careful to avoid this (fixed seedProductStamp); the sync is not.","catalogView and loadPriceIndex each do a FULL collection scan sorted by updated_at, with no index on updated_at, on EVERY GET /consumer/catalog and EVERY order/subscription creation. Fine at ~109 rows, a cliff at scale.","An addition hidden by its OWN row (not by an override) is simply ABSENT from the response — no overrides entry is emitted for it. If the app still bundles that sku it keeps showing it. Hiding only propagates to a bundled copy when the hide is written as an override row; the code comments acknowledge the override case but not this one.","POST /stores/{storeId}/low-stock does NOT call assertStore — unlike every other store route in this module. Any STORE_MANAGER can raise or clear a STORE_LOW_STOCK alert naming any store id. It also swallows body decode errors (`_ = decode(r, &body)`).","patchStoreSku's split is subtle and easy to break: price/in_stock/hidden go through upsertOverride (which UPSERTS and stamps kind=override only $setOnInsert), while name/category/variant/description/subscribable/photo_url/physical set additionOnly=true and force patchExisting (404 if absent). A caller sending {price, name} on an unrowed baseline sku therefore gets a 404 and NO price update — intentional (no phantom docs) but surprising.","In addStoreSku shape 1, `BaseID: strings.TrimSpace(req.BaseID)` is always \"\" — a non-empty base_id routes to shape 2 before that line is reached. Natively created bases never store base_id; only the Dolibarr sync (which builds catalogDoc directly and sets BaseID=ref) populates it.","A base created with price 0 and variants[] passes validation (the range check is skipped when req.Price==0 && len(Variants)>0) and is stored with price=&0. additionViewFromDoc emits price 0 and priceFor rejects the base (p <= 0) — the product is buyable only by naming a priced variant; ordering it without one returns 400 'unknown product'.","validateVariant enforces a price on the way in, but patchVariant only sets variants.$[v].price when non-nil, and buildPriceIndex SKIPS variants whose price is 0 — so a variant can end up with no index entry and silently fall back to the base price. patchVariant also does not check kind=addition, so it would happily arrayFilter into a seeded product row.","overrideView.MRP is documented as meaningful at 0 ('an explicit 0 CLEARS a stale bundled strikethrough') and this works only because the field is a *float64 with omitempty — omitempty drops a nil pointer but not a pointer to 0.0. Do not 'simplify' MRP to a plain float64; that would silently break the clear semantics.","additionView.MostOrdered is a plain bool with omitempty, so false is omitted from the wire while true is present — an asymmetry the app must treat as absent==false. InStock, by contrast, is always emitted.","subscribableOrDairyDefault defaults an UNSET subscribable to true only for category=='milk'. The Dolibarr sync explicitly writes subscribable=false on every ERP addition, so an ERP-sourced milk SKU is NOT subscribable until a human flips it — different from a hand-added milk SKU.","GET /consumer/catalog is fail-closed on CONSUMER_APP_KEY: an unset key returns 403 for everyone, not an open gate. This coupling between products_seed.json and dolibarrRefToSeedSku is implicit and undocumented; editing one without the other will put an unstockable SKU on sale.","dolibarrRefToSeedSku deliberately omits pairs whose ERP pack size differs from the seeded one (ERP Dahi Sada 80/180/380g vs seeded 90/200/400g). That is intended, not a bug.","catalogImagePath returns a RELATIVE path ('catalog/img/x.png') and the route is /consumer/catalog/img/{name} — the 'img/' segment belongs to the route, not the B2 key. The bucket key is catalog/<name>. Getting this wrong (e.g. uploading to catalog/img/) silently 502s every image.","catalogImage rejects any name containing '/' or '..', so nested B2 keys under catalog/ are unreachable by design. Uploads must be flat filenames directly under catalog/.","The dolibarrImages byte cache is a package-level var with a 64-entry cap and a naive O(n) evict-oldest scan, and it is per-process — N replicas each hold their own copy and each miss hits the ERP. A product-image count above 64 will thrash.","B2 tokens are cached in-process for 20h against a 24h life, with no negative caching: if B2 is down, every image request retries the full authorize → list_buckets → get_download_authorization chain.","Dolibarr prices are stored ex-GST (price_base_type=HT) with tva_tx often unset; the rate is recovered from the default_vat_code suffix ('C+S-5' → 5%).
