The `order` struct has TWO fields tagged `json:\"delivery_date,omitempty\"` at the same depth — `DeliveryDate` (orders.go:96) and `ScheduledFor` (orders.go:135). Go's encoding/json drops ALL conflicting fields at equal depth, so neither is serialized (verified experimentally: the marshalled object is `{}` for both). Every consumer-facing order response is missing the delivery date entirely, including the UPCOMING date the subscription flow explicitly materialises tomorrow's order for.","`cancellableStatuses = {placed, confirmed, assigned}` (orders.go:45) is declared with a long comment saying a customer may cancel after a rider claims but before pickup — and it is DEAD CODE, referenced nowhere in the repo. The real guard in cancelOrder is `status $in [\"placed\", \"confirmed\"]`, so once claimDelivery flips the order to \"assigned\" the customer can no longer cancel, contradicting the comment.","Order statuses \"confirmed\" and \"preparing\" are only ever READ (recentFulfillableOrders' backfill filter, delivery.go:217) — no code path ever writes them except the dev-only advanceOrder, which accepts ANY arbitrary string with no validation. The statuses actually written are: placed, assigned, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled.","The delivery geofence is CLIENT-ASSERTED. deliverDelivery only checks `in.GeofenceOK` — the boolean the rider app sends as `proof.geofence_ok` — and never compares `in.Geo` against `d.Geo`. A modified rider client can deliver from anywhere by sending `{\"proof\":{\"geofence_ok\":true,\"photo_ref\":\"x\"},\"geo\":[0,0]}`. Nothing validates the photo_ref is a real uploaded asset either.","`geofence_ok` is written into the deliveries document (delivery_svc.go:649) but is NOT a field on the `delivery` Go struct, so it is never decoded, never returned, and never queried. It is write-only data.","A manager-assigned delivery does NOT sync the parent order. assignRider sets the task to ASSIGNED but never calls syncOrderAssigned, so the shopper's order stays \"placed\" with no rider until pickup. Only the rider's self-claim path (claimOfferedDelivery) surfaces the rider early. Asymmetric and easy to miss.","INSTANT tasks cannot be manually assigned. createDeliveryForOrder creates instant-lane tasks with status OFFERED, but assignRider's guard is `status $in [ASSIGNED, FAILED]` — so a store manager can never assign an instant task, even when no rider claims it. Its only exits are a rider claim or (after a fail) reassignment.","A rejected MORNING task enters the INSTANT broadcast pool. rejectOffer accepts status $in [ACCEPTED, ASSIGNED] and sets OFFERED unconditionally; listOfferedForStores does not filter on lane. So a manager-assigned 05:00 subscription task, once declined, becomes a 15-km-fenced first-accept-wins offer.","createOrder only gates the INSTANT lane on serviceability, and only when `geo` is non-nil. A morning order to a point 1000 km outside the fence is accepted. An instant order with `geo: null` skips the INSTANT_CLOSED check AND the monsoon surcharge entirely, so a client can zero the surcharge by omitting geo.","An order with no geo delivers TO THE STORE. createDeliveryForOrder sets `dest = storeGeo` when `o.Geo == nil`, so the task's `geo` is the store centre and distance_km is 0. The rider's map, the offer fence and the (client-side) geofence all then point at the store, not the customer.","COD deliveries move no money and record nothing. deliverDelivery only settles when `d.PaymentMode == \"PREPAID\"`; a COD task completes with no ledger row, no collected-cash record, and no reconciliation hook. payMode is COD for any payment_method other than \"wallet\"/\"prepaid\".","The debit ref contract with the client is unwritten. The server uses `\"delivery:\" + orderID`; the code comments say the app's settleDeliveredOrders sweep POSTs /wallet/debit \"idempotent by order id\". If the app's ref string does not match this exact prefix format the unique gate will not dedupe and the customer is charged TWICE for a delivered order. Nothing in the backend or docs pins the client's format.","POST /wallet/debit accepts a CLIENT-SUPPLIED amount and ref with no entitlement check. A shopper's own token can debit their own wallet for an arbitrary amount on an arbitrary ref — harmless to the business but it also means a client bug can burn a legitimate ref (e.g. \"delivery:ord_x\") at the wrong amount and permanently block the real settle from charging.","There is NO Razorpay webhook anywhere in the repo (grep confirms only the Dolibarr webhook exists). Payment confirmation depends entirely on the client calling POST /wallet/verify. If the app is killed after payment succeeds, the money is captured at Razorpay and the wallet is never credited — there is no reconciliation job.","verifyPayment checks the HMAC signature but NEVER calls Razorpay to confirm the payment is captured or that its amount matches. It credits the amount stored in consumer_payment_orders on signature validity alone.","The dev Razorpay secret is a hard-coded constant, `devRazorpaySecret = \"rzp_dev_secret_v1\"` (razorpay.go:30). Whenever OTP_DEV_MODE=true AND RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET is empty, anyone who reads this source can forge a valid signature for any order id and mint wallet cash via /wallet/verify. render.yaml sets OTP_DEV_MODE=false for production, which is the only thing closing this.","signingSecret() prefers a real rzpKeySecret; but if a real secret IS set and OTP_DEV_MODE is also true, createRzpOrder hits the live Razorpay API while every dev money-mint route (/wallet/topup, /wallet/promo, /wallet/refund) stays open. The two flags are independent and the combination is not defended against.","POST /orders/{id}/pay creates a real amount-bound Razorpay order (purpose=\"order\") but there is NO verify/capture route for it. A customer who completes that payment has their money taken at the gateway with no server path to record it. The code is paid-first with trialPaidDays=trialFreeDays=2, but three of the four comments describe something else — and the file itself warns \"POLARITY IS LOAD-BEARING\" while contradicting itself.","pushLocation has NO status guard — a rider can push GPS onto a DELIVERED or FAILED task, and syncOrderRiderLocation will keep moving the rider pin on a completed order.","Rider presence freshness compares RFC3339 STRINGS lexicographically (`at >= cutoff`, `d.LastLocationAt > lastAt`). Sending `{\"instantRadiusM\": 0, \"instant_radius_km\": 0}` plus a standard radius silently disables instant rather than erroring.","zoneView emits effOpenMin/effCloseMin (07:00–22:00 defaults substituted when instant_close_min==0), so the console reads back hours the DB does not actually contain. A save round-trip therefore MATERIALISES those defaults, silently converting a legacy 24-hour-instant zone into a 07:00–22:00 zone.","storeAdjustDelivery recomputes total as `subtotal + deliveryFeeFor(subtotal) + o.MonsoonFee` — so shrinking an order below ₹199 RE-ADDS the ₹15 delivery fee that free-over-₹199 had waived. Not part of the order/delivery path.","where":"internal/modules/consumer/module.go:50 → internal/modules/consumer/qrresign.go"}],"domain_concepts":[{"term":"Lane","meaning":"How an order is fulfilled. \"instant\" = ≈20-minute doorstep run, auto-dispatched as an OFFERED broadcast to riders within 15 km, ETA = placed_at + 20 min, eligible for the monsoon surcharge, gated by the store's instant hours. \"morning\" = the 05:00–07:30 AM subscription route, created ASSIGNED for the store manager to batch-assign. Morning is the DEFAULT — any lane value other than the literal \"instant\" becomes \"morning\" so a stray value can never mint an instant promise."},{"term":"Delivery task","meaning":"A consumer_deliveries row — the operator-side twin of a consumer order. Exactly one per order (enforced by a unique order_id index). It is what the store console and rider app see; the order is what the shopper sees. The two are kept in sync by the syncOrder* helpers, one-way, delivery → order."},{"term":"Delivery status (6 values)","meaning":"OFFERED (instant broadcast, unclaimed, rider_party_id==\"\") → ACCEPTED (a rider claimed it) → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (picked up) → DELIVERED (terminal); ASSIGNED (morning-lane initial state, or a manager assignment) → ACCEPTED; FAILED (terminal-ish; a manager may reassign a FAILED task back to ASSIGNED). Transitions: OFFERED→ACCEPTED via claimDelivery; ACCEPTED|ASSIGNED→OFFERED via rejectOffer (re-broadcast, records rejected_by, $inc reoffer_count); ASSIGNED→ACCEPTED via acceptDelivery; ACCEPTED→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY via pickupDelivery; OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED via deliverDelivery; anything-but-DELIVERED→FAILED via failDelivery / storeCancelDelivery / a customer cancel; ASSIGNED|FAILED→ASSIGNED via assignRider."},{"term":"Order status (5 written values)","meaning":"placed (creation, and the state a rejected/re-broadcast order falls back to) → assigned (a rider claimed the task) → out_for_delivery (rider picked up) → delivered (terminal, sets can_review) ; cancelled (terminal, from the customer's cancel of a placed/confirmed order, from storeCancelDelivery, or from the subscription sweep expiring/killing an unlocked preview). \"confirmed\" and \"preparing\" appear only in the backfill filter and are never written by any real path."},{"term":"Service level / mode","meaning":"The serviceability answer, ranked svcInstant(2) > svcStandard(1) > svcNone(0) and rendered as \"instant\" | \"standard\" | \"none\". The richest match across all active zones wins."},{"term":"Zone","meaning":"One store's self-contained geo policy in store_zones: an instant circle, a larger standard circle, include pincodes (serviceable even outside the circles), exclude pincodes (blacklist), include polygons (allowed area beyond the circle), exclude polygons (holes that deny even inside a serving circle), plus monsoon surcharge and instant hours."},{"term":"Default-open / defaultFenceKm","meaning":"Before any manager draws a zone, serviceability falls back to a hard 5.0 km radius around the nearest STORE org-unit with a sane geo (defaultFenceKm). If NO store has a usable coordinate, the pilot stays open (Serviceable:true, DefaultOpen:true) rather than going dark."},{"term":"Distance tiers (riderTiersKm)","meaning":"15 / 30 / 60 km bands. tierFor returns the smallest band a rider falls in (0 = beyond 60 km). The tiers RANK the manager's assign sheet; they never block an assignment — any rider on the store's roster is eligible. riderTiersKm[0] (15 km) doubles as the hard instant-offer broadcast fence."},{"term":"Monsoon surcharge","meaning":"A store-manager-set flat rupee amount (0..500) added to INSTANT orders only. Read authoritatively from the winning zone inside createOrder, never trusted from the client payload; also surfaced on the serviceability response so the app can display it."},{"term":"Instant window","meaning":"Per-zone instant opening hours in minutes since IST midnight (instant_open_min / instant_close_min), supporting overnight windows (open > close), plus a manual instant_paused kill switch. instant_close_min == 0 means legacy 24-hour instant unless paused. When shut, serviceability returns instantClosed plus a human resume label and an RFC3339 resume moment."},{"term":"Settle-on-delivery","meaning":"The core money rule: order creation moves no money at all; the wallet is debited at the moment of proof-of-delivery, keyed by \"delivery:<orderId>\" — the same ref the consumer app's own settleDeliveredOrders sweep uses, so the two paths dedupe against each other through the unique (consumer_id, ref_id, type) ledger index."},{"term":"Money gate","meaning":"The insert-first idempotency pattern: a ledger row on the partial unique index (consumer_id, ref_id, type) is inserted BEFORE any balance moves. A duplicate insert means the movement already happened; on a failed movement the row is rolled back on a detached context so a future retry is not permanently blocked."},{"term":"Promo-first debit","meaning":"debitWalletAtomic spends the REWARDS (promotional) bucket before CASH inside a single aggregation-pipeline update guarded by $expr {cash + rewards >= amount}, making overdraft impossible under concurrency."},{"term":"2+2 welcome trial","meaning":"A per-shopper window counted in DELIVERED days (never calendar days) for the gold-* full-cream SKU on a SUBSCRIPTION-linked morning delivery. As implemented: the first trialPaidDays(2) delivered days charge in full, the next trialFreeDays(2) charge 0, then \"done\". Idempotent by the key \"sub:<consumerHex>:<IST day>\". A free day still writes a ₹0 DEBIT ledger row so the app's settle sweep cannot back-charge it. Several code comments describe the opposite polarity — see gotchas."},{"term":"Preview vs locked subscription order","meaning":"A subscription order materialised at 13:00 IST is a visible but modifiable PREVIEW (status placed, scheduled_for set, sub_locked_at empty, no delivery task, no wallet gate). At IST midnight it LOCKS: sub_locked_at is stamped and the delivery task is created. After the lock the store owns it and subscription edits no longer reconcile it."},{"term":"Rider presence","meaning":"The rider's live duty position (consumer_rider_presence), upserted from the GPS fix the rider app attaches to every ~8 s offer poll. Considered live for 10 minutes (offerPingFreshness); older fixes are discarded so a stale position can neither include nor exclude a rider from an offer."},{"term":"Order surgery","meaning":"The store manager's reduce-only adjustment at handover (3 packets ordered, 1 damaged → deliver 2; qty 0 removes the line). Quantities are ABSOLUTE, never deltas, so the call is idempotent; both the order and the task are re-billed and the customer pays only for what actually ships."},{"term":"Operator wire format vs consumer wire format","meaning":"Store-manager and rider routes emit the Saathi {data} envelope with camelCase via httpx.JSON/httpx.Error (toHTTPErr bridges consumer apiError codes across). Shopper routes emit RAW JSON with snake_case and {message} errors, matching the consumer app's apiClient — including custom 404/405 handlers on the /consumer subtree."}],"tests":[{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/geofence_test.go","covers":"The pure geofence core: TestHaversineM, TestPointInPolygon, TestServiceabilityPriorityTable (every branch of evalZone's 7-step ladder), TestServiceabilityBoundary (circle edges), TestRichestMatchAcrossZones, TestValidateRadius (100..60000 m), TestCoordsSane."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/geofence_fence_test.go","covers":"The no-zone STORE-OrgUnit fence: TestGeoSane (Null Island and out-of-range rejection) and TestDefaultFenceBoundary pinned to the seeded STORE-LKO-01 centre (26.85, 81.00) — near point serviceable, Hyderabad and an 11 km outskirt point not."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/geofence_hours_test.go","covers":"instantWindow and effOpenMin/effCloseMin: normal 07:00–22:00 hours, before-open and after-close resume labels, manual pause, the no-hours 24 h zone, no-hours+paused, and overnight windows (open 22:00 / close 06:00)."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/trial_test.go","covers":"The trial engine as actually implemented: TestTrialProgression, TestTrialBoundaries, TestTrialPauseSafe (a pause never burns a free day), TestTrialIdempotentByKey, TestTrialSameDayDifferentAmount (a second delivery the same trial day charges its OWN amount), TestTrialDeliveryKey, TestTrialView."},{"path":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_price_test.go","covers":"TestPriceIndexResolvesServerSide — the server-authoritative pricing that createOrder depends on (override beats seed, variant price beats base, hidden and unknown SKUs unpurchasable). Nothing covers order creation/repricing, the cancellable-status guard, delivery state transitions, claimDelivery's first-accept-wins race, the 15 km offer fence, proof-of-delivery gating, the settle/trial interaction, storeAdjustDelivery's re-billing, or signature verification."}]},{"area":"Consumer: subscriptions, mandates, trials, leads, service wiring","purpose":"The `consumer` module is the add-only D2C backend for the PYAAS/PARAG consumer app, mounted at /api/v1/consumer and deliberately isolated from the operator (Saathi) side: its own `consumer_*` Mongo collections, its own JWT (kind=\"consumer\", HMAC-derived key disjoint from operator tokens), and raw-JSON `{message}` error bodies instead of the operator `{data}` envelope. If effective == 0 → insert a ZERO-amount DEBIT gate row on the SAME ref so the consumer app's own settle sweep (which POSTs /wallet/debit with the sticker total) dedupes into a no-op instead of back-charging a free day","Flip the delivery to DELIVERED with proof fields, then syncOrderDelivered"],"side_effects":"consumer_wallet_txns DEBIT row (possibly amount 0) under the unique (consumer_id, ref_id, type) partial index; consumer_trials counters advance; delivery + order status sync."},{"name":"E-mandate registration and charge","trigger":"POST /mandate/create → Razorpay recurring checkout → POST /mandate/verify; charges from mandateAutoRenewalWorker or POST /mandate/{id}/execute","steps":["createMandate: round2 amount; max_amount defaults to amount; validateMandate — plan ∈ mandatePlans {daily:24h, alternate:48h, weekly:7d}, amount ₹1..₹5000, max_amount ≥ amount and ≤ ₹100000","createRzpMandate: if RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET == \"\" and OTP_DEV_MODE → mock token \"token_dev_<16hex>\"; if secret empty and NOT dev → 500 \"recurring payments are not configured\". LIVE path POSTs a Razorpay order with amount=first charge paise, payment_capture true and a token object {max_amount, expire_at = now+1y, frequency = rzpFrequency(plan) → daily|weekly|as_presented}","Insert into consumer_mandates: mandate_id \"mnd_<12hex>\", status \"pending\", reg_order_id. Response {id, token, keyId, status}","verifyMandate: idempotent if already active; requires mandateCanTransition(status,\"active\"); in dev seam (rzpDevMode) signature is skipped, otherwise verifyRzpSignature(reg_order_id, payment_id, signature) must pass; sets payment_id, next_charge = now + plan cadence, optional token; transitionMandate guarded on the exact `from` status","runMandateCharge(consumerID, mandateID, at): mandate must be status \"active\"; day = dayKey(at) in IST; ref = \"mandate:<id>:<YYYY-MM-DD>\"; s.debit(...) is the money gate (unique consumer+ref+type); then advanceMandateCharge sets last_charge_date/last_charge_at/next_charge guarded on last_charge_date != day","mandateAutoRenewalWorker: returns immediately unless env MANDATE_AUTODEBIT == \"true\"; otherwise sleeps 45s, then every mandateTickEvery (10 min) calls sweepDueMandates → dueMandates (status active AND (next_charge <= now OR next_charge == nil), sorted next_charge asc, limit 200) and runs each through runMandateCharge; failures (typically INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS) are logged and left due for the next tick"],"side_effects":"Wallet DEBIT rows keyed mandate:<id>:<day>; mandate bookkeeping fields. NOTE the worker is deliberately OFF by default (double-debit guard, see gotchas)."},{"name":"Lead capture (partner + wishlist)","trigger":"App submits the \"Partner with us\" form, or taps \"Notify me\" on an out-of-stock SKU","steps":["Both handlers first call h.svc.appKeyOK(r) — constant-time compare of X-Parag-App-Key against CONSUMER_APP_KEY; an unset server key DENIES (fail-closed) and logs a warning","createPartnerLead: decode {kind, name, phone, email, business_name, city, message, details(map[string]any)}; name and phone are trimmed and REQUIRED (400 otherwise); a single InsertOne into consumer_partner_leads with created_at = time.Now().UTC(); responds {\"ok\": true}","createWishlistLead: decode {user_id, product_id, product_name, variant, source}; product_id REQUIRED; user_id defaults to the literal string \"anon\" when blank; UpdateOne with upsert on filter {user_id, product_id}, $set {product_name, variant, source, updated_at}, $inc {taps: 1}, $setOnInsert {created_at}; responds {\"ok\": true}"],"side_effects":"Write-only into Mongo. NO notification, NO SMS, NO event, NO ERP push, and NO read/list/admin endpoint anywhere in the repo consumes either collection."},{"name":"Consumer login / token lifecycle","trigger":"POST /auth/otp/request then /auth/otp/verify","steps":["normalizePhone strips non-digits and keeps the last 10; phoneRe = ^[6-9]\\\\d{9}$","Play-review bypass: phone == \"9999900000\" (reviewLoginEnabled() returns a hardcoded true) → requestOTP returns immediately with no code minted and no SMS; verifyOTP accepts the fixed code \"123456\" with no challenge lookup and calls ensureReviewAccount (creates \"+919999900000\" named \"Play Reviewer\", tops the wallet's cash_balance directly to a ₹500 floor with NO ledger row, seeds a default Lucknow address 26.85/81.00 Gomti Nagar 226010)","Normal path: 6-digit OTP, hashed as auth.HMACHash(OTP_HASH_SECRET, \"consumer\", phone, code) into consumer_otp_challenges (TTL index on expires_at); delivered synchronously via MSG91 when MSG91_AUTHKEY+MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID are set, else echoed as dev_otp when OTP_DEV_MODE","verifyOTP: latest challenge must exist and be unexpired; wrong code bumps attempts and burns the challenge at maxOTPAttempts(5); on success deleteOTP; account looked up/created by canonical \"+91\"+phone in consumer_accounts (unique phone index); a fresh account gets an empty consumer_wallets row","issueTokens: signAccessToken mints HS256 JWT with kind=\"consumer\", iss=\"saathi-consumer\", sub=<account ObjectID hex>, phone claim, exp = now + ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES (default 15), signed with s.consumerKey = auth.HMACHash(JWT_SECRET, \"consumer-jwt-v1\") — cryptographically disjoint from operator tokens; refresh token is 32 random bytes stored only as HMAC(OTP_HASH_SECRET, \"consumer_refresh\", raw) in consumer_refresh_tokens with REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS (default 30)","refresh: first use stamps used_at; a replay within refreshRotationGrace (90s) still re-issues a fresh pair; beyond that → 401 \"refresh token already used\"; purgeUsedRefresh tidies rows older than an hour"],"side_effects":"OTP SMS via MSG91; account + wallet creation on first verify."},{"name":"Traceability bridge (operator → consumer)","trigger":"App scans a pack QR (deep link parag://trace/<CODE>) and calls GET /traceability/{code}","steps":["appKeyOK gate (fail-closed on an unset CONSUMER_APP_KEY)","service.traceByCode tries the code as-given, lowercased, and uppercased against publictrace.Service.ResolvePublicQR (consignment batch tokens are stored lowercase hex; the app uppercases scans)","A *publictrace.QRScanResponse maps via mapToMilkBatch (product-lot pack QR): batch_code, product, pack size, mfg/expiry, plant, district, hardcoded state \"Uttar Pradesh\", union name derived as \"<district> District Cooperative Dairy Union\", member_villages = len(Sourcing.Samitis), pouring_members = Sourcing.FarmersTotal, tests with FAT/SNF lifted into fat_pct/snf_pct, verified = Ledger.Intact, recalled/recall_notice","A *publictrace.BatchQualityReport maps via mapReportToMilkBatch (per-samiti pooled batch): product literal \"Cooperative pooled milk batch\", member_villages hardcoded 1, verified = Quality.OverallPass, batch/packed date from Collection.PickedUpAt","Unresolvable → 404 so the app falls back to its offline demo seed","/label renders a fully self-contained HTML card (inline CSS, QR as a base64 data: URI encoding parag://trace/<UPPERCASE CODE>) that expo-print converts to a PDF"],"side_effects":"The only write is publictrace's own best-effort public scan-count increment inside ResolvePublicQR — the same behaviour the operator's /public/qr already performs. No operator business state, PII, or money is touched."},{"name":"Boot-time QR re-signing repair (qrresign.go)","trigger":"go resignQRTokens(d, log) fired from Register; best-effort, 30s context, never blocks boot","steps":["resignConsignmentBatchQRs scans mongodb.CollConsignmentBatchQRs; for each row recomputes auth.HMACHash(QR_SIGNING_SECRET, batch_code) truncated to the row's stored token length (default 8 when empty); ConstantTimeEqual skip if already current, else UpdateByID sets `token`","resignProductQRs scans mongodb.CollBatchQRs; splits signed_token on the first '.' into base64url payload + hex mac, decodes the payload, recomputes auth.HMACHash(secret, payload), skips if equal, else rewrites signed_token as payloadB64 + \".\" + newMac","Malformed/legacy rows are skipped for manual review; counts are logged only when > 0"],"side_effects":"Writes to two OPERATOR-owned QR collections (the only operator-collection writes in the consumer module)."}],"data_stores":[{"name":"consumer_subscriptions","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Server-owned recurring plan: one product line + cadence + vacations, plus the exactly-once day claim.","key_fields":["subscription_id (\"sub_<12hex>\", unique)","consumer_id (ObjectID)","product_id","name","variant","qty","unit_price","frequency (daily|alternate|weekly)","delivery_slot","status (active|paused|cancelled)","start_date (YYYY-MM-DD IST)","vacations[] {start,end} inclusive","last_order_date (day claim)","last_order_id","created_at","updated_at"],"indexes":"unique subscription_id; (consumer_id, created_at desc). THE primary raw CRM lead table. Upsert by phone.","key_fields":["phone (normalized 10-digit)","pincode","name","lat","lng","hits ($inc)","created_at","updated_at"],"indexes":"see ensureGeoIndexes (geofence.go)"},{"name":"consumer_accounts","kind":"mongo","purpose":"The shopper record — the CRM \"contact\". Never a Party.","key_fields":["_id","phone (canonical \"+91XXXXXXXXXX\", unique)","full_name (*string)","email (*string)","alternate_phone","family_member_count","milk_preference","avatar_url","referral_code","delivery_slot","membership_tier","status (\"ACTIVE\")","created_at","updated_at"],"indexes":"unique phone; created_at desc"},{"name":"consumer_addresses","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Delivery points; the default one (with lat/lng) is what every subscription order routes to.","key_fields":["consumer_id","label","line1","line2","city","pincode","is_default","lat","lng","store_id","preferences {receiver_name, geo_label, ring_bell, call_before, instructions, door_photo_uri}","created_at"],"indexes":"consumer_id"},{"name":"consumer_wallets / consumer_wallet_txns","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Dual-bucket wallet (cash_balance + rewards_balance − held_amount = available) and the append-only ledger that is the exactly-once money gate for every subscription/mandate/delivery charge.","key_fields":["wallets: consumer_id (unique), cash_balance, rewards_balance, held_amount, currency, autorecharge{enabled,threshold,amount,mandate_ref,per_debit_cap}, seq","txns: consumer_id, seq, type (TOPUP|BONUS|DEBIT|REFUND|…), bucket (CASH|REWARDS), amount, cash_after, rewards_after, ref_type, ref_id, status, remark, created_at"],"indexes":"wallets unique consumer_id; txns (consumer_id, seq desc); UNIQUE PARTIAL (consumer_id, ref_id, type) where ref_id > \"\" — this index is the money gate and its creation is FATAL at boot"},{"name":"consumer_orders","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Consumer orders, including worker-created subscription morning orders.","key_fields":["order_id (\"ord_<12hex>\")","user_id (consumer hex)","status","subtotal","delivery_fee","total","payment_method","address_label","address_text","lane","delivery_window","trial_free","order_items[]","consumer_name","phone","geo","subscription_id","scheduled_for (IST day)","sub_locked_at"],"indexes":"see ensureOrderIndexes (orders.go)"},{"name":"consumer_payment_orders","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Amount-bound Razorpay orders so a tampered client cannot pay ₹1 for a ₹500 top-up; consumer_id"},{"name":"consumer_otp_challenges / consumer_refresh_tokens","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Login OTP challenges (HMAC-hashed, TTL-expired) and rotating refresh tokens (HMAC-hashed at rest, 90s post-rotation grace).","key_fields":["otp: _id, phone, code_hash, expires_at, attempts, created_at","refresh: token_hash (unique), consumer_id, expires_at, created_at, used_at"],"indexes":"otp: phone, TTL on expires_at; refresh: unique token_hash, consumer_id"},{"name":"notifications / parties / role_assignments / org_units","kind":"mongo","purpose":"Shared OPERATOR collections the consumer repo opens read-mostly for store/rider resolution and for the STORE_LOW_STOCK admin inbox fan-out.","key_fields":["notifications: party_id, template_key (\"STORE_LOW_STOCK\"), store id key"],"indexes":"owned by the operator modules"},{"name":"service.dolibarrKick","kind":"memory","purpose":"Buffered(1) chan struct{} that lets POST/GET /consumer/dolibarr/webhook wake the ERP catalog sync loop immediately; concurrent kicks coalesce into one follow-up pass.","key_fields":[],"indexes":"n/a"}],"crm_relevant":[{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go","observation":"There are TWO lead endpoints and both are pure fire-and-forget Mongo writes: POST /consumer/partner-leads inserts one doc into `consumer_partner_leads` {kind, name, phone, email, business_name, city, message, details, created_at}; POST /consumer/wishlist/leads upserts `consumer_wishlist_leads` on (user_id, product_id) with $set{product_name, variant, source, updated_at}, $inc{taps:1}, $setOnInsert{created_at}. Neither collection is read, listed, exported, indexed, or pushed anywhere else in the repo (verified by grep for both collection names — the only hits are leads.go itself and repo wiring absent entirely).","why_it_matters":"This is the single highest-value CRM hook point and it is currently a dead-end write. A CRM integration should either (a) tail these two collections, or (b) add a post-insert push (Dolibarr thirdparty/contact create, or an event-bus topic) directly in createPartnerLead/createWishlistLead. Nothing today would break, because nothing today reads them."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go:97","observation":"createWishlistLead trusts the CLIENT-SUPPLIED `user_id` from the request body — it does NOT come from the authenticated consumer JWT (the route is mounted OUTSIDE the pr.Use(svc.authenticate) group, in the public/app-key-gated block). A blank user_id becomes the literal string \"anon\".","why_it_matters":"Wishlist lead identity is unverified and can be spoofed or collapsed into a shared \"anon\" bucket. Any CRM that keys demand signals on user_id must treat it as untrusted and must handle the \"anon\" sentinel. Contrast with the module.go route comment which claims \"the wishlist tap sends the server-known uid\" — it does not."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go:31, geofence.go:775","observation":"Both lead routes and the waitlist route are gated only by service.appKeyOK — a constant-time compare of the X-Parag-App-Key header against env CONSUMER_APP_KEY. It is fail-closed (an unset key denies everyone and logs a warning), and the key is a static value shipped inside the mobile app as EXPO_PUBLIC_CONSUMER_APP_KEY.","why_it_matters":"A CRM must not assume lead rows are attributable to a verified human: the shared app key is extractable from the APK, so anyone can post arbitrary partner leads. Dedup/spam handling belongs on the CRM side."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/geofence.go:351-378, 727-749","observation":"consumer_waitlist is a THIRD lead table with the same shape: upsert by normalized 10-digit phone, $inc hits, fields {phone, pincode, name, lat, lng, created_at, updated_at}. Fed by POST /consumer/waitlist when a shopper's location is outside every serviceable zone.","why_it_matters":"Out-of-area demand is the highest-intent expansion signal in the product and shares the phone identity key with consumer_accounts. Any CRM sync should treat consumer_waitlist + consumer_partner_leads + consumer_wishlist_leads as one lead funnel, joined on phone / user_id."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/models.go:33-47","observation":"The customer record is `consumer_accounts`: _id (ObjectID), phone (canonical \"+91XXXXXXXXXX\", UNIQUE index — this is the identity key), full_name, email, alternate_phone, family_member_count, milk_preference, avatar_url, referral_code, delivery_slot, membership_tier, status, created_at, updated_at. It is explicitly NOT the operator `parties` collection.","why_it_matters":"phone is the only unique/stable natural key for CRM matching; email is optional and never validated. referral_code and membership_tier already exist on the schema but nothing in this slice writes them — free fields for a CRM/loyalty integration. updateMe whitelists exactly {full_name, email, alternate_phone, milk_preference, avatar_url, delivery_slot, family_member_count} — anything else a CRM wants to write back must go through a new server-side path."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/service.go:92-103","observation":"Consumer identity is issued as a self-contained HS256 JWT signed with consumerKey = auth.HMACHash(Cfg.JWTSecret, \"consumer-jwt-v1\") — HMAC domain separation making consumer tokens cryptographically disjoint from operator tokens. Claims: sub = account ObjectID hex, phone, kind=\"consumer\", iss=\"saathi-consumer\". Middleware is service.authenticate (plumbing.go), which puts a consumerActor{ID, Phone} on the request context; handlers call actorID(r).","why_it_matters":"A CRM-facing service cannot reuse operator middleware.Authenticate on consumer routes and vice versa — signature validation will fail. Any new CRM route must pick one auth model explicitly. There is no role/scope concept on consumer tokens at all: every authenticated shopper has identical privileges."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/subscriptions.go:86-108","observation":"The subscription lifecycle has no external notification of any kind: no event bus publish, no SSE push, no SMS, no webhook. Grep for Publish/eventbus/events across internal/modules/consumer returns ZERO hits — the entire consumer module is event-bus-silent, unlike the operator modules.","why_it_matters":"There is currently no subscribe/pause/cancel/renewal event stream for a CRM to consume. Introducing one means adding the first event-bus producer in this module; the natural emit points are createSubscription, setSubscriptionStatus, and sweepSubscriptionOrders step (2) LOCK."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/mandate.go:88-95, subscriptions.go:238-256, trial.go:52-56","observation":"There is one consistent idempotency idiom to copy: a stable string ref + a guarded single-document update. mandateChargeRef = \"mandate:<mandateID>:<YYYY-MM-DD IST>\"; delivery debit ref = \"delivery:<orderID>\"; trial key = \"sub:<consumerHex>:<YYYY-MM-DD IST>\"; the subscription day-claim is UpdateOne guarded on last_order_date $ne day; the trial ledger uses an explicit `seq` CAS. All money refs collapse onto the UNIQUE PARTIAL index (consumer_id, ref_id, type) on consumer_wallet_txns.","why_it_matters":"Any CRM sync-state should follow the same shape (a deterministic ref + a guarded write) rather than inventing a new one, and must never reuse an existing ref namespace — colliding with \"delivery:\"/\"mandate:\" would silently suppress a real debit."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go, leads.go:120-140","observation":"The existing Dolibarr ERP client is CATALOG/STOCK ONLY. Grepping dolibarr_sync.go for thirdparty/societe/customer/contact returns nothing — the integration mirrors sellable products inbound and posts a nightly net stock-out. The webhook route ignores its payload entirely and only calls svc.KickDolibarrSync(); config gates are DOLIBARR_URL + DOLIBARR_API_KEY (Cfg.DolibarrEnabled()), DOLIBARR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN (falls back to DOLIBARR_API_KEY), DOLIBARR_STORE_ID, DOLIBARR_SYNC_EVERY_SECONDS (default 20), DOLIBARR_STOCKOUT_HOUR_IST, DOLIBARR_OUT_WAREHOUSE_ID, DOLIBARR_POST_STOCKOUT.","why_it_matters":"If the CRM is Dolibarr, no thirdparty/contact plumbing exists yet — it must be built. The existing client, its auth (DOLAPIKEY header), its kick channel and its change-detected state doc in dolibarr_sync are the pieces to reuse. The webhook's \"payload is ignored, re-read the ERP as source of truth\" stance is a deliberate security property worth preserving for any inbound CRM webhook."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/service.go:120-160","observation":"Outbound SMS is platform/sms.MSG91, constructed as sms.NewMSG91(os.Getenv(\"MSG91_AUTHKEY\"), os.Getenv(\"MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID\")) and used ONLY for the login OTP, sent SYNCHRONOUSLY (deliberately bypassing the outbox worker). If not configured, requestOTP silently falls through to dev echo.","why_it_matters":"This is the only consumer-side SMS path and it is single-template. Any CRM campaign/notification SMS needs a new template id and should NOT reuse the synchronous OTP call path."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/lowstock.go:19-24","observation":"The only in-app notification fan-out in this module writes into the SHARED operator `notifications` collection with template_key \"STORE_LOW_STOCK\", one upserted row per SUPER_ADMIN/PCDF_ADMIN recipient, keyed on (party_id, template_key, store id) so a 12-second store poll is idempotent.","why_it_matters":"This is the working pattern for delivering a CRM alert to platform admins — reuse repository.adminRecipients + the same idempotent upsert key rather than inserting duplicate rows."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/service.go:29-51, 210-266","observation":"A permanently-enabled backdoor account exists: phone \"9999900000\" with fixed OTP \"123456\" (reviewLoginEnabled() hardcoded to return true, explicitly documented as a founder decision not to gate it behind an env flag). ensureReviewAccount creates \"+919999900000\"/\"Play Reviewer\", writes cash_balance directly up to a ₹500 floor with NO ledger row, and seeds a Lucknow address.","why_it_matters":"Any CRM sync of consumer_accounts or wallet analytics will ingest a synthetic customer whose wallet balance does not reconcile against consumer_wallet_txns. It must be excluded by phone."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/trial.go:63-72","observation":"Trial eligibility is decided by a string prefix: isTrialProduct(productID) == strings.HasPrefix(productID, \"gold-\"). Product ids are catalog SKU ids (e.g. gold-500ml, taaza-500ml). The delivery-side gate additionally requires lane==\"morning\" and a non-empty parent order subscription_id.","why_it_matters":"Any promo/offer eligibility a CRM wants to drive is currently encoded as a hardcoded SKU-id prefix in Go, with no campaign table and no feature flag. There is no flag system in this module at all — the only runtime switches are env vars (OTP_DEV_MODE, MANDATE_AUTODEBIT, CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE, CONSUMER_APP_KEY, DOLIBARR_*)."},{"file":"internal/modules/consumer/subscriptions.go:349-378","observation":"Subscription unit_price is resolved from the catalog ONCE at creation and then frozen on the subscription document; the sweep worker bills sub.UnitPrice forever, and patchSubscription cannot change the product or re-resolve the price.","why_it_matters":"A CRM/ERP price change never propagates to existing subscribers. Any pricing or churn analytics built on catalog price will disagree with what members are actually billed."}],"gotchas":["TRIAL POLARITY IS SELF-CONTRADICTORY ACROSS THREE PLACES. trial.go's file header says «the \"2+2\" welcome trial (2 FREE then 2 PAID)» and claims the engine was fixed to free-first, and delivery_svc.go:597 says «the first 2 delivered days are on us (effective 0), the next 2 pay full». The ACTUAL code does the opposite: trialApply (trial.go:143) returns fullAmount while deliveredPaid < trialPaidDays(2), then 0 while deliveredFree < trialFreeDays(2) — PAID-FIRST — and trialApply's own inline comment says «Paid days come first by design». trial_test.go pins paid-first explicitly (steps d1=full, d2=full, d3=0, d4=0, d5=full). So the tests and the code agree; two prominent comments lie. Do not trust the header comments when reasoning about billing.","MODULE.GO ROUTE COMMENT SAYS THE WRONG NUMBERS: the /trial/me comment reads «Subscription welcome trial (\"3 PAID then 3 FREE\")» while the constants are trialPaidDays = 2 and trialFreeDays = 2. Three different descriptions of the same offer live in the repo (2 free/2 paid, 2 paid/2 free, 3 paid/3 free); only 2 paid + 2 free is real.","CONFIRMED BUG — `delivery_date` NEVER APPEARS IN ORDER JSON. The order struct (orders.go) declares BOTH `DeliveryDate string bson:\"delivery_date,omitempty\" json:\"delivery_date,omitempty\"` and `ScheduledFor string bson:\"scheduled_for,omitempty\" json:\"delivery_date,omitempty\"`. Two fields at the same struct depth with the same JSON name make encoding/json drop BOTH (verified experimentally). The subscriptions.go comment explicitly relies on scheduled_for surfacing as delivery_date «so tomorrow's order shows as UPCOMING in the app from the moment it is scheduled» — it cannot, the key is absent from every order response.","MANDATE AUTO-DEBIT IS DELIBERATELY DISABLED IN PRODUCTION. mandateAutoRenewalWorker returns immediately unless env MANDATE_AUTODEBIT == \"true\", with the in-code audit note that runMandateCharge DEBITS the wallet for the mandate amount while subscription days are ALSO debited at delivery — a member with both active would be charged twice a day. The intended rework is for AutoPay to fund a wallet TOP-UP via the stored Razorpay token, not a per-day debit. So the entire mandate execution path is currently dead code in prod, reachable only via the dev-gated POST /mandate/{id}/execute.","dueMandates queries {status:\"active\", $or:[next_charge<=now, next_charge==nil]} and sorts by next_charge, but ensureMandateIndexes only creates unique mandate_id and (consumer_id, created_at). The sweep is a full collection scan.","SUBSCRIPTION LINE NAME IS CLIENT-SUPPLIED. createSubscription does `name := in.Name; if name == \"\" { name = in.ProductID }` and never calls priceIx.nameFor(). orders.go:272 DOES use nameFor, with catalog_price.go's comment stating the exact catalog name is «the store inventory's reconciliation key (deriveStock matches rows by name)». A subscription can therefore inject an arbitrary product name into the store console and orphan sold/held stock counts. Price is safe (server-resolved); name is not.","SUBSCRIPTION DELIVERY FEE IS HARDCODED 0 (subscriptionDeliveryFee), unlike one-off orders. This is intentional (the app quotes the bare subtotal on the Subscribe button) but means the wallet floor check `wv.Available >= o.Total` for a subscription is subtotal-only.","THE SCHEDULE PHASE HAS NO WALLET GATE, THE LOCK PHASE DOES. Tomorrow's preview order is created from 13:00 IST regardless of balance; at the first tick after IST midnight it only locks when Available >= total, and an unfunded preview is silently retried every 15 min until the day passes, at which point the EXPIRE step cancels it. A member who never tops up sees a phantom \"upcoming\" order all evening that quietly dies.","ASYMMETRIC DAY-CLAIM RELEASE: the RECONCILER releases the day claim when it cancels a preview (unclaimSubscriptionDay, so a resume before midnight re-schedules), but a SHOPPER's direct order cancel deliberately does NOT — that day stays permanently skipped. Response bodies capped at 4MB on GET / 1MB on POST via io.LimitReader. Endpoints used: GET /products (paged, mode=1, includestockdata=1, limit=100, sortfield=t.ref), GET /stockmovements (sqlfilters idempotency probe), POST /stockmovements, GET /documents (modulepart=product&ref=), GET /documents/download (modulepart=product&original_file=). Gate: `^(?:PRG|PYS)-[A-Z0-9-]+$`, applied AFTER ToUpper. Anything else (legacy demo rows like `Parag_Gold`) never enters the catalog."},{"term":"baseline vs addition","meaning":"The two sync modes. baseline = the ERP ref is in the curated dolibarrRefToSeedSku table (36 entries: 32 PRG + the 4 Pyaas twins) → only price / mrp / in_stock are mirrored as an OVERRIDE row; the seeded name, photo, category, subscribable flag are never touched. addition = everything else → a full catalogDoc with kind=\"addition\" and base_id = ERP ref."},{"term":"house-brand admission rule","meaning":"Commit 9192087 widened the gate to PYS-*; commit 19cb400 then mapped the 4 PYS refs that duplicate seeded Pyaas cards (PYS-TONED-1LTR/PP-500ML, PYS-A2-1LTR/PP-500ML) onto pyaas-toned-1l / pyaas-toned-pouch / pyaas-a2-1l / pyaas-a2-pouch as baselines, so the duplicate addition cards disappeared. PYS-*-CTN-500ML are genuinely new pack formats and stay additions. Family-fallback art is deliberately PRG-gated so a Pyaas card can never wear a Parag pack shot."},{"term":"family-fallback photo","meaning":"dolibarrFallbackSeedSku maps a PRG-<CAT> segment (21 segments) to a seeded product whose front+back art stands in when an ERP addition has no image of its own — so a new ERP product never renders an empty card. Guarded by TestDolibarrFallbackMapTargetsExistInSeed, which also asserts every category segment has a fallback except the PYS-only \"A2\"."},{"term":"HT pricing / vat-code GST","meaning":"The live instance stores prices EX-GST (price_base_type=HT) with tva_tx usually 0 and the real rate only encoded in default_vat_code (\"C+S-5\" = 5%, \"C+S-00\" = 0%). Consumer price = stored × (1+rate/100), with a 2-paise snap to whole rupees. Verified: PRG-PEDA-250GM 119.04762 → exactly ₹125 (the seeded price)."},{"term":"movementcode / inventorycode","meaning":"The idempotency key for outbound stock movements. Saathi sends it as `movementcode` in the POST body; Dolibarr stores it in the `inventorycode` column, which is why MovementExists filters on `(t.inventorycode:=:'<code>')`. Format: SAATHI-STKOUT-YYYY-MM-DD-<ERP-REF>."},{"term":"schema_v / shipped migration","meaning":"dolibarrSyncSchemaV (currently 4) is bumped whenever the SHAPE the sync writes changes. A state row with an older schema_v fails the unchanged-guard, forcing exactly one re-patch of its catalog row on the next tick — so schema migrations ship in code with zero manual DB edits. v2 = name/variant split + unit + back cover + mrp; v3 = family-fallback photos; v4 = ERP on-hand mirrored into inventory stock_count."},{"term":"one writer per direction","meaning":"The brief's hard rule encoded in the client's package doc: stock-IN / GRN is booked by a human in the Dolibarr UI and never by the API; the API only ever books the daily NET stock-out."}],"crm_relevant":[{"observation":"Dolibarr's CRM side is NOT touched at all today. Grep for thirdparties / thirdparty / contacts / proposals / invoices / commande over internal/platform/dolibarr and dolibarr_sync.go returns zero hits. The client exposes exactly five HTTP calls: GET /products, GET /stockmovements, POST /stockmovements, GET /documents, GET /documents/download.","file":"internal/platform/dolibarr/client.go","why_it_matters":"A CRM integration is greenfield on the ERP side. To reach Dolibarr's CRM you would add methods for: GET/POST/PUT /thirdparties (+ /thirdparties/{id}, ?sqlfilters on phone/email for lookup-or-create), GET/POST /contacts, GET/POST /proposals, GET/POST/PUT /orders (commandes) and /orders/{id}/close|validate, GET/POST /invoices (+ /invoices/{id}/payments), and GET /categories for segmentation. The transport (getJSON/postJSON) is reusable as-is but has NO PUT/PATCH/DELETE helper — you must add putJSON/deleteJSON, and getJSON's 404→(found=false, nil) contract is wrong for a single-entity GET where 404 genuinely means 'no such record' (it is currently indistinguishable from an empty list)."},{"observation":"Customer identity lives entirely in Mongo, in the consumer module's own namespace: `consumer_accounts` (type `account` in models.go) keyed by phone, with full_name, email (*string), alternate_phone, family_member_count, milk_preference, avatar_url, referral_code, delivery_slot, membership_tier, status, created_at/updated_at. Addresses are separate in `consumer_addresses`.","file":"internal/modules/consumer/models.go:30","why_it_matters":"This is the record a CRM `thirdparty`/`contact` would mirror. Phone is the natural business key (E.164-ish local numbers; OTP login is phone-first, email is optional and nullable). There is NO external-id field on `account` today — a CRM sync will need one (e.g. `crm_id`, `crm_synced_at`) or a side collection mirroring the dolibarr_sync pattern."},{"observation":"Two ready-made LEAD sources already exist and go nowhere but Mongo: POST /api/v1/consumer/partner-leads → `consumer_partner_leads` {kind, name, phone, email, business_name, city, message, details, created_at} (insert-only, no upsert, no dedupe), and POST /api/v1/consumer/wishlist/leads → `consumer_wishlist_leads` upserted per (user_id, product_id) with a `taps` counter. There is also a geofence waitlist (POST /consumer/waitlist, upsert by phone).","file":"internal/modules/consumer/leads.go:25","why_it_matters":"These are the obvious first CRM push targets (partner lead → Dolibarr thirdparty/prospect + a proposal; wishlist tap → an interest/opportunity note). Both handlers are gated only by `h.svc.appKeyOK(r)` (X-Parag-App-Key), not JWT — a partner lead is submitted signed-out, so the CRM record must be created from an anonymous submission with phone as the only identity."},{"observation":"Order and subscription lifecycle is Mongo-only. `consumer_orders` (const collOrders, orders.go:25) carries order_id (\"ord_<hex12>\"), user_id, status, subtotal/delivery_fee/monsoon_fee/total, payment_method, address_label/address_text, rider_id, placed_at, lane, delivery_date/scheduled_for, sub_locked_at, subscription_id, buyer_gstin, order_items[] {id, product_id, name, variant, price, qty}, plus owner-only consumer_name/phone/geo. Subscriptions live in `consumer_subscriptions` (subscriptions.go:45).","file":"internal/modules/consumer/orders.go:79","why_it_matters":"A CRM order/invoice mirror maps 1:1 onto this: order_id → external ref, order_items[].product_id → the same sku the dolibarr_sync state row already maps to a Dolibarr product id, buyer_gstin is already captured for B2B invoicing. Note the order carries NO ERP linkage field today — the only sku↔ERP bridge is `dolibarr_sync.sku_id → dolibarr_id`, and it is loaded wholesale into a `bySku` map at stock-out time (runDolibarrStockOut). Reuse that exact pattern."},{"observation":"The event bus (internal/platform/eventbus/bus.go) is an in-process async pub/sub with panic isolation and a bounded per-handler context, explicitly designed to be re-implemented over Kafka/NATS later. Topics today are ALL cooperative-side: pour.recorded, invoice.issued, qc.gate_blocked, qc.recorded, settlement.executed, settlement.changed, payout.credited, mvu.dispatched, mvu.closed, consignment.plant_accepted/rejected, qc.batch_recorded, batch.qr_minted, kyc.queue_changed.","file":"internal/platform/eventbus/bus.go:16","why_it_matters":"There is NO consumer/D2C topic — order.placed, order.delivered, subscription.created etc. do not exist on the bus, and the Dolibarr integration does not publish or subscribe to anything. A CRM integration that wants to react to order/lead events must either add topics (Subscribe must be called during module wiring, NOT concurrently with Publish) or copy the Dolibarr approach: a polling worker + a state collection."},{"observation":"Idempotency + sync-state pattern worth copying verbatim: (1) a per-entity state doc keyed by the EXTERNAL id (_id = ERP ref) holding the last-mirrored values, so every pass is change-detected and writes nothing when nothing moved; (2) `schema_v` on that doc so a shape change forces exactly one re-patch per row — migrations ship in code, never as manual DB edits; (3) query-before-write idempotency enforced INSIDE the client (PostStockOut refuses to post until MovementExists proves the code is unused), not trusted to callers; (4) `updated_by = \"dolibarr-sync\"` stamped on every mirrored row so human edits stay distinguishable; (5) success-only cursor marking (`lastRun = today` only after a clean run).","file":"internal/modules/consumer/dolibarr_sync.go:227","why_it_matters":"These five are exactly the primitives a CRM sync needs (customer upsert idempotency, retry safety, migration path, audit trail). Copy them; do NOT copy the omitempty bug described in gotchas."},{"observation":"Feature gating is by env presence, not by the flags service: `Config.DolibarrEnabled()` = DolibarrURL != \"\" && DolibarrAPIKey != \"\"; module.go only spawns the workers behind that check, and the write lane has a second explicit gate (DolibarrPostStockOut, default false = DRY-RUN log only). The DB-backed flags service (internal/platform/flags, collection `feature_flags`) has FlagConsumerCommerce/FlagONDC/FlagPhotoOCR/FlagCollarTelemetry but is NOT used by Dolibarr.","file":"internal/modules/consumer/module.go:63","why_it_matters":"Mirror this for CRM: env-presence for 'is it configured', plus a separate default-OFF boolean for 'may it actually WRITE to the external system'. The dry-run-first pattern (log the exact payload, post nothing) is what let the ERP write lane ship safely."},{"observation":"Notification/SMS path: the only outbound messaging platform package is internal/platform/sms/msg91.go (MSG91 v5 OTP endpoint, SendOTP only — no transactional/marketing send). Notifications otherwise go through the platformops module's in-app inbox driven by event-bus topics.","file":"internal/platform/sms/msg91.go:21","why_it_matters":"A CRM that wants to trigger campaigns/reminders has no generic SMS send to reuse — MSG91 here is OTP-template-only. Either extend that package or drive messaging from the CRM side."},{"observation":"Server-side price authority (catalog_price.go) resolves every order/subscription line price from the catalog rows the ERP sync writes: buildPriceIndex folds catalog docs oldest→newest so a later write wins, an override's price beats the seeded price (that is how ERP prices reach seeded SKUs), a hidden sku is not purchasable at all, and an unknown product_id is rejected rather than guessed. nameFor() pins the order-line name to the EXACT catalog name because the store inventory reconciles by name.","file":"internal/modules/consumer/catalog_price.go:38","why_it_matters":"Money is already ERP-authoritative end to end — a CRM must not become a second price writer. Also note loadPriceIndex does a FULL catalog scan per order/subscription creation (comment says '109 rows today'); adding many CRM-sourced catalog rows would make that hot path expensive."}],"gotchas":["BSON `omitempty` on the state struct silently breaks change-detection for zero values, causing permanent write churn. `saveDolibarrState` does `UpdateByID(ref, {$set: st})` with the WHOLE struct, and dolibarrSyncState declares `MRP float64 bson:\"mrp,omitempty\"`, `HiddenBySync bool bson:\"hidden_by_sync,omitempty\"`, `Stock int64 bson:\"stock,omitempty\"`, `PhotoURL string bson:\"photo_url,omitempty\"`. So a transition to zero is NEVER persisted: e.g. once a ref goes hidden_by_sync=true, saving state with HiddenBySync=false omits the field and the stored `true` survives — the unchanged-guard (`!st.HiddenBySync`) then fails on EVERY subsequent pass, so the override/patch is rewritten and 'back in stock' / unhide is logged every 20 seconds forever. Same for mrp dropping to 0 (the deliberate 'clear the stale strikethrough' case), stock dropping to 0, and a photo being removed.","syncAddition's INSERT branch saves state WITHOUT Stock and with `PhotoURL: front` (the possibly-fallback path), while the UPDATE branch saves `PhotoURL: erpFront` (ERP-only) and Stock. So the state row written on first sight is inconsistent with the one written on update, and a newly-inserted product with non-zero ERP stock always takes one extra redundant patch on the following pass (st.Stock==0 != stock).","`saveDolibarrState` puts `_id` inside the `$set` document (Ref has `bson:\"_id\"` and the whole struct is the $set payload). MongoDB tolerates this only because the value is identical to the filter's _id; any refactor that changes the key would hard-fail with ImmutableField.","dolibarr_sync has NO indexes beyond _id, and the sweep does a full `Find({})` + `cur.All` of the collection on EVERY pass (every 20s), plus another full read per stock-out run. Fine at ~70 rows, not fine if the ref namespace grows.","render.yaml contains ZERO DOLIBARR_* env vars, and neither .env nor .env.example mentions Dolibarr. The integration is therefore OFF on a fresh Blueprint deploy and must be configured by hand in the Render dashboard. There is no `sync: false` placeholder to remind anyone it exists.","`DolibarrStoreID` defaults to the hardcoded Mongo ObjectID hex string \"6a53fb242b4fd88066524d41\" (config.go:95). If that store does not exist in a given environment, every addition/override is written under a phantom store_id and silently never surfaces.","Both docs the code cites as authority are ABSENT from the repo: `docs/dolibarr-sync.md` (referenced from client.go's package doc, config.go and dolibarr_sync.go) and `docs/Pyaas_Dolibarr_WriteAPI_Enablement_Brief`. The comments are the only spec.","catalog.go:177 still carries a 'DOLIBARR-SYNC seam (NOT integrated) … Nothing here calls Dolibarr today — this is a documented seam only' block. It is stale — the sync has been live since commit 1745c2a and does use insertAddition/patchExisting exactly as the note predicted (it never uses pushVariants, though: ERP variants/combinations are NOT synced at all; each ERP pack size becomes its own addition and is only visually grouped via the name/variant label split).","LIVE-ERP QUIRK 1 (commit f9ca6de): `datem` on Dolibarr 23.0.3 is DATE-ONLY. The first real stock-out 400'd on 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; the fixed movement (id=182) verified only after switching to 'YYYY-MM-DD'.","LIVE-ERP QUIRK 2 (commit 344f3e6): the ledger row's label is persisted from the `label` field, NOT `movementlabel` — 23.0.3 accepts `movementlabel` but drops it. PostStockOut now sends BOTH (verified via SAATHI-TEST-OUT-1).","LIVE-ERP QUIRK 3: the production instance intermittently prefixes EVERY HTTP response with 'Failed to write to log file dolibarr.log' lines; cleanJSON() strips anything before the first '{' or '['. A response that is a bare JSON scalar (POST /stockmovements returns e.g. `7`) would not be cleaned — harmless only because postJSON never decodes the body.","LIVE-ERP QUIRK 4: Dolibarr list endpoints return HTTP 404 for ZERO ROWS. getJSON maps 404 → (found=false, err=nil), so a genuinely-broken/renamed endpoint is indistinguishable from an empty result and the sync just does nothing, quietly.","LIVE-ERP QUIRK 5: numerics come back as strings with 8 decimals (\"35.00000000\"), as JSON numbers, or as null — hence the custom `Num` type. Any new field must use Num, not float64/int64.","`MovementExists` interpolates the code straight into a sqlfilters string with only `'` stripped: `fmt.Sprintf(\"(t.inventorycode:=:'%s')\", strings.ReplaceAll(code, \"'\", \"\"))`. The code is server-generated today (SAATHI-STKOUT-<date>-<ref>) so it is safe, but it is a hand-rolled quoting scheme, not a parameterised query.","The client has NO retries, NO backoff and NO circuit breaker; a single flat 20s http.Client timeout covers every call. A slow ERP simply makes each pass take longer, and passes can overlap only via the kick channel (the loop itself is strictly serial).","dolibarrImage constructs a BRAND-NEW dolibarr.Client on every single image request instead of reusing one, so no connection pooling for the proxy path. The cache holds at most 64 images while the live range is ~63 products × up to 2 covers — it will thrash.","The dolimg proxy is fully PUBLIC (no JWT, no X-Parag-App-Key). Traversal is blocked via '..' checks after PathUnescape and a '/' check on the file segment — but the FOLDER segment is not checked for '/', so a %2F in the folder yields a multi-segment path (still confined under modulepart=product).","The webhook token comparison is a plain `!=` (not hmac.Equal), and when DOLIBARR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is unset it silently falls back to using the DOLAPIKEY itself as the URL query token — i.e. the ERP API key ends up in webhook URLs and access logs.","The stock-out aggregation matches on `updated_at` within yesterday's IST window, not on a delivery timestamp. Any post-delivery mutation of the order (a review, a status touch) moves updated_at and can drop the order out of yesterday's window (under-count) or into a later day's window (that day's movement over-counts). The movementcode only guarantees one movement per (sku, date) — it does NOT guarantee the quantity was right.","Quantity mapping is `bySku[st.SkuID]` built from ALL state rows; if two ERP refs ever resolved to the same sku_id the last one read wins silently. Fair-use caps maxQtyPerProduct=10, maxItemsPerOrder=30; delivery fee ₹15, free ≥ ₹199.","key_fields":["order_id \"ord_<hex>\" (unique)","user_id hex string","status placed|confirmed|assigned|preparing|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled","subtotal","delivery_fee","monsoon_fee","total","payment_method","address_label","address_text","rider_id","placed_at","priority","delivery_window","delivery_date","buyer_gstin","proof_photo_url","lane instant|morning","trial_free bool (display/analytics only — never gates the wallet or the hold)","order_items []{id,product_id,name,variant,price,qty}","riders (embedded rider summary)","can_review","review{rating,comment,created_at}","consumer_name / phone / geo (json:\"-\" — owner-facing PII never returned to the shopper)","subscription_id","scheduled_for","sub_locked_at","created_at","updated_at"],"indexes":"unique {order_id}; {user_id,placed_at:-1}"},{"name":"consumer_deliveries","kind":"mongo","purpose":"CONSUMER last-mile task, but operated by SAATHI OPERATORS (STORE_MANAGER / DELIVERY_RIDER with operator JWTs and the operator {data} envelope). consumer.delivery — bson is snake_case storage, json is the camelCase FE Delivery shape. order_id→consumer_orders; store_id→org_units (OPERATOR); rider_party_id→parties (OPERATOR).","key_fields":["delivery_id \"del_<hex>\" (unique)","order_id (unique)","order_code","store_id (org_units STORE hex)","rider_party_id (parties hex)","consumer_id (hex string)","consumer_name","phone_masked / phone","address_label","address_line","landmark","geo{lat,lng}","items[]{name,qty}","amount","payment_mode","trial_eligible","perishable","slot","lane","eta_at (placed_at + 20 min, instant only)","distance_km","status (incl. OFFERED for the auto-dispatch broadcast)","assigned_at","offered_at","accepted_at","rejected_by [] (riders who declined — never re-offered)","reoffer_count","out_for_delivery_at","delivered_at","proof_note","proof_photo_uri","proof_geo","last_known_geo","last_location_at","failure_reason","delivery_event_id"],"indexes":"unique {delivery_id}; {store_id,assigned_at}; {rider_party_id}; unique {order_id}"},{"name":"consumer_rider_presence","kind":"mongo","purpose":"CONSUMER. The rider's LIVE duty position, upserted from the fix sent with every ~8 s offer poll, so the 15 km offer fence and the manager's assign ranking judge the rider where they are RIGHT NOW rather than where their last delivery ended. party_id→parties (OPERATOR).","key_fields":["party_id (parties hex)","lat","lng","at (RFC3339 STRING, not a time.Time)"],"indexes":"unique {party_id}"},{"name":"consumer_catalog","kind":"mongo","purpose":"CONSUMER catalog OVERLAY — one collection, three kinds of row: seeded baseline products (kind=\"product\", store_id=\"_global\", served only when CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE=true), per-store price/stock/visibility overrides (kind=\"override\") and store-added SKUs (kind=\"addition\"). consumer.catalogDoc. NOTE the name breaks the consumer_* convention.","key_fields":["store_id","active","center (GeoJSON Point [lng,lat])","instant_radius_m","standard_radius_m (bounds 100 m – 60 km)","monsoon_enabled","monsoon_rupees (charged on INSTANT orders only)","instant_open_min / instant_close_min (minutes since IST midnight; close==0 = no hours gating)","instant_paused","include_pincodes []","exclude_pincodes []","include_polygons [][]geoPt","exclude_polygons [][]geoPt (holes that deny even inside a serving circle)","updated_by","updated_at"],"indexes":"unique {store_id}; 2dsphere {center} (for future server-side $near routing — all current point tests run in Go); {active}"},{"name":"consumer_waitlist","kind":"mongo","purpose":"CONSUMER. Out-of-area demand capture written by POST /consumer/waitlist when a shopper falls outside the fence; upserted by phone with a hit counter so repeat submissions read as intensity, never duplicates. NO read route exists — nothing consumes these rows. The phone is NOT joined to consumer_accounts or parties.","key_fields":["phone (normalised 10-digit)","pincode","name","lat","lng","hits ($inc per submission)","created_at","updated_at"],"indexes":"unique {phone}"},{"name":"consumer_partner_leads","kind":"mongo","purpose":"CONSUMER. \"Partner with us\" enquiries (bulk order / franchise / vendor), app-key-gated so a signed-out prospect can submit.
