243	func (s *service) createOrder(ctx context.Context, userID string, in orderInput) (*order, error) {
244		if len(in.Items) == 0 {
245			return nil, errBadRequest("an order needs at least one item")
246		}
247		// Money is recomputed SERVER-SIDE: the client-supplied `total` is ignored
248		// AND every unit price comes from the server's own catalog
249		// (catalog_price.go) — a tampered client can neither deflate nor inflate a
250		// line ("₹0 milk" closed). Unknown or hidden products are rejected, never
251		// guessed.
252		priceIx, err := s.loadPriceIndex(ctx)
253		if err != nil {
254			return nil, err
255		}
256		var subtotal float64
257		var units int
258		items := make([]orderItem, 0, len(in.Items))
259		for _, it := range in.Items {
260			if it.Qty <= 0 {
261				return nil, errBadRequest("invalid order item")
262			}
263			if it.Qty > maxQtyPerProduct {
264				return nil, errBadRequest("quantity per item exceeds the limit")
265			}
266			// SERVER-AUTHORITATIVE PRICE: the catalog's price index is the one billed —
267			// the client's number is display-only, and unknown ids are refused.
268			price, ok := priceIx.priceFor(it.ProductID, it.Variant)
269			if !ok {
270				return nil, errBadRequest("unknown product in order: " + it.ProductID)
271			}
272			name := priceIx.nameFor(it.ProductID)
273			if name == "" {
274				name = it.Name // catalog rows without a name keep the client label
275			}
276			units += it.Qty
277			subtotal += price * float64(it.Qty)
278			items = append(items, orderItem{
279				ID: newItemID(), ProductID: it.ProductID, Name: name, Variant: it.Variant, Price: round2(price), Qty: it.Qty,
280			})
281		}
282		if units > maxItemsPerOrder {
283			return nil, errBadRequest("too many items in one order")
284		}
285		subtotal = round2(subtotal)
286		fee := deliveryFeeFor(subtotal)
287		total := round2(subtotal + fee)
288		// Payment mode defaults to 'wallet' — the order is settled from the server
289		// wallet on delivery (the settle sweep debits /wallet/debit, idempotent by
290		// order id). A client may pass another mode (e.g. 'cod', or 'gateway' once the
291		// /orders/{id}/pay direct-pay seam is wired to verify).
292		pm := in.PaymentMethod
293		if pm == "" {
294			pm = "wallet"
295		}
296		// Delivery lane: "morning" (5–7:30 subscription run) is the DEFAULT — the
297		// instant ≈20-min lane is an explicit, validated opt-in (an unknown value
298		// must never accidentally mint an instant ETA).
299		lane := in.Lane
300		if lane != "instant" {
301			lane = "morning"
302		}
303		// Monsoon surcharge: INSTANT orders only, and only if the store manager enabled
304		// it on the delivery location's zone. Authoritative here — read from the zone,
305		// never trusted from the client payload, so a tampered client cannot skip it.
306		monsoonFee := 0.0
307		if lane == "instant" && in.Geo != nil {
308			if sv, sErr := s.serviceability(ctx, in.Geo.Lat, in.Geo.Lng, ""); sErr == nil {
309				// Store shut for the night / paused → refuse instant (defence in depth;
310				// the consumer already hides it, but a stale client must not slip through).
311				if sv.InstantClosed {
312					return nil, errUnprocessable("INSTANT_CLOSED", "instant delivery is closed right now; please choose the morning slot")
313				}
314				if sv.MonsoonEnabled && sv.MonsoonRupees > 0 {
315					monsoonFee = float64(sv.MonsoonRupees)
316				}
317			}
318		}
319		total = round2(total + monsoonFee)
320		priority := in.Priority
321		if priority == "" {
322			priority = "normal"
323		}
324		// Scheduled morning date: validate against IST — tomorrow through +7 days.
325		// (Instant orders never carry one; the FE sends null.) Invalid input is
326		// rejected loudly instead of silently becoming a due-now delivery.
327		deliveryDate := strings.TrimSpace(in.DeliveryDate)
328		if deliveryDate != "" && lane == "morning" {
329			d, derr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", deliveryDate, istZone)
330			if derr != nil {
331				return nil, errBadRequest("delivery_date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
332			}
333			ist := time.Now().In(istZone)
334			today0 := time.Date(ist.Year(), ist.Month(), ist.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, istZone)
335			if d.Before(today0.AddDate(0, 0, 1)) || d.After(today0.AddDate(0, 0, 7)) {
336				return nil, errUnprocessable("BAD_DELIVERY_DATE", "pick a morning between tomorrow and 7 days from now")
337			}
338		} else {
339			deliveryDate = ""
340		}
341		now := time.Now().UTC()
342		o := &order{
343			MongoID: primitive.NewObjectID(), OrderID: newOrderID(), UserID: userID, Status: "placed",
344			Subtotal: subtotal, DeliveryFee: fee, MonsoonFee: monsoonFee, Total: total, PaymentMethod: pm,
345			AddressLabel: in.AddressLabel, AddressText: in.AddressText, RiderID: nil,
346			PlacedAt: now, Priority: priority, DeliveryWindow: in.DeliveryWindow, Lane: lane,
347			DeliveryDate: deliveryDate, BuyerGSTIN: strings.TrimSpace(in.BuyerGSTIN),
348			Items: items, Rider: nil, CanReview: false, Review: nil,
349			ConsumerName: in.ConsumerName, Phone: in.Phone, Geo: in.Geo, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
350		}
351		if err := s.repo.insertOrder(ctx, o); err != nil {
352			return nil, err
353		}
354		// Create the last-mile delivery task (routed to the nearest Parag Store,
355		// unassigned until a store manager assigns a rider). Best-effort.
356		s.createDeliveryForOrder(ctx, o)
357		return o, nil
358	}

368	func (s *service) cancelOrder(ctx context.Context, userID, orderID string) (*order, error) {
369		// Guard: only placed/confirmed orders may cancel — the $in precondition makes
370		// this atomic (no cancelling an order that just went out for delivery).
371		o, err := s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, orderID, userID,
372			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "cancelled"}},
373			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: bson.A{"placed", "confirmed"}}}}},
374		)
375		if err != nil {
376			return nil, err
377		}
378		// A cancelled order must not leave a LIVE delivery task behind — otherwise a
379		// rider could still deliver it, debit the wallet, and flip the order back to
380		// delivered. Fail the task (guarded: never touch one already terminal).
381		if d, _ := s.repo.findDeliveryByOrder(ctx, orderID); d != nil && d.Status != "DELIVERED" && d.Status != "FAILED" {
382			_, _ = s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, d.ID,
383				bson.D{
384					{Key: "status", Value: "FAILED"},
385					{Key: "failure_reason", Value: "Order cancelled by the customer"},
386					{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
387				},
388				bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"DELIVERED", "FAILED"}}}}},
389			)
390		}
391		return o, nil
392	}
393	
394	func (s *service) reviewOrder(ctx context.Context, userID, orderID string, rating int, comment string) (*order, error) {
395		if rating < 1 || rating > 5 {
396			return nil, errBadRequest("rating must be 1–5")
397		}
398		// Only a DELIVERED order can be reviewed.
399		return s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, orderID, userID,
400			bson.D{
401				{Key: "review", Value: orderReview{Rating: rating, Comment: comment, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC()}},
402				{Key: "can_review", Value: false},
403			},
404			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "delivered"}},
405		)
406	}
407	
408	// advanceOrder is a DEV-only status transition (rider/store surfaces own the real
409	// transitions in a later phase). Gated by OTP dev mode so it never exists in prod.
410	func (s *service) advanceOrder(ctx context.Context, userID, orderID, status string) (*order, error) {
411		if !s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
412			return nil, errForbidden("not available")
413		}
414		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: status}}
415		switch status {
416		case "out_for_delivery":
417			demoID := "rider-demo"
418			veh := "Bike · UP32 CD 5678"
419			rating := 4.8
420			lat, lng := 26.8467, 80.9462
421			set = append(set,
422				bson.E{Key: "rider_id", Value: &demoID},
423				bson.E{Key: "riders", Value: &rider{ID: demoID, FullName: "Ram Kumar", Phone: "+919999900000", Vehicle: &veh, Rating: &rating, CurrentLat: &lat, CurrentLng: &lng}},
424			)
425		case "delivered":
426			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "can_review", Value: true})
427		}
428		return s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, orderID, userID, set, bson.D{})
429	}

669: 
670: // debit spends `amount` from the wallet (promo-first) for a purchase/delivery.
671: // EXACTLY-ONCE by ref: a DEBIT gate row is inserted first (unique consumer+ref+
672: // type), so a retried settle sweep for the same order can never double-charge.
673: // The balance move is a single atomic guarded update that fails closed on
674: // insufficient funds. If the move does NOT happen (insufficient funds or a
675: // transient error) the gate row is rolled back on a DETACHED context — a
676: // cancelled request can't orphan it — so a later top-up + retry still charges.
677: func (s *service) debit(ctx context.Context, consumerID primitive.ObjectID, amount float64, ref, remark string) (walletView, error) {
678: 	amount = round2(amount)
679: 	if amount <= 0 {
680: 		return walletView{}, errBadRequest("amount must be positive")
681: 	}
682: 	if ref == "" {
683: 		return walletView{}, errBadRequest("a debit reference (ref) is required")
684: 	}
685: 	now := time.Now().UTC()
686: 	// Pre-read the balances so the ledger row records the bucket the debit
687: 	// actually drew from (promo-first). Money correctness does NOT depend on this
688: 	// read — the atomic guarded update below is the authority; this only labels
689: 	// the ledger row for display.
690: 	pre, _ := s.getOrCreateWallet(ctx, consumerID)
691: 	bucket := "CASH"
692: 	if pre != nil && pre.RewardsBalance >= amount {
693: 		bucket = "REWARDS" // fully covered by promo
694: 	}
695: 	gate := walletTxn{
696: 		ID: primitive.NewObjectID(), ConsumerID: consumerID,
697: 		Type: "DEBIT", Bucket: bucket, Amount: amount, RefType: "order", RefID: ref, Status: "SUCCESS", Remark: remark, CreatedAt: now,
698: 	}
699: 	dup, err := s.repo.insertWalletTxnGate(ctx, gate)
700: 	if err != nil {
701: 		return walletView{}, err
702: 	}
703: 	if dup {
704: 		wl, e := s.getOrCreateWallet(ctx, consumerID)
705: 		if e != nil {
706: 			return walletView{}, e
707: 		}
708: 		return walletToView(wl), nil // already debited — idempotent
709: 	}
710: 	updated, ok, err := s.repo.debitWalletAtomic(ctx, consumerID, amount, 1)
711: 	if err != nil || !ok {
712: 		// No money moved — roll back the gate on a detached context so a
713: 		// cancelled/timed-out request context cannot orphan it (an orphan would
714: 		// permanently short-circuit a future retry as "already debited").
715: 		rbCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
716: 		s.repo.deleteWalletTxn(rbCtx, gate.ID)
717: 		cancel()
718: 		if err != nil {
719: 			return walletView{}, err
720: 		}
721: 		return walletView{}, errUnprocessable("INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS", "wallet balance is too low for this order")
722: 	}
723: 	s.repo.updateWalletTxnBalances(ctx, gate.ID, updated.ID, updated.Seq, updated.CashBalance, updated.RewardsBalance)
724: 	return walletToView(updated), nil
725: }

16	// Consumer home-delivery (last mile). The store manager and delivery rider are
17	// SAATHI operators (onboarded via KYC, STORE-scoped roles) — these routes reuse
18	// Saathi's operator auth (Authenticate + RequireRoles) and the operator wire
19	// format ({data} envelope, camelCase, {error} on failure) because they are
20	// consumed by the Saathi FE client (delivery.ts / store.ts, service:'consumer').
21	//
22	// Flow: consumer places an order (consumer app) → a delivery task is created for
23	// the nearest Parag Store → the store manager assigns a rider (nearest 15/30/60
24	// km tier; distance behind a maps seam) → the rider accepts → picks up (out for
25	// delivery, streams location) → delivers with photo+geo proof → the consumer's
26	// wallet is debited EXACTLY ONCE (same order-derived ref as settleDeliveredOrders)
27	// and the consumer sees the order 'delivered'. Riders are salaried — no
28	// delivery-payment logic here.

116	func newDeliveryID() string {
117		b := make([]byte, 6)
118		_, _ = rand.Read(b)
119		return "del_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
120	}

122	func maskPhone(p string) string {
123		d := p
124		if len(d) >= 10 {
125			d = d[len(d)-10:]
126			return d[:2] + "XXXXX" + d[7:]
127		}
128		return "XXXXXXXXXX"
129	}

131	// haversineKm — great-circle distance between two lat/lng points (the maps seam
132	// currently uses this on-device coords; a real maps/distance API drops in later).
133	func haversineKm(a, b geoPt) float64 {
134		const R = 6371.0
135		dLat := (b.Lat - a.Lat) * math.Pi / 180
136		dLng := (b.Lng - a.Lng) * math.Pi / 180
137		la1 := a.Lat * math.Pi / 180
138		la2 := b.Lat * math.Pi / 180
139		h := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) + math.Cos(la1)*math.Cos(la2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)
140		return 2 * R * math.Asin(math.Sqrt(h))
141	}

145	func (r *repository) ensureDeliveryIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
146		_, err := r.deliveries.Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, []mongo.IndexModel{
147			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "delivery_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
148			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "store_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "assigned_at", Value: 1}}},
149			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: 1}}},
150			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
151		})
152		if err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		_, err = r.riderPresence.Indexes().CreateOne(ctx, mongo.IndexModel{
156			Keys: bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true),
157		})
158		return err
159	}

161	// upsertRiderPresence records the rider's live duty position (one row per rider).
162	func (r *repository) upsertRiderPresence(ctx context.Context, partyID string, g geoPt, at time.Time) {
163		upsert := true
164		_, _ = r.riderPresence.UpdateOne(ctx,
165			bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}},
166			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
167				{Key: "lat", Value: g.Lat},
168				{Key: "lng", Value: g.Lng},
169				{Key: "at", Value: at.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)},
170			}}},
171			&options.UpdateOptions{Upsert: &upsert})
172	}

209	// recentFulfillableOrders returns still-open orders (for backfilling any that

211	// Subscription-scheduled orders are EXCLUDED: their delivery task is created by
212	// the subscription worker at the midnight lock, never earlier — the backfill

263	func (r *repository) updateDelivery(ctx context.Context, id string, set bson.D, guard bson.D) (*delivery, error) {
264		filter := append(bson.D{{Key: "delivery_id", Value: id}}, guard...)
265		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()})
266		after := options.After
267		var d delivery
268		err := r.deliveries.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
269			&options.FindOneAndUpdateOptions{ReturnDocument: &after}).Decode(&d)
270		if isNoDocs(err) {
271			return nil, errConflict("INVALID_STATE", "delivery is not in a valid state for this action")
272		}
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, errInternal("delivery update failed")
275		}
276		return &d, nil
277	}

279	// claimDelivery is the FIRST-ACCEPT-WINS atomic claim. The first rider whose call
280	// matches {OFFERED, no rider, not already declined by them} flips it to ACCEPTED and
281	// wins; every later caller matches nothing and gets a conflict. Single-writer via
282	// one Mongo FindOneAndUpdate — correct across replicas with no external lock/Redis.
283	func (r *repository) claimDelivery(ctx context.Context, id, riderPartyID string, now time.Time) (*delivery, error) {
284		after := options.After
285		var d delivery
286		err := r.deliveries.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
287			bson.D{
288				{Key: "delivery_id", Value: id},
289				{Key: "status", Value: "OFFERED"},
290				{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: ""},
291				{Key: "rejected_by", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: riderPartyID}}},
292			},
293			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
294				{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: riderPartyID},
295				{Key: "status", Value: "ACCEPTED"},
296				{Key: "assigned_at", Value: now.Format(time.RFC3339)},
297				{Key: "accepted_at", Value: now.Format(time.RFC3339)},
298				{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
299			}}},
300			&options.FindOneAndUpdateOptions{ReturnDocument: &after},
301		).Decode(&d)
302		if isNoDocs(err) {
303			return nil, errConflict("CLAIMED_BY_OTHER", "another rider already took this order")
304		}
305		if err != nil {
306			return nil, errInternal("delivery claim failed")
307		}
308		return &d, nil
309	}
310	
311	// rejectOffer atomically returns a rider's accepted-but-declined task to the OFFERED
312	// pool (a re-broadcast), records the decline so it's never re-offered to that rider,
313	// and bumps the re-offer counter. Guarded to the current owner + pre-pickup states so
314	// it can never race a pickup/delivery.
315	func (r *repository) rejectOffer(ctx context.Context, id, riderPartyID string, now time.Time) (*delivery, error) {
316		after := options.After
317		var d delivery
318		err := r.deliveries.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
319			bson.D{
320				{Key: "delivery_id", Value: id},
321				{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: riderPartyID},
322				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: bson.A{"ACCEPTED", "ASSIGNED"}}}},
323			},
324			bson.D{
325				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
326					{Key: "status", Value: "OFFERED"},
327					{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: ""},
328					{Key: "offered_at", Value: now.Format(time.RFC3339)},
329					{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
330				}},
331				{Key: "$addToSet", Value: bson.D{{Key: "rejected_by", Value: riderPartyID}}},
332				{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "reoffer_count", Value: 1}}},
333			},
334			&options.FindOneAndUpdateOptions{ReturnDocument: &after},
335		).Decode(&d)
336		if isNoDocs(err) {
337			return nil, errConflict("INVALID_STATE", "this order can no longer be declined")
338		}
339		if err != nil {
340			return nil, errInternal("delivery reject failed")
341		}
342		return &d, nil
343	}

346	func (r *repository) storesForRider(ctx context.Context, riderPartyID string) ([]string, error) {
347		oid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(riderPartyID)
348		if err != nil {
349			return nil, errBadRequest("bad rider id")
350		}
351		cur, err := r.roleAssignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{
352			{Key: "party_id", Value: oid}, {Key: "role_code", Value: "DELIVERY_RIDER"}, {Key: "status", Value: "ACTIVE"},
353		})
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, errInternal("rider store lookup failed")
356		}
357		var rows []struct {
358			OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"org_unit_id"`
359		}
360		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
361			return nil, errInternal("rider store decode failed")
362		}
363		ids := make([]string, 0, len(rows))
364		for _, x := range rows {
365			ids = append(ids, x.OrgUnitID.Hex())
366		}
367		return ids, nil
368	}

404	// nearestStore returns the closest active STORE org id to a point (or the first
405	// store if the point has no geo). One integration seam for many stores later.
406	func (r *repository) nearestStore(ctx context.Context, at *geoPt) (string, geoPt, error) {
407		cur, err := r.orgUnits.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: "STORE"}, {Key: "active", Value: true}})
408		if err != nil {
409			return "", geoPt{}, errInternal("store lookup failed")
410		}
411		var stores []struct {
412			ID  primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
413			Lat float64            `bson:"geo_lat"`
414			Lng float64            `bson:"geo_lng"`
415		}
416		if err := cur.All(ctx, &stores); err != nil || len(stores) == 0 {
417			return "", geoPt{}, errNotFound("no serving store")
418		}
419		best := 0
420		if at != nil {
421			bestD := math.MaxFloat64
422			for i, s := range stores {
423				d := haversineKm(*at, geoPt{Lat: s.Lat, Lng: s.Lng})
424				if d < bestD {
425					bestD, best = d, i
426				}
427			}
428		}
429		s := stores[best]
430		return s.ID.Hex(), geoPt{Lat: s.Lat, Lng: s.Lng}, nil
431	}
432	
433	// geoSane rejects out-of-range and Null-Island (0,0 = missing geo) coordinates,
434	// so a store that was never given a centre can't win "nearest".
435	func geoSane(lat, lng float64) bool {
436		if lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180 {
437			return false
438		}
439		return !(lat == 0 && lng == 0)
440	}
441	
442	// nearestStoreNamed returns the closest active STORE org-unit WITH a usable geo to
443	// a point, plus its display name and the great-circle distance in km. ok=false
444	// when no store has valid coordinates (caller then keeps the pilot fail-open).
445	func (r *repository) nearestStoreNamed(ctx context.Context, at geoPt) (storeID, name string, geo geoPt, distanceKm float64, ok bool, err error) {
446		cur, e := r.orgUnits.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: "STORE"}, {Key: "active", Value: true}})
447		if e != nil {
448			return "", "", geoPt{}, 0, false, errInternal("store lookup failed")
449		}
450		var stores []struct {
451			ID   primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
452			Name string             `bson:"name"`
453			Lat  float64            `bson:"geo_lat"`
454			Lng  float64            `bson:"geo_lng"`
455		}
456		if e := cur.All(ctx, &stores); e != nil {
457			return "", "", geoPt{}, 0, false, errInternal("store decode failed")
458		}
459		bestD := math.MaxFloat64
460		for _, s := range stores {
461			if !geoSane(s.Lat, s.Lng) {
462				continue
463			}
464			d := haversineKm(at, geoPt{Lat: s.Lat, Lng: s.Lng})
465			if d < bestD {
466				bestD = d
467				storeID, name, geo, ok = s.ID.Hex(), s.Name, geoPt{Lat: s.Lat, Lng: s.Lng}, true
468			}
469		}
470		distanceKm = bestD
471		if !ok {
472			distanceKm = 0
473		}
474		return storeID, name, geo, distanceKm, ok, nil
475	}
476	
477	// storeName resolves a STORE org-unit's display name (for the serviceability +
478	// Coming-Soon copy). ok=false when the id is unknown.
479	func (r *repository) storeName(ctx context.Context, storeID string) (string, bool) {
480		oid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(storeID)
481		if err != nil {
482			return "", false
483		}
484		var doc struct {
485			Name string `bson:"name"`
486		}
487		if err := r.orgUnits.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: oid}}).Decode(&doc); err != nil {
488			return "", false
489		}
490		return doc.Name, true
491	}
492	
493	// riderName resolves a rider party's display name + masked/real phone.
494	func (r *repository) riderName(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (name, phone string) {
495		oid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(partyID)
496		if err != nil {
497			return partyID, ""
498		}
499		var p struct {
500			FullName string `bson:"full_name"`
501			Phone    string `bson:"phone"`
502		}
503		if err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: oid}}).Decode(&p); err != nil {
504			return partyID, ""
505		}
506		return p.FullName, p.Phone
507	}
508	
509	// ridersForStore returns the DELIVERY_RIDER party ids assigned to a store.
510	func (r *repository) ridersForStore(ctx context.Context, storeID string) ([]string, error) {
511		oid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(storeID)
512		if err != nil {
513			return nil, errBadRequest("bad store id")
514		}
515		cur, err := r.roleAssignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{
516			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: oid}, {Key: "role_code", Value: "DELIVERY_RIDER"}, {Key: "status", Value: "ACTIVE"},
517		})
518		if err != nil {
519			return nil, errInternal("rider lookup failed")
520		}
521		var rows []struct {
522			PartyID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"party_id"`
523		}
524		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
525			return nil, errInternal("rider decode failed")
526		}
527		ids := make([]string, 0, len(rows))
528		for _, x := range rows {
529			ids = append(ids, x.PartyID.Hex())
530		}
531		return ids, nil
532	}
533	
534	// storeForActor returns the STORE org id the operator's role is assigned to.
535	func (r *repository) storeForActor(ctx context.Context, partyID, roleCode string) (string, error) {
536		oid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(partyID)
537		if err != nil {
538			return "", errBadRequest("bad actor")
539		}
540		var ra struct {
541			OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"org_unit_id"`
542		}
543		err = r.roleAssignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{
544			{Key: "party_id", Value: oid}, {Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode}, {Key: "status", Value: "ACTIVE"},
545		}).Decode(&ra)
546		if err != nil {
547			return "", errForbidden("no active store assignment for this operator")
548		}
549		return ra.OrgUnitID.Hex(), nil
550	}

585		if !in.GeofenceOK {
586			return nil, errUnprocessable("GEOFENCE_FAILED", "you are not at the delivery address — move closer to confirm")
587		}
588		// Debit-on-delivery BEFORE flipping status (funds gate). PREPAID only; keyed
589		// to the order so the consumer's settle sweep can never double-charge.
590		if d.PaymentMode == "PREPAID" && d.Amount > 0 {
591			cid, cerr := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(d.ConsumerID)
592			if cerr != nil {
593				return nil, errInternal("bad consumer id on delivery")
594			}
595			amount := d.Amount
596			// FULL-CREAM SUBSCRIPTION deliveries (the morning run) flow through the
597			// "2 FREE then 2 PAID" welcome trial: the first 2 delivered days are on
598			// us (effective 0), the next 2 pay full, then normal. The window counts
599			// DELIVERED days (dated in IST) and is idempotent by this delivered-day key,
600			// so a settle re-run never double-advances it. Gates: the SKU must be the
601			// offer's full cream (TrialEligible ← isTrialProduct, gold-*) AND the
602			// parent order must be SUBSCRIPTION-linked — a one-time morning order of
603			// the same milk never consumes or earns trial days.
604			if d.Lane == "morning" && d.TrialEligible && parent != nil && parent.SubscriptionID != "" {
605				day := trialDay(time.Now())
606				eff, _, terr := s.trialChargeFor(ctx, cid, trialDeliveryKey(cid, day), d.Amount)
607				if terr != nil {
608					return nil, terr
609				}
610				amount = eff
611			}
612			if amount > 0 {
613				if _, e := s.debit(ctx, cid, amount, "delivery:"+d.OrderID, "Delivery "+d.OrderCode); e != nil {
614					return nil, e // INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS etc. surface to the rider app
615				}
616			} else {
617				// FREE trial day: no money moves, but the delivery ref MUST still be
618				// consumed with a zero-amount ledger row. The consumer app runs a
619				// settle sweep that POSTs /wallet/debit with the order's STICKER total
620				// for any delivered order whose ref it cannot see — before this row
621				// existed, every backend-free day was silently back-charged at full
622				// price by the member's own app. The gate row makes any later debit
623				// on this ref dedupe into a no-op, and gives the member a ₹0 "free
624				// day" line in their ledger to boot.
625				gate := walletTxn{
626					ID: primitive.NewObjectID(), ConsumerID: cid,
627					Type: "DEBIT", Bucket: "CASH", Amount: 0, RefType: "order",
628					RefID: "delivery:" + d.OrderID, Status: "SUCCESS",
629					Remark: "Delivery " + d.OrderCode + " (trial free day)", CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
630				}
631				if _, e := s.repo.insertWalletTxnGate(ctx, gate); e != nil {
632					return nil, e // must not deliver without consuming the ref
633				}
634			}
635		}

18	// ── Delivery creation (called when a consumer order is placed) ───────────────
19	
20	// createDeliveryForOrder makes the last-mile task for a placed order, routed to
21	// the nearest Parag Store. Unassigned (no rider) until the store manager assigns
22	// one. Best-effort: an order is never blocked if delivery creation fails.
23	func (s *service) createDeliveryForOrder(ctx context.Context, o *order) {
24		var at *geoPt
25		if o.Geo != nil {
26			at = &geoPt{Lat: o.Geo.Lat, Lng: o.Geo.Lng}
27		}
28		storeID, storeGeo, err := s.repo.nearestStore(ctx, at)
29		if err != nil {
30			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "no serving store for order", "order", o.OrderID)
31			return
32		}
33		dest := storeGeo
34		if at != nil {
35			dest = *at
36		}
37		items := make([]deliveryItem, 0, len(o.Items))
38		trialEligible := false
39		for _, it := range o.Items {
40			items = append(items, deliveryItem{Name: it.Name, Qty: it.Qty})
41			if isTrialProduct(it.ProductID) {
42				trialEligible = true // 2+2 welcome trial — full-cream (gold-*) only
43			}
44		}
45		payMode := "COD"
46		if o.PaymentMethod == "wallet" || o.PaymentMethod == "prepaid" {
47			payMode = "PREPAID"
48		}
49		now := time.Now().UTC()
50		// Instant lane: the task carries a hard ETA anchored to the ORDER's
51		// placed-at (+20 min) — not task-creation time, so a backfilled task keeps
52		// the customer's original promise instead of restarting the clock.
53		eta := ""
54		if o.Lane == "instant" {
55			base := o.PlacedAt
56			if base.IsZero() {
57				base = now
58			}
59			eta = base.Add(20 * time.Minute).Format(time.RFC3339)
60		}
61		// Instant orders BROADCAST as OFFERED to the store's riders — the first rider to
62		// claim it wins (auto-dispatch). Morning/subscription tasks stay unassigned
63		// ASSIGNED for the store manager's batch route-assign.
64		status, offeredAt := "ASSIGNED", ""
65		if o.Lane == "instant" {
66			status, offeredAt = "OFFERED", now.Format(time.RFC3339)
67		}
68		del := &delivery{
69			MongoID: primitive.NewObjectID(), ID: newDeliveryID(), OrderID: o.OrderID, OrderCode: o.OrderID,
70			StoreID: storeID, RiderPartyID: "", ConsumerID: o.UserID, ConsumerName: o.ConsumerName,
71			PhoneMasked: maskPhone(o.Phone), Phone: o.Phone, AddressLabel: o.AddressLabel, AddressLine: o.AddressText,
72			Geo: dest, Items: items, Amount: o.Total, PaymentMode: payMode, TrialEligible: trialEligible, Perishable: false,
73			Slot: slotLabel(o), Lane: o.Lane, EtaAt: eta, DistanceKm: round2(haversineKm(storeGeo, dest)),
74			Status: status, OfferedAt: offeredAt, AssignedAt: now.Format(time.RFC3339), CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
75		}
76		_ = s.repo.insertDelivery(ctx, del)
77	}

81	func (s *service) storeOrders(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID string) ([]delivery, error) {
82		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
83			return nil, err
84		}
85		// Backfill any open order missing its delivery task (e.g. placed before a
86		// Parag Store existed, or if delivery creation failed) so no order is ever
87		// invisible to the store. Idempotent — one delivery per order.
88		s.backfillMissingDeliveries(ctx)
89		return s.repo.listDeliveriesByStore(ctx, storeID)
90	}
91	
92	// backfillMissingDeliveries creates a delivery task for any still-open order that
93	// doesn't have one yet, routed to its nearest Parag Store. Best-effort.
94	func (s *service) backfillMissingDeliveries(ctx context.Context) {
95		orders, err := s.repo.recentFulfillableOrders(ctx)
96		if err != nil {
97			return
98		}
99		for i := range orders {
100			o := &orders[i]
101			if d, _ := s.repo.findDeliveryByOrder(ctx, o.OrderID); d == nil {
102				s.createDeliveryForOrder(ctx, o)
103			}
104		}
105	}
106	
107	// storeRiders returns the store's riders with workload + distance to a specific
108	// delivery (when deliveryID given) so the manager can pick the nearest tier.
109	func (s *service) storeRiders(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID, deliveryID string) ([]riderSummary, error) {
110		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
111			return nil, err
112		}
113		riderIDs, err := s.repo.ridersForStore(ctx, storeID)
114		if err != nil {
115			return nil, err
116		}
117		// NEARBY ranking: the instant lane reuses the SAME rider pool that runs the
118		// morning subscription round — but each rider's position is taken from the
119		// freshest last_known_geo on their own tasks (their live GPS trail), falling
120		// back to the store centre for riders who haven't moved yet. Distance is
121		// rider→drop, and the list is sorted nearest-first so the store manager's
122		// assign sheet leads with the closest rider.
123		storeGeo, geoOK := s.repo.storeGeo(ctx, storeID)
124		var dest *geoPt
125		if deliveryID != "" {
126			if d, e := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, deliveryID); e == nil {
127				dest = &d.Geo
128			}
129		}
130		// A store with no geo must not rank idle riders from (0,0) — thousands of
131		// phantom km. Stage geo-less stores AT the drop point (distance 0), letting
132		// riders with real GPS pings still rank truthfully.
133		if !geoOK && dest != nil {
134			storeGeo = *dest
135		}
136		all, _ := s.repo.listDeliveriesByStore(ctx, storeID)
137		today := time.Now().UTC().Format("2006-01-02")
138		out := make([]riderSummary, 0, len(riderIDs))
139		for _, rid := range riderIDs {
140			name, phone := s.repo.riderName(ctx, rid)
141			active, done := 0, 0
142			origin := storeGeo // position fallback: idle riders stage at the store
143			lastAt := ""
144			// Duty presence (the fix the rider's offer poll reports every ~8 s) is
145			// the truest live position — task pings below only win if fresher.
146			if g, at, ok := s.repo.findRiderPresence(ctx, rid); ok {
147				lastAt = at
148				origin = g
149			}
150			for _, d := range all {
151				if d.RiderPartyID != rid {
152					continue
153				}
154				if d.Status == "ACCEPTED" || d.Status == "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" {
155					active++
156				}
157				if d.Status == "DELIVERED" && len(d.DeliveredAt) >= 10 && d.DeliveredAt[:10] == today {
158					done++
159				}
160				// Freshest GPS ping across the rider's tasks = their live position.
161				if d.LastKnownGeo != nil && d.LastLocationAt > lastAt {
162					lastAt = d.LastLocationAt
163					origin = *d.LastKnownGeo
164				}
165			}
166			dist := 0.0
167			if dest != nil {
168				dist = round2(haversineKm(origin, *dest))
169			}
170			out = append(out, riderSummary{
171				PartyID: rid, Name: name, PhoneMasked: maskPhone(phone), VehicleNo: "",
172				ActiveDeliveries: active, CompletedToday: done, DistanceKm: dist, WithinTierKm: tierFor(dist),
173			})
174		}
175		// Nearest-first when ranking against a concrete drop; ties break on the
176		// lighter current workload so instant orders spread across free riders.
177		if dest != nil {
178			sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
179				if out[i].DistanceKm != out[j].DistanceKm {
180					return out[i].DistanceKm < out[j].DistanceKm
181				}
182				return out[i].ActiveDeliveries < out[j].ActiveDeliveries
183			})
184		}
185		return out, nil
186	}
187	
188	// tierFor returns the smallest 15/30/60 km band a distance falls in. 0 means
189	// beyond 60 km → the "all riders assigned to the store" fallback (still eligible;
190	// the store owns the delivery).
191	func tierFor(distKm float64) float64 {
192		for _, t := range riderTiersKm {
193			if distKm <= t {
194				return t
195			}
196		}
197		return 0
198	}
199	
200	// assignRider assigns the nearest-tier-eligible rider to an unassigned delivery.
201	// Enforces the 15→30→60 km escalation: a rider may only be assigned if the
202	// delivery falls within a served tier (with the store-distance seam, all the
203	// store's riders share the store→address distance).
204	func (s *service) assignRider(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID, deliveryID, riderPartyID string) (*delivery, error) {
205		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
206			return nil, err
207		}
208		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, deliveryID)
209		if err != nil {
210			return nil, err
211		}
212		if d.StoreID != storeID {
213			return nil, errForbidden("delivery belongs to another store")
214		}
215		riders, err := s.repo.ridersForStore(ctx, storeID)
216		if err != nil {
217			return nil, err
218		}
219		// Any rider ASSIGNED TO THE STORE is eligible. The 15→30→60 km tiers only
220		// RANK/suggest the nearest riders; if the address is beyond 60 km of every
221		// rider, the fallback is the whole store roster (the store owns the delivery),
222		// so assignment is never blocked on distance.
223		if !contains(riders, riderPartyID) {
224			return nil, errBadRequest("rider is not assigned to this store")
225		}
226		now := time.Now().UTC()
227		return s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, deliveryID,
228			bson.D{{Key: "rider_party_id", Value: riderPartyID}, {Key: "status", Value: "ASSIGNED"}, {Key: "assigned_at", Value: now.Format(time.RFC3339)}},
229			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: bson.A{"ASSIGNED", "FAILED"}}}}},
230		)
231	}
232	
233	// ── Store manager order surgery (damage at handover) ────────────────────────
234	
235	// storeCancelDelivery — the manager cancels an order BEFORE it is delivered
236	// (e.g. the whole crate got damaged). The task fails, the parent order flips
237	// cancelled — and since money only ever moves ON delivery, nothing was charged
238	// and nothing needs refunding. A DELIVERED order can never be cancelled.
239	func (s *service) storeCancelDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID, deliveryID, reason string) (*delivery, error) {
240		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
241			return nil, err
242		}
243		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, deliveryID)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if d.StoreID != storeID {
248			return nil, errForbidden("delivery belongs to another store")
249		}
250		if d.Status == "DELIVERED" {
251			return nil, errConflict("ALREADY_DELIVERED", "a delivered order can no longer be cancelled")
252		}
253		if reason == "" {
254			reason = "Cancelled by the store"
255		}
256		upd, err := s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, deliveryID,
257			bson.D{
258				{Key: "status", Value: "FAILED"},
259				{Key: "failure_reason", Value: reason},
260				{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
261			},
262			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"DELIVERED"}}}}},
263		)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		// The consumer sees the cancellation immediately (their Orders screen).
268		_, _ = s.repo.orders.UpdateOne(ctx,
269			bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: d.OrderID}, {Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"delivered", "cancelled"}}}}},
270			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "cancelled"}, {Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}}})
271		return upd, nil
272	}
273	
274	// itemAdjust is one requested line change — the ABSOLUTE new quantity,
275	// reduction only (a store can shrink a bill, never inflate one).
276	type itemAdjust struct {
277		Name string `json:"name"`
278		Qty  int    `json:"qty"`
279	}
280	
281	// storeAdjustDelivery — the manager reduces item quantities before handover
282	// (3 packets ordered, 1 damaged → deliver 2; qty 0 removes the line). The
283	// ORDER and its TASK are re-billed server-side (subtotal, delivery fee and
284	// total recomputed under the same rules as order creation), and because the
285	// wallet debit happens AT DELIVERY from the task's amount, the customer pays
286	// exactly for what is actually delivered. COD collects the updated amount;
287	// the morning Taaza trial maths also read the updated amount — no flow forks.
288	func (s *service) storeAdjustDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID, deliveryID string, changes []itemAdjust) (*delivery, error) {
289		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		if len(changes) == 0 {
293			return nil, errBadRequest("no item changes given")
294		}
295		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, deliveryID)
296		if err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		if d.StoreID != storeID {
300			return nil, errForbidden("delivery belongs to another store")
301		}
302		if d.Status == "DELIVERED" || d.Status == "FAILED" {
303			return nil, errConflict("NOT_ADJUSTABLE", "only an open order can be adjusted")
304		}
305		o, err := s.repo.findOrderAnyUser(ctx, d.OrderID)
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, err
308		}
309		if o.Status == "delivered" || o.Status == "cancelled" {
310			return nil, errConflict("NOT_ADJUSTABLE", "only an open order can be adjusted")
311		}
312		want := map[string]int{}
313		for _, c := range changes {
314			want[c.Name] = c.Qty
315		}
316		newItems := make([]orderItem, 0, len(o.Items))
317		changed := false
318		for _, it := range o.Items {
319			q, ok := want[it.Name]
320			if !ok {
321				newItems = append(newItems, it)
322				continue
323			}
324			if q < 0 || q > it.Qty {
325				return nil, errUnprocessable("REDUCE_ONLY", "an adjustment can only reduce a quantity, never raise it")
326			}
327			if q != it.Qty {
328				changed = true
329			}
330			if q == 0 {
331				continue // damaged out entirely — the line is removed
332			}
333			it.Qty = q
334			newItems = append(newItems, it)
335		}
336		if !changed {
337			return d, nil // idempotent no-op (absolute quantities)
338		}
339		if len(newItems) == 0 {
340			return nil, errUnprocessable("USE_CANCEL", "removing every item cancels the order — use cancel instead")
341		}
342		var subtotal float64
343		for _, it := range newItems {
344			subtotal += it.Price * float64(it.Qty)
345		}
346		subtotal = round2(subtotal)
347		fee := deliveryFeeFor(subtotal)
348		total := round2(subtotal + fee + o.MonsoonFee)
349		now := time.Now().UTC()
350		if _, uerr := s.repo.orders.UpdateOne(ctx,
351			bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: o.OrderID}, {Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"delivered", "cancelled"}}}}},
352			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
353				{Key: "order_items", Value: newItems},
354				{Key: "subtotal", Value: subtotal},
355				{Key: "delivery_fee", Value: fee},
356				{Key: "total", Value: total},
357				{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
358			}}}); uerr != nil {
359			return nil, errInternal("order adjust failed")
360		}
361		dItems := make([]deliveryItem, 0, len(newItems))
362		for _, it := range newItems {
363			dItems = append(dItems, deliveryItem{Name: it.Name, Qty: it.Qty})
364		}
365		return s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, deliveryID,
366			bson.D{{Key: "items", Value: dItems}, {Key: "amount", Value: total}, {Key: "updated_at", Value: now}},
367			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"DELIVERED", "FAILED"}}}}},
368		)
369	}

371	func (s *service) assertStore(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID string) error {
372		owned, err := s.repo.storeForActor(ctx, actor.PartyID, "STORE_MANAGER")
373		if err != nil {
374			return err
375		}
376		if owned != storeID {
377			return errForbidden("you do not manage this store")
378		}
379		return nil
380	}
381	
382	// ── Delivery rider ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
383	
384	func (s *service) riderDeliveries(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) ([]delivery, error) {
385		all, err := s.repo.listDeliveriesByRider(ctx, actor.PartyID)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, err
388		}
389		return all, nil
390	}
391	
392	// offerPingFreshness — how recent a rider's GPS ping must be to count as their
393	// LIVE position for the 15-km offer fence. Riders push location every ~20 s
394	// while on a delivery, so 10 minutes comfortably spans a run; anything older is
395	// a stale/stuck fix and falls back to the store-staging rule.
396	const offerPingFreshness = 10 * time.Minute
397	
398	// offeredForRider is the rider's "available orders" feed — OFFERED (broadcast)
399	// instant tasks at any store they serve, minus ones they already declined,
400	// fenced to the 15-km broadcast radius (riderTiersKm[0]): the accept-request
401	// only reaches riders within 15 km of the drop; the first to claim wins
402	// (claimDelivery is atomic, so exactly one rider can ever take it).
403	func (s *service) offeredForRider(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, live *geoPt) ([]delivery, error) {
404		stores, err := s.repo.storesForRider(ctx, actor.PartyID)
405		if err != nil {
406			return nil, err
407		}
408		// The rider app sends its CURRENT fix with every offer poll — the position
409		// at the very moment the offer would be shown. Record it as the rider's
410		// duty presence so the manager's assign ranking sees it too.
411		if live != nil {
412			s.repo.upsertRiderPresence(ctx, actor.PartyID, *live, time.Now())
413		}
414		offered, err := s.repo.listOfferedForStores(ctx, stores, actor.PartyID)
415		if err != nil {
416			return nil, err
417		}
418		// Rider origin, best first: (1) the live fix on THIS poll; (2) their last
419		// duty presence, if FRESH; (3) the freshest FRESH GPS ping across their own
420		// tasks. A stale/stuck fix (older than the freshness window) is discarded —
421		// it may be yesterday's position, so it must never include OR exclude a
422		// rider from an offer. Nothing fresh → the rider stages AT their store (the
423		// duty station), the same positioning rule the manager's assign sheet uses.
424		cutoff := time.Now().UTC().Add(-offerPingFreshness).Format(time.RFC3339)
425		origin := live
426		if origin == nil {
427			if g, at, ok := s.repo.findRiderPresence(ctx, actor.PartyID); ok && at >= cutoff {
428				origin = &g
429			}
430		}
431		if origin == nil {
432			mine, _ := s.repo.listDeliveriesByRider(ctx, actor.PartyID)
433			lastAt := ""
434			for i := range mine {
435				d := &mine[i]
436				if d.LastKnownGeo != nil && d.LastLocationAt > lastAt && d.LastLocationAt >= cutoff {
437					lastAt = d.LastLocationAt
438					origin = d.LastKnownGeo
439				}
440			}
441		}
442		storeGeos := map[string]*geoPt{}
443		out := make([]delivery, 0, len(offered))
444		for i := range offered {
445			d := &offered[i]
446			from := origin
447			if from == nil {
448				g, seen := storeGeos[d.StoreID]
449				if !seen {
450					if sg, ok := s.repo.storeGeo(ctx, d.StoreID); ok {
451						cp := sg
452						g = &cp
453					}
454					storeGeos[d.StoreID] = g
455				}
456				from = g
457			}
458			// Unknown geo on both sides → still offered: an order must never be
459			// stranded just because we cannot rank the distance.
460			if from == nil || haversineKm(*from, d.Geo) <= riderTiersKm[0] {
461				out = append(out, *d)
462			}
463		}
464		return out, nil
465	}
466	
467	// claimOfferedDelivery is the FIRST-ACCEPT-WINS path: the first rider to claim an
468	// OFFERED task wins it atomically; everyone else gets CLAIMED_BY_OTHER (409).
469	func (s *service) claimOfferedDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*delivery, error) {
470		d, err := s.repo.claimDelivery(ctx, id, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
471		if err != nil {
472			return nil, err
473		}
474		s.syncOrderAssigned(ctx, d) // consumer immediately sees the assigned rider
475		return d, nil
476	}
477	
478	// rejectOfferedDelivery returns a claimed (pre-pickup) task to the pool so a nearby
479	// rider can take it — the re-broadcast. Not allowed once picked up.
480	func (s *service) rejectOfferedDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*delivery, error) {
481		d, err := s.repo.rejectOffer(ctx, id, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
482		if err != nil {
483			return nil, err
484		}
485		s.syncOrderFindingRider(ctx, d)
486		return d, nil
487	}

489	// acceptDelivery is the MANAGER-ASSIGNED (morning/subscription) accept: a rider
490	// accepts a task the store manager already assigned to them. Instant/OFFERED tasks
491	// go through claimOfferedDelivery (first-accept-wins) instead.
492	func (s *service) acceptDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*delivery, error) {
493		return s.riderTransition(ctx, actor, id, "ASSIGNED",
494			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "ACCEPTED"}}, "")
495	}

497	func (s *service) pickupDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*delivery, error) {
498		now := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
499		d, err := s.riderTransition(ctx, actor, id, "ACCEPTED",
500			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY"}, {Key: "out_for_delivery_at", Value: now}}, "")
501		if err == nil {
502			s.syncOrderOutForDelivery(ctx, d)
503		}
504		return d, err
505	}

507	func (s *service) pushLocation(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, lat, lng float64) (*delivery, error) {
508		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, id)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if d.RiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
513			return nil, errForbidden("not your delivery")
514		}
515		now := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
516		updated, err := s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, id,
517			bson.D{{Key: "last_known_geo", Value: geoPt{Lat: lat, Lng: lng}}, {Key: "last_location_at", Value: now}}, bson.D{})
518		if err == nil {
519			s.syncOrderRiderLocation(ctx, updated, lat, lng) // consumer sees the rider move
520		}
521		return updated, err
522	}

524	func (s *service) failDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, reason string) (*delivery, error) {
525		if reason == "" {
526			reason = "Could not deliver"
527		}
528		return s.riderTransition(ctx, actor, id, "", // any non-delivered state
529			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "FAILED"}, {Key: "failure_reason", Value: reason}}, "DELIVERED")
530	}
531	
532	// deliverInput carries the proof-of-delivery from the rider app.
533	type deliverInput struct {
534		EventID    string
535		ProofNote  string
536		ProofPhoto string
537		Geo        *geoPt
538		GeofenceOK bool
539	}
540	
541	// deliverDelivery is THE delivery event: photo+geo proof + geofence, then debit
542	// the consumer wallet EXACTLY ONCE (ref = the order, shared with the consumer's
543	// settle sweep) and mark the order delivered. Idempotent by event id.
544	func (s *service) deliverDelivery(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, in deliverInput) (*delivery, error) {
545		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if d.RiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
550			return nil, errForbidden("not your delivery")
551		}
552		if d.Status == "DELIVERED" {
553			if in.EventID != "" && d.DeliveryEventID == in.EventID {
554				return d, nil // idempotent replay
555			}
556			return nil, errConflict("ALREADY_DELIVERED", "this delivery is already completed")
557		}
558		if d.Status != "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" {
559			return nil, errConflict("NOT_OUT", "this delivery is not out for delivery")
560		}
561		// Belt + braces with cancelOrder's task-failing: refuse to deliver a task
562		// whose parent order was cancelled (a stale task must never debit money or
563		// resurrect a cancelled order to delivered). The parent is kept for the
564		// trial gate below (trial pricing applies only to SUBSCRIPTION deliveries).
565		parent, perr := s.repo.findOrderAnyUser(ctx, d.OrderID)
566		if perr != nil {
567			// A transient lookup failure must FAIL the settle, not silently skip the
568			// cancelled-order guard and the trial gate below — skipping the trial
569			// gate bills a FREE day at full price. The rider app retries.
570			return nil, perr
571		}
572		if parent != nil && parent.Status == "cancelled" {
573			_, _ = s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, d.ID,
574				bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "FAILED"}, {Key: "failure_reason", Value: "Order cancelled by the customer"}, {Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}},
575				bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$nin", Value: bson.A{"DELIVERED", "FAILED"}}}}},
576			)
577			return nil, errConflict("ORDER_CANCELLED", "this order was cancelled by the customer")
578		}
579		if in.ProofPhoto == "" {
580			return nil, errUnprocessable("PROOF_PHOTO_REQUIRED", "add a delivery photo as proof")
581		}
582		if in.Geo == nil {
583			return nil, errUnprocessable("PROOF_GEO_REQUIRED", "add the delivery location (geotag) as proof")
584		}
585		if !in.GeofenceOK {
586			return nil, errUnprocessable("GEOFENCE_FAILED", "you are not at the delivery address — move closer to confirm")
587		}
588		// Debit-on-delivery BEFORE flipping status (funds gate). PREPAID only; keyed
589		// to the order so the consumer's settle sweep can never double-charge.
590		if d.PaymentMode == "PREPAID" && d.Amount > 0 {
591			cid, cerr := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(d.ConsumerID)
592			if cerr != nil {
593				return nil, errInternal("bad consumer id on delivery")
594			}
595			amount := d.Amount
596			// FULL-CREAM SUBSCRIPTION deliveries (the morning run) flow through the
597			// "2 FREE then 2 PAID" welcome trial: the first 2 delivered days are on
598			// us (effective 0), the next 2 pay full, then normal. The window counts
599			// DELIVERED days (dated in IST) and is idempotent by this delivered-day key,
600			// so a settle re-run never double-advances it. Gates: the SKU must be the
601			// offer's full cream (TrialEligible ← isTrialProduct, gold-*) AND the
602			// parent order must be SUBSCRIPTION-linked — a one-time morning order of
603			// the same milk never consumes or earns trial days.
604			if d.Lane == "morning" && d.TrialEligible && parent != nil && parent.SubscriptionID != "" {
605				day := trialDay(time.Now())
606				eff, _, terr := s.trialChargeFor(ctx, cid, trialDeliveryKey(cid, day), d.Amount)
607				if terr != nil {
608					return nil, terr
609				}
610				amount = eff
611			}
612			if amount > 0 {
613				if _, e := s.debit(ctx, cid, amount, "delivery:"+d.OrderID, "Delivery "+d.OrderCode); e != nil {
614					return nil, e // INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS etc. surface to the rider app
615				}
616			} else {
617				// FREE trial day: no money moves, but the delivery ref MUST still be
618				// consumed with a zero-amount ledger row. The consumer app runs a
619				// settle sweep that POSTs /wallet/debit with the order's STICKER total
620				// for any delivered order whose ref it cannot see — before this row
621				// existed, every backend-free day was silently back-charged at full
622				// price by the member's own app. The gate row makes any later debit
623				// on this ref dedupe into a no-op, and gives the member a ₹0 "free
624				// day" line in their ledger to boot.
625				gate := walletTxn{
626					ID: primitive.NewObjectID(), ConsumerID: cid,
627					Type: "DEBIT", Bucket: "CASH", Amount: 0, RefType: "order",
628					RefID: "delivery:" + d.OrderID, Status: "SUCCESS",
629					Remark: "Delivery " + d.OrderCode + " (trial free day)", CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
630				}
631				if _, e := s.repo.insertWalletTxnGate(ctx, gate); e != nil {
632					return nil, e // must not deliver without consuming the ref
633				}
634			}
635		}
636		evt := in.EventID
637		if evt == "" {
638			evt = newDeliveryID()
639		}
640		now := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
641		note := in.ProofNote
642		if note == "" {
643			note = "Delivered"
644		}
645		updated, err := s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, id, bson.D{
646			{Key: "status", Value: "DELIVERED"}, {Key: "delivered_at", Value: now},
647			{Key: "proof_note", Value: note}, {Key: "proof_photo_uri", Value: in.ProofPhoto},
648			{Key: "proof_geo", Value: in.Geo}, {Key: "last_known_geo", Value: in.Geo}, {Key: "last_location_at", Value: now},
649			{Key: "delivery_event_id", Value: evt}, {Key: "geofence_ok", Value: true},
650		}, bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY"}})
651		if err != nil {
652			return nil, err
653		}
654		s.syncOrderDelivered(ctx, updated)
655		return updated, nil
656	}
657	
658	func (s *service) riderTransition(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, requireStatus string, set bson.D, notStatus string) (*delivery, error) {
659		d, err := s.repo.findDeliveryByID(ctx, id)
660		if err != nil {
661			return nil, err
662		}
663		if d.RiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
664			return nil, errForbidden("not your delivery")
665		}
666		guard := bson.D{}
667		if requireStatus != "" {
668			guard = append(guard, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: requireStatus})
669		}
670		if notStatus != "" {
671			guard = append(guard, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: notStatus}}})
672		}
673		return s.repo.updateDelivery(ctx, id, set, guard)
674	}
675	
676	// ── Consumer order sync (so the consumer app shows tracking + status) ────────
677	
678	func (s *service) syncOrderOutForDelivery(ctx context.Context, d *delivery) {
679		name, phone := s.repo.riderName(ctx, d.RiderPartyID)
680		rd := &rider{ID: d.RiderPartyID, FullName: name, Phone: phone}

835	func (h *handler) riderAvailable(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
836		actor, _ := operatorActor(r)

838		if latS, lngS := r.URL.Query().Get("lat"), r.URL.Query().Get("lng"); latS != "" && lngS != "" {
839			lat, e1 := strconv.ParseFloat(latS, 64)
840			lng, e2 := strconv.ParseFloat(lngS, 64)
841			// (0,0) is the null island a failed device fix reports — never a rider.
842			if e1 == nil && e2 == nil && !(lat == 0 && lng == 0) {
843				live = &geoPt{Lat: lat, Lng: lng}
844			}
845		}
846		ds, err := h.svc.offeredForRider(r.Context(), actor, live)

927	// slotLabel is what the store/rider console sees on the task: a scheduled
928	// morning order carries its member-picked IST date in front of the window so
929	// a +N-days order is never worked as "due tomorrow".
930	func slotLabel(o *order) string {
931		if o.DeliveryDate != "" {
932			if o.DeliveryWindow != "" {
933				return o.DeliveryDate + " · " + o.DeliveryWindow
934			}
935			return o.DeliveryDate
936		}
937		return o.DeliveryWindow
938	}

18: // SERVER-OWNED SUBSCRIPTIONS — the backend twin of the consumer app's local
19: // subscription rows (lib/subscriptions.ts), so the DAILY MORNING ORDER exists
20: // even when nobody opens the app.
21: //
22: // Model (mirrors the FE exactly):
23: //   one subscription = ONE product line (product, variant, qty, unit price) +
24: //   a cadence (daily | alternate | weekly) anchored at start_date, minus any
25: //   vacation ranges (a skip is a one-day vacation, start == end).
26: //
27: // MONEY MODEL — no charge at creation. The worker only CREATES the order
28: // (payment_method "wallet"); money moves exactly once ON DELIVERY through the
29: // existing settle path (deliverDelivery → debit "delivery:<orderID>"), which
30: // also applies the Taaza 2-paid-2-free welcome trial. Charging here as well
31: // would double-debit — the AutoPay mandate (mandate.go) remains the wallet
32: // top-up backstop, not the per-delivery charge.
33: //
34: // ADDRESS MODEL — a subscription NEVER carries its own address. Every order the
35: // worker creates resolves the consumer's CURRENT default saved address (with
36: // lat/lng, so geofence routes it to the serving store). One saved address feeds
37: // every subscription — new subscriptions never re-ask for a location, and an
38: // address edit re-points every future delivery automatically.
39: //
40: // EXACTLY-ONCE — at most one order per (subscription, IST day), enforced by an
41: // atomic last_order_date claim (UpdateOne guarded on $ne day), the same pattern
42: // as advanceMandateCharge. A crashed tick after the claim skips that day rather
43: // than ever double-ordering milk.
44: 
45: const collSubscriptions = "consumer_subscriptions"
46: 
47: // subscriptionDeliveryFee is the delivery fee on a SUBSCRIPTION morning delivery:
48: // always 0. The consumer app quotes and debits the bare subtotal on the Subscribe
49: // button, so the server-side recurring debit must match (never subtotal + ₹15).
50: const subscriptionDeliveryFee = 0.0
51: 
52: // NOTE: cadence math and day-claims use IST (istZone, shared with trial.go),
53: // matching the FE's local calendar dates, never UTC (UTC is "yesterday" until
54: // 05:30 IST).
55: 
56: // subscriptionFrequencies is the supported cadence set (FE Frequency minus the
57: // purely-local one_time/custom modes, which the app fulfils immediately itself).
58: var subscriptionFrequencies = map[string]bool{"daily": true, "alternate": true, "weekly": true}
59: 
60: // subscriptionTransitions — same shape as the mandate state machine.
61: var subscriptionTransitions = map[string]map[string]bool{
62: 	"active":    {"paused": true, "cancelled": true},
63: 	"paused":    {"active": true, "cancelled": true},
64: 	"cancelled": {},
65: }
66: 
67: func subscriptionActionTarget(action string) (string, bool) {
68: 	switch action {
69: 	case "pause":
70: 		return "paused", true
71: 	case "resume":
72: 		return "active", true
73: 	case "cancel":
74: 		return "cancelled", true
75: 	default:
76: 		return "", false
77: 	}

97: 	DeliverySlot   string             `bson:"delivery_slot,omitempty"  json:"delivery_slot,omitempty"`
98: 	Status         string             `bson:"status"                   json:"status"`     // active|paused|cancelled

100: 	Vacations      []vacationRange    `bson:"vacations,omitempty"      json:"vacations,omitempty"`
101: 	// LastOrderDate is the exactly-once day claim (YYYY-MM-DD IST) — the worker
102: 	// creates at most one order per subscription per day.
103: 	LastOrderDate string    `bson:"last_order_date,omitempty" json:"last_order_date,omitempty"`
104: 	LastOrderID   string    `bson:"last_order_id,omitempty"   json:"last_order_id,omitempty"`

109: func newSubscriptionID() string {
110: 	b := make([]byte, 6)
111: 	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
112: 	return "sub_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
113: }

115: // istToday returns the current IST calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD.
116: func istToday(now time.Time) string { return now.In(istZone).Format("2006-01-02") }
117: 
118: // parseDay parses a YYYY-MM-DD into an IST-midnight time (cadence anchor).
119: func parseDay(iso string) (time.Time, bool) {
120: 	t, err := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", iso, istZone)
121: 	if err != nil {
122: 		return time.Time{}, false
123: 	}
124: 	return t, true
125: }
126: 
127: // subscriptionDeliversOn — the cadence law, IDENTICAL to the FE
128: // (lib/subscriptions.ts): daily every day, alternate every 2nd day, weekly
129: // every 7th, all counted from start_date. Days before the start never deliver.
130: func subscriptionDeliversOn(frequency, startDate, dayISO string) bool {
131: 	from, ok1 := parseDay(startDate)
132: 	to, ok2 := parseDay(dayISO)
133: 	if !ok1 || !ok2 {
134: 		return false
135: 	}
136: 	d := int(to.Sub(from).Hours() / 24)
137: 	if d < 0 {
138: 		return false
139: 	}
140: 	switch frequency {
141: 	case "daily":
142: 		return true
143: 	case "alternate":
144: 		return d%2 == 0
145: 	case "weekly":
146: 		return d%7 == 0
147: 	default:
148: 		return false
149: 	}
150: }
151: 
152: // subscriptionDueOn — cadence AND not inside any vacation/skip range (dates are
153: // YYYY-MM-DD so string compare is chronological; the FE rule verbatim).
154: func subscriptionDueOn(sub *subscription, dayISO string) bool {
155: 	if sub.Status != "active" || !subscriptionDeliversOn(sub.Frequency, sub.StartDate, dayISO) {
156: 		return false
157: 	}
158: 	for _, v := range sub.Vacations {
159: 		if dayISO >= v.Start && dayISO <= v.End {
160: 			return false
161: 		}
162: 	}
163: 	return true
164: }

171: 		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}},
172: 		{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: 1}}}, // the worker scans active subs
173: 	}

175: 	return err

181: 			return errConflict("SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS", "subscription already exists")
182: 		}
183: 		return errInternal("subscription create failed")
184: 	}
185: 	return nil
186: }

189: 	var s subscription

191: 	if isNoDocs(err) {
192: 		return nil, errNotFound("subscription not found")
193: 	}
194: 	if err != nil {
195: 		return nil, errInternal("subscription lookup failed")
196: 	}
197: 	return &s, nil
198: }

23	// GEOFENCE SERVICEABILITY — is a shopper's delivery address inside a Parag
24	// Store's serving area, and at what service level (instant doorstep vs the
25	// standard/morning run)? A store manager (Saathi operator, STORE_MANAGER) draws
26	// the store's zone; the consumer app asks GET /consumer/serviceability before
27	// letting a shopper check out, and offers a waitlist join when the answer is no.
28	//
29	// A zone is a small, self-contained geo policy per store:
30	//
31	//   - an INSTANT circle (center + radius): inside → richest "instant" service;
32	//   - a STANDARD circle (larger radius): inside → "standard" service;
33	//   - INCLUDE pincodes: serviceable (standard) even OUTSIDE the circles — the
34	//     manual "we deliver to this colony too" override;
35	//   - EXCLUDE pincodes: never serviceable (a blacklisted pincode);
36	//   - EXCLUDE polygons (holes): a carved-out area that is DENIED even when it
37	//     sits INSIDE a serving circle (a river, a restricted campus, a dead zone).
38	//
39	// Priority (evaluated per zone, EXACTLY):
40	//  1. inside an exclude polygon  → NONE  (a hole denies even inside a circle)
41	//  2. pincode in exclude list    → NONE
42	//  3. inside the instant circle  → INSTANT (richest; beats an include-pincode)
43	//  4. pincode in include list    → STANDARD (allowed even outside the circle)
44	//  5. inside an include polygon  → STANDARD
45	//  6. inside the standard circle → STANDARD
46	//  7. otherwise                  → NONE
47	//
48	// Across zones (the pilot usually has one) the RICHEST match wins:
49	// instant beats standard beats none. With NO active zone configured the system
50	// defaults OPEN (standard) — the pilot must not be dark before a manager draws
51	// the first zone.
52	//
53	// All point tests run on-device in Go (haversineM + ray-casting pointInPolygon)
54	// so serviceability is a pure, offline-testable function of the zone docs; the
55	// 2dsphere index on `center` is for later server-side $near store routing.
56	
57	const collStoreZones = "store_zones"
58	const collConsumerWaitlist = "consumer_waitlist"
59	
60	// Service levels, ranked so the richest match wins (instant > standard > none).
61	const (
62		svcNone     = 0
63		svcStandard = 1
64		svcInstant  = 2
65	)
66	
67	// Radius bounds (metres): a zone smaller than 100 m is a mistake; larger than
68	// 60 km outgrows a single last-mile store.
69	const (
70		minRadiusM = 100.0
71		maxRadiusM = 60000.0
72	)
73	
74	// defaultFenceKm — the hard delivery radius (km) around the nearest STORE OrgUnit,
75	// applied when no store-manager zone is drawn yet (the live pilot state). Beyond
76	// this a point is honestly non-serviceable instead of the old fail-open "serve
77	// everywhere". Product-owned pilot default.
78	const defaultFenceKm = 5.0
79	
80	func modeString(level int) string {
81		switch level {
82		case svcInstant:
83			return "instant"
84		case svcStandard:
85			return "standard"
86		default:
87			return "none"
88		}
89	}

91	// ── Geo primitives (pure, offline, unit-tested) ─────────────────────────────
92	
93	// haversineM — great-circle distance in METRES between two lat/lng points. The
94	// serviceability circle tests are all in metres (radii are stored in metres).
95	func haversineM(a, b geoPt) float64 {
96		const R = 6371000.0 // mean Earth radius, metres
97		dLat := (b.Lat - a.Lat) * math.Pi / 180
98		dLng := (b.Lng - a.Lng) * math.Pi / 180
99		la1 := a.Lat * math.Pi / 180
100		la2 := b.Lat * math.Pi / 180
101		h := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) + math.Cos(la1)*math.Cos(la2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)*math.Sin(dLng/2)
102		return 2 * R * math.Asin(math.Sqrt(h))
103	}
104	
105	// pointInPolygon — ray-casting (even-odd) test: is pt inside the closed ring?
106	// The ring is an ordered list of vertices (lng=x, lat=y); the closing edge back
107	// to ring[0] is implied. Points on an edge are treated consistently by the
108	// standard half-open comparison; a ring of <3 vertices is never "inside".
109	//
110	// For the small, flat serving areas of a single store (a few km across) planar
111	// ray-casting on raw lat/lng is accurate enough — no projection is warranted.
112	func pointInPolygon(pt geoPt, ring []geoPt) bool {
113		n := len(ring)
114		if n < 3 {
115			return false
116		}
117		inside := false
118		x, y := pt.Lng, pt.Lat
119		j := n - 1
120		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
121			xi, yi := ring[i].Lng, ring[i].Lat
122			xj, yj := ring[j].Lng, ring[j].Lat
123			if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi) {
124				inside = !inside
125			}
126			j = i
127		}
128		return inside
129	}
130	
131	func coordsSane(lat, lng float64) bool {
132		if math.IsNaN(lat) || math.IsNaN(lng) || math.IsInf(lat, 0) || math.IsInf(lng, 0) {
133			return false
134		}
135		if lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180 {
136			return false
137		}
138		// Null Island (0,0) is the classic "no fix" sentinel — reject it as insane.
139		return !(lat == 0 && lng == 0)
140	}
141	
142	func containsStr(list []string, v string) bool {
143		if v == "" {
144			return false
145		}
146		for _, s := range list {
147			if s == v {
148				return true
149			}
150		}
151		return false
152	}

154	// ── Zone model ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
155	
156	// geoJSONPoint stores the zone centre as GeoJSON ([lng, lat]) so a 2dsphere
157	// index can later drive server-side $near store routing. Go-side point tests
158	// read it back via centerPt().
159	type geoJSONPoint struct {
160		Type        string     `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
161		Coordinates [2]float64 `bson:"coordinates" json:"coordinates"` // [lng, lat]
162	}
163	
164	func newGeoPoint(lat, lng float64) geoJSONPoint {
165		return geoJSONPoint{Type: "Point", Coordinates: [2]float64{lng, lat}}
166	}

168	// zone is one store's serviceability policy (see the file header for the rules).
169	type zone struct {
170		MongoID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"           json:"-"`
171		StoreID         string             `bson:"store_id"                json:"storeId"`
172		Active          bool               `bson:"active"                  json:"active"`
173		Center          geoJSONPoint       `bson:"center"                  json:"center"`
174		InstantRadiusM  float64            `bson:"instant_radius_m"        json:"instantRadiusM"`
175		StandardRadiusM float64            `bson:"standard_radius_m"       json:"standardRadiusM"`
176		// Monsoon surcharge (store-manager set) charged on INSTANT orders only.
177		MonsoonEnabled bool `bson:"monsoon_enabled"         json:"monsoonEnabled"`
178		MonsoonRupees  int  `bson:"monsoon_rupees"          json:"monsoonRupees"`
179		// Instant delivery hours (minutes since IST midnight) + a manual "closed now"
180		// switch. When instant is shut the consumer offers only the morning lane.
181		// InstantCloseMin==0 → no hours gating (legacy zones stay 24h instant).
182		InstantOpenMin  int      `bson:"instant_open_min"        json:"instantOpenMin"`
183		InstantCloseMin int      `bson:"instant_close_min"       json:"instantCloseMin"`
184		InstantPaused   bool     `bson:"instant_paused"          json:"instantPaused"`
185		IncludePincodes []string `bson:"include_pincodes,omitempty" json:"includePincodes,omitempty"`
186		ExcludePincodes []string `bson:"exclude_pincodes,omitempty" json:"excludePincodes,omitempty"`
187		// Polygon rings ([]geoPt, lat/lng). Include = an allowed area beyond the
188		// circle (standard); exclude = a hole denied even inside a circle.
189		IncludePolygons [][]geoPt `bson:"include_polygons,omitempty" json:"includePolygons,omitempty"`
190		ExcludePolygons [][]geoPt `bson:"exclude_polygons,omitempty" json:"excludePolygons,omitempty"`
191		UpdatedBy       string    `bson:"updated_by,omitempty"    json:"updatedBy,omitempty"`
192		UpdatedAt       time.Time `bson:"updated_at"              json:"updatedAt"`
193		CreatedAt       time.Time `bson:"created_at"              json:"-"`
194	}
195	
196	// centerPt reads the GeoJSON centre back as a lat/lng point for the Go tests.
197	func (z *zone) centerPt() geoPt {
198		return geoPt{Lat: z.Center.Coordinates[1], Lng: z.Center.Coordinates[0]}
199	}
200	
201	// evalZone applies the priority rules to one zone and returns the service level
202	// plus the point's distance (metres) to the zone centre. This is the whole
203	// contract, and it is pure — geofence_test.go pins every branch.
204	func evalZone(z zone, pt geoPt, pincode string) (int, float64) {
205		dist := haversineM(pt, z.centerPt())
206	
207		// 1. A hole denies outright — even inside a serving circle.
208		for _, ring := range z.ExcludePolygons {
209			if pointInPolygon(pt, ring) {
210				return svcNone, dist
211			}
212		}
213		// 2. A blacklisted pincode is never serviceable.
214		if containsStr(z.ExcludePincodes, pincode) {
215			return svcNone, dist
216		}
217		// 3. Inside the instant circle is the richest match (beats an include pincode).
218		if z.InstantRadiusM > 0 && dist <= z.InstantRadiusM {
219			return svcInstant, dist
220		}
221		// 4. An include pincode is serviceable (standard) even outside the circles.
222		if containsStr(z.IncludePincodes, pincode) {
223			return svcStandard, dist
224		}
225		// 5. An include polygon is an allowed area beyond the circle (standard).
226		for _, ring := range z.IncludePolygons {
227			if pointInPolygon(pt, ring) {
228				return svcStandard, dist
229			}
230		}
231		// 6. Inside the standard circle.
232		if z.StandardRadiusM > 0 && dist <= z.StandardRadiusM {
233			return svcStandard, dist
234		}
235		// 7. Out of area.
236		return svcNone, dist
237	}

239	// ── Serviceability response ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

241	type serviceabilityResult struct {
242		Serviceable bool    `json:"serviceable"`
243		Mode        string  `json:"mode"` // "instant" | "standard" | "none"
244		Instant     bool    `json:"instant"`
245		StoreID     string  `json:"storeId,omitempty"`
246		DistanceM   float64 `json:"distanceM,omitempty"`
247		Pincode     string  `json:"pincode,omitempty"`
248		DefaultOpen bool    `json:"defaultOpen,omitempty"` // true → no zone configured, open by default
249		// Monsoon surcharge (₹) the store charges on INSTANT orders; 0/absent = none.
250		MonsoonEnabled bool `json:"monsoonEnabled,omitempty"`
251		MonsoonRupees  int  `json:"monsoonRupees,omitempty"`
252		// Instant closed (store shut for the night / manually paused): the consumer
253		// hides instant and shows when it resumes (label + RFC3339, both IST-computed).
254		InstantClosed       bool   `json:"instantClosed,omitempty"`
255		InstantResumesLabel string `json:"instantResumesLabel,omitempty"`
256		InstantResumesAt    string `json:"instantResumesAt,omitempty"`
257		// Nearest serving store + distance (km) and a natural-language reason, used by
258		// the consumer's Coming-Soon screen when a point is outside the delivery fence.
259		StoreName  string  `json:"storeName,omitempty"`
260		DistanceKm float64 `json:"distanceKm,omitempty"`
261		Reason     string  `json:"reason,omitempty"`
262	}
