```text
264	// ── Repository ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
265	
266	// ensureGeoIndexes owns the zone collection's indexes: at most one zone per
267	// store (unique store_id), and a 2dsphere on the GeoJSON centre for future
268	// server-side $near routing.
269	func (r *repository) ensureGeoIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
270		_, err := r.storeZones.Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, []mongo.IndexModel{
271			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "store_id", Value: 1}}, Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
272			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "center", Value: "2dsphere"}}},
273			{Keys: bson.D{{Key: "active", Value: 1}}},
274		})
275		if err != nil {
276			return err
277		}
278		// Waitlist: one row per phone (upsert-by-phone).
279		_, err = r.waitlist.Indexes().CreateOne(ctx, mongo.IndexModel{
280			Keys:    bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: 1}},
281			Options: options.Index().SetUnique(true),
282		})
283		return err
284	}
285	
286	// getZone loads a store's zone (nil, nil when none is configured yet).
287	func (r *repository) getZone(ctx context.Context, storeID string) (*zone, error) {
288		var z zone
289		err := r.storeZones.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "store_id", Value: storeID}}).Decode(&z)
290		if isNoDocs(err) {
291			return nil, nil
292		}
293		if err != nil {
294			return nil, errInternal("zone lookup failed")
295		}
296		return &z, nil
297	}
298	
299	// upsertZone replaces a store's whole zone policy (keyed by store_id). created_at
300	// is stamped once on insert; the returned doc reflects the stored state.
301	func (r *repository) upsertZone(ctx context.Context, z *zone) (*zone, error) {
302		now := time.Now().UTC()
303		z.UpdatedAt = now
304		set := bson.D{
305			{Key: "active", Value: z.Active},
306			{Key: "center", Value: z.Center},
307			{Key: "instant_radius_m", Value: z.InstantRadiusM},
308			{Key: "standard_radius_m", Value: z.StandardRadiusM},
309			{Key: "monsoon_enabled", Value: z.MonsoonEnabled},
310			{Key: "monsoon_rupees", Value: z.MonsoonRupees},
311			{Key: "instant_open_min", Value: z.InstantOpenMin},
312			{Key: "instant_close_min", Value: z.InstantCloseMin},
313			{Key: "instant_paused", Value: z.InstantPaused},
314			{Key: "include_pincodes", Value: z.IncludePincodes},
315			{Key: "exclude_pincodes", Value: z.ExcludePincodes},
316			{Key: "include_polygons", Value: z.IncludePolygons},
317			{Key: "exclude_polygons", Value: z.ExcludePolygons},
318			{Key: "updated_by", Value: z.UpdatedBy},
319			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
320		}
321		after := options.After
322		var out zone
323		err := r.storeZones.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
324			bson.D{{Key: "store_id", Value: z.StoreID}},
325			bson.D{
326				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
327				{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: now}}},
328			},
329			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(after).SetUpsert(true),
330		).Decode(&out)
331		if err != nil {
332			return nil, errInternal("zone save failed")
333		}
334		return &out, nil
335	}
336	
337	// listActiveZones returns every active zone (pilot: usually one). Serviceability
338	// takes the richest match across them.
339	func (r *repository) listActiveZones(ctx context.Context) ([]zone, error) {
340		cur, err := r.storeZones.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "active", Value: true}})
341		if err != nil {
342			return nil, errInternal("zone list failed")
343		}
344		out := []zone{}
345		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
346			return nil, errInternal("zone decode failed")
347		}
348		return out, nil
349	}
350	
351	// upsertWaitlist records/refreshes a would-be shopper's interest, keyed by
352	// phone (idempotent): re-submitting bumps a hit counter, never duplicates.
353	func (r *repository) upsertWaitlist(ctx context.Context, w waitlistEntry) error {
354		now := time.Now().UTC()
355		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: now}}
356		if w.Pincode != "" {
357			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "pincode", Value: w.Pincode})
358		}
359		if w.Name != "" {
360			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: w.Name})
361		}
362		if w.Lat != nil && w.Lng != nil {
363			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "lat", Value: *w.Lat}, bson.E{Key: "lng", Value: *w.Lng})
364		}
365		_, err := r.waitlist.UpdateOne(ctx,
366			bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: w.Phone}},
367			bson.D{
368				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
369				{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "hits", Value: 1}}},
370				{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: now}}},
371			},
372			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
373		)
374		if err != nil {
375			return errInternal("waitlist save failed")
376		}
377		return nil
378	}
379	
380	// ── Service ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
381	
382	// effOpenMin/effCloseMin give a zone's INSTANT hours, defaulting a never-configured
383	// zone (close==0) to 07:00–22:00 IST so the store console shows sensible times.
384	func effOpenMin(z *zone) int {
385		if z.InstantCloseMin == 0 {
386			return 420
387		}
388		return z.InstantOpenMin
389	}
390	
391	func effCloseMin(z *zone) int {
392		if z.InstantCloseMin == 0 {
393			return 1320
394		}
395		return z.InstantCloseMin
396	}
397	
398	// instantWindow decides whether a store's INSTANT lane is open right now (IST) and,
399	// when shut, a human "resumes …" label + the RFC3339 resume moment. A zone that
400	// never set hours (InstantCloseMin==0) is 24h instant unless manually paused (then
401	// it resumes at the 07:00 IST default).
402	func instantWindow(z zone, now time.Time) (open bool, resumesLabel, resumesAt string) {
403		nowIST := now.In(istZone)
404		cur := nowIST.Hour()*60 + nowIST.Minute()
405		openMin, closeMin := z.InstantOpenMin, z.InstantCloseMin
406		withinHours := true
407		if closeMin > 0 {
408			if openMin < closeMin {
409				withinHours = cur >= openMin && cur < closeMin
410			} else { // overnight window (opens in the evening, closes after midnight)
411				withinHours = cur >= openMin || cur < closeMin
412			}
413		} else {
414			openMin = 420 // no hours set → default resume 07:00 IST when manually paused
415		}
416		if withinHours && !z.InstantPaused {
417			return true, "", ""
418		}
419		// Next opening moment in IST (today if we are before today's open, else tomorrow).
420		oh, om := openMin/60, openMin%60
421		todayOpen := time.Date(nowIST.Year(), nowIST.Month(), nowIST.Day(), oh, om, 0, 0, istZone)
422		next := todayOpen
423		if !nowIST.Before(todayOpen) {
424			next = todayOpen.Add(24 * time.Hour)
425		}
426		day := "today"
427		if next.YearDay() != nowIST.YearDay() || next.Year() != nowIST.Year() {
428			day = "tomorrow"
429		}
430		return false, day + " at " + next.Format("3:04 PM"), next.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
431	}
432	
433	// serviceability answers "can we deliver here, and how fast?" for a coordinate
434	// (+ optional pincode). Defaults OPEN when no active zone is configured.
435	func (s *service) serviceability(ctx context.Context, lat, lng float64, pincode string) (*serviceabilityResult, error) {
436		if !coordsSane(lat, lng) {
437			return nil, errBadRequest("lat/lng are out of range")
438		}
439		pincode = strings.TrimSpace(pincode)
440	
441		// TESTING SHORTCUT: with INSTANT_TEST_OPEN=true, instant is offered wherever
442		// the point is serviceable, so the ⚡ Instant tab can be exercised before a
443		// store manager has drawn an instant zone. OFF by default → production still
444		// gates instant strictly on the store's instant radius.
445		instantTestOpen := strings.EqualFold(os.Getenv("INSTANT_TEST_OPEN"), "true")
446	
447		zones, err := s.repo.listActiveZones(ctx)
448		if err != nil {
449			return nil, err
450		}
451		pt := geoPt{Lat: lat, Lng: lng}
452		if len(zones) == 0 {
453			// No manager zone drawn yet — apply the hard STORE-OrgUnit fence so a point in
454			// another city (e.g. Hyderabad while the store is Lucknow) is honestly told we
455			// don't serve it yet, instead of the old fail-open "serviceable everywhere". If
456			// NO store has a usable geo, keep the pilot open (never go dark).
457			storeID, name, _, distKm, ok, err := s.repo.nearestStoreNamed(ctx, pt)
458			if err != nil {
459				return nil, err
460			}
461			if !ok {
462				return &serviceabilityResult{
463					Serviceable: true, Mode: modeString(svcStandard), Instant: instantTestOpen,
464					DefaultOpen: true, Pincode: pincode,
465				}, nil
466			}
467			dKm := math.Round(distKm*10) / 10
468			if distKm <= defaultFenceKm {
469				return &serviceabilityResult{
470					Serviceable: true, Mode: modeString(svcStandard), Instant: instantTestOpen,
471					DefaultOpen: true, Pincode: pincode,
472					StoreID: storeID, StoreName: name, DistanceKm: dKm,
473				}, nil
474			}
475			return &serviceabilityResult{
476				Serviceable: false, Mode: modeString(svcNone), Instant: false,
477				Pincode: pincode, StoreID: storeID, StoreName: name, DistanceKm: dKm,
478				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("We don’t deliver to your area yet. The nearest PYAAS store, %s, is about %.1f km away and we currently deliver within %.0f km. We’re expanding fast — we’ll let you know the moment we reach you.", name, distKm, defaultFenceKm),
479			}, nil
480		}
481	
482		best := svcNone
483		var bestStore string
484		var bestDist float64
485		var bestZone zone
486		for _, z := range zones {
487			lvl, dist := evalZone(z, pt, pincode)
488			if lvl > best {
489				best, bestStore, bestDist, bestZone = lvl, z.StoreID, dist, z
490			}
491		}
492	
493		res := &serviceabilityResult{
494			Serviceable: best > svcNone,
495			Mode:        modeString(best),
496			Instant:     best == svcInstant || (instantTestOpen && best > svcNone),
497			Pincode:     pincode,
498		}
499		if best > svcNone {
500			res.StoreID = bestStore
501			res.DistanceM = math.Round(bestDist)
502			if name, ok := s.repo.storeName(ctx, bestStore); ok {
503				res.StoreName = name
504			}
505			// Surface the winning store's monsoon surcharge so the consumer can show +
506			// charge it (the FE and createOrder both gate it to the INSTANT lane).
507			if bestZone.MonsoonEnabled && bestZone.MonsoonRupees > 0 {
508				res.MonsoonEnabled = true
509				res.MonsoonRupees = bestZone.MonsoonRupees
510			}
511			// Instant hours / manual close (IST): if this store would offer instant but
512			// it is shut right now, drop instant and tell the consumer when it resumes.
513			if res.Instant {
514				if openNow, label, at := instantWindow(bestZone, time.Now()); !openNow {
515					res.Instant = false
516					res.InstantClosed = true
517					res.InstantResumesLabel = label
518					res.InstantResumesAt = at
519				}
520			}
521		}
522		if best == svcNone {
523			// Out of every drawn zone → give the Coming-Soon screen the nearest store +
524			// a natural reason, so it reads the same whether or not a zone is drawn.
525			if storeID, name, _, distKm, ok, e := s.repo.nearestStoreNamed(ctx, pt); e == nil && ok {
526				res.StoreID = storeID
527				res.StoreName = name
528				res.DistanceKm = math.Round(distKm*10) / 10
529				res.Reason = fmt.Sprintf("We don’t deliver to your area yet. The nearest PYAAS store, %s, is about %.1f km away. We’re expanding fast — we’ll let you know the moment we reach you.", name, distKm)
530			}
531		}
532		return res, nil
533	}
534	
535	// storeZone returns the store manager's configured zone (guarded to the store
536	// the actor manages). A store with no zone yet is a 404 the UI treats as "draw
537	// your first zone".
538	func (s *service) storeZone(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID string) (*zone, error) {
539		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
540			return nil, err
541		}
542		z, err := s.repo.getZone(ctx, storeID)
543		if err != nil {
544			return nil, err
545		}
546		if z == nil {
547			return nil, errNotFound("no serviceability zone configured for this store")
548		}
549		return z, nil
550	}
551	
552	// zoneInput is the store manager's PUT body. Center is {lat,lng}. Radii accept
553	// either metres (camelCase, contract canonical) OR kilometres (snake_case, what
554	// the Saathi store console sends) — normalized to metres in upsertZone. Pincode
555	// lists accept both camel and snake keys. The backend is the tolerant seam so
556	// the two clients never have to agree on units.
557	type zoneInput struct {
558		Active           *bool     `json:"active"`
559		Center           *geoPt    `json:"center"`
560		InstantRadiusM   float64   `json:"instantRadiusM"`
561		StandardRadiusM  float64   `json:"standardRadiusM"`
562		InstantRadiusKm  float64   `json:"instant_radius_km"`
563		StandardRadiusKm float64   `json:"standard_radius_km"`
564		IncludePincodes  []string  `json:"includePincodes"`
565		ExcludePincodes  []string  `json:"excludePincodes"`
566		IncludePincodesS []string  `json:"include_pincodes"`
567		ExcludePincodesS []string  `json:"exclude_pincodes"`
568		IncludePolygons  [][]geoPt `json:"includePolygons"`
569		ExcludePolygons  [][]geoPt `json:"excludePolygons"`
570		// Monsoon surcharge (₹, INSTANT orders only). Accept camel + snake (Saathi console).
571		MonsoonEnabled  bool `json:"monsoonEnabled"`
572		MonsoonRupees   int  `json:"monsoonRupees"`
573		MonsoonEnabledS bool `json:"monsoon_enabled"`
574		MonsoonRupeesS  int  `json:"monsoon_rupees"`
575		// Instant hours (minutes since IST midnight) + manual pause. camel + snake.
576		InstantOpenMin   *int  `json:"instantOpenMin"`
577		InstantCloseMin  *int  `json:"instantCloseMin"`
578		InstantPaused    *bool `json:"instantPaused"`
579		InstantOpenMinS  *int  `json:"instant_open_min"`
580		InstantCloseMinS *int  `json:"instant_close_min"`
581		InstantPausedS   *bool `json:"instant_paused"`
582	}
583	
584	// normalize folds the km + snake aliases onto the canonical metres/camel fields.
585	func (in *zoneInput) normalize() {
586		if in.StandardRadiusM == 0 && in.StandardRadiusKm > 0 {
587			in.StandardRadiusM = in.StandardRadiusKm * 1000
588		}
589		if in.InstantRadiusM == 0 && in.InstantRadiusKm > 0 {
590			in.InstantRadiusM = in.InstantRadiusKm * 1000
591		}
592		if len(in.IncludePincodes) == 0 && len(in.IncludePincodesS) > 0 {
593			in.IncludePincodes = in.IncludePincodesS
594		}
595		if len(in.ExcludePincodes) == 0 && len(in.ExcludePincodesS) > 0 {
596			in.ExcludePincodes = in.ExcludePincodesS
597		}
598		if !in.MonsoonEnabled && in.MonsoonEnabledS {
599			in.MonsoonEnabled = in.MonsoonEnabledS
600		}
601		if in.MonsoonRupees == 0 && in.MonsoonRupeesS > 0 {
602			in.MonsoonRupees = in.MonsoonRupeesS
603		}
604		if in.InstantOpenMin == nil {
605			in.InstantOpenMin = in.InstantOpenMinS
606		}
607		if in.InstantCloseMin == nil {
608			in.InstantCloseMin = in.InstantCloseMinS
609		}
610		if in.InstantPaused == nil {
611			in.InstantPaused = in.InstantPausedS
612		}
613	}
614	
615	func validateRadius(m float64) *apiError {
616		if m < minRadiusM || m > maxRadiusM {
617			return errUnprocessable("INVALID_RADIUS", "radius must be between 100 and 60000 metres")
618		}
619		return nil
620	}
621	
622	func validateRings(rings [][]geoPt, what string) *apiError {
623		for _, ring := range rings {
624			if len(ring) < 3 {
625				return errUnprocessable("INVALID_POLYGON", what+" polygon needs at least 3 points")
626			}
627			for _, p := range ring {
628				if !coordsSane(p.Lat, p.Lng) {
629					return errUnprocessable("INVALID_POLYGON", what+" polygon has an out-of-range point")
630				}
631			}
632		}
633		return nil
634	}
635	
636	func cleanPincodes(in []string) []string {
637		out := make([]string, 0, len(in))
638		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
639		for _, p := range in {
640			p = strings.TrimSpace(p)
641			if p == "" {
642				continue
643			}
644			if _, dup := seen[p]; dup {
645				continue
646			}
647			seen[p] = struct{}{}
648			out = append(out, p)
649		}
650		return out
651	}
652	
653	// upsertZone validates a manager's zone config and stores it (guarded to the
654	// store they manage). Radii are range-checked (100..60000 m); if both circles
655	// are set, the instant circle must sit inside the standard one.
656	func (s *service) upsertZone(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, storeID string, in zoneInput) (*zone, error) {
657		if err := s.assertStore(ctx, actor, storeID); err != nil {
658			return nil, err
659		}
660		in.normalize() // fold km + snake aliases onto metres/camel
661		if in.Center == nil || !coordsSane(in.Center.Lat, in.Center.Lng) {
662			return nil, errUnprocessable("INVALID_CENTER", "a sane center {lat,lng} is required")
663		}
664		// A zone must serve at least the standard circle.
665		if err := validateRadius(in.StandardRadiusM); err != nil {
666			return nil, err
667		}
668		if in.InstantRadiusM > 0 {
669			if err := validateRadius(in.InstantRadiusM); err != nil {
670				return nil, err
671			}
672			if in.InstantRadiusM > in.StandardRadiusM {
673				return nil, errUnprocessable("INVALID_RADIUS", "the instant radius must not exceed the standard radius")
674			}
675		}
676		if err := validateRings(in.ExcludePolygons, "exclude"); err != nil {
677			return nil, err
678		}
679		if err := validateRings(in.IncludePolygons, "include"); err != nil {
680			return nil, err
681		}
682		if in.MonsoonRupees < 0 || in.MonsoonRupees > 500 {
683			return nil, errUnprocessable("INVALID_MONSOON", "monsoon surcharge must be between 0 and 500 rupees")
684		}
685		// Instant hours default to 07:00–22:00 IST; a manual pause shuts instant now.
686		openMin, closeMin := 420, 1320
687		if in.InstantOpenMin != nil {
688			openMin = *in.InstantOpenMin
689		}
690		if in.InstantCloseMin != nil {
691			closeMin = *in.InstantCloseMin
692		}
693		paused := false
694		if in.InstantPaused != nil {
695			paused = *in.InstantPaused
696		}
697		if openMin < 0 || openMin >= 1440 || closeMin < 0 || closeMin > 1440 {
698			return nil, errUnprocessable("INVALID_HOURS", "instant hours must be within a day (0..1440 minutes)")
699		}
700	
701		active := true
702		if in.Active != nil {
703			active = *in.Active
704		}
705		z := &zone{
706			StoreID:         storeID,
707			Active:          active,
708			Center:          newGeoPoint(in.Center.Lat, in.Center.Lng),
709			InstantRadiusM:  in.InstantRadiusM,
710			StandardRadiusM: in.StandardRadiusM,
711			IncludePincodes: cleanPincodes(in.IncludePincodes),
712			ExcludePincodes: cleanPincodes(in.ExcludePincodes),
713			IncludePolygons: in.IncludePolygons,
714			ExcludePolygons: in.ExcludePolygons,
715			MonsoonEnabled:  in.MonsoonEnabled,
716			MonsoonRupees:   in.MonsoonRupees,
717			InstantOpenMin:  openMin,
718			InstantCloseMin: closeMin,
719			InstantPaused:   paused,
720			UpdatedBy:       actor.PartyID,
721		}
722		return s.repo.upsertZone(ctx, z)
723	}

736	func (s *service) joinWaitlist(ctx context.Context, in waitlistEntry) error {
737		phone := normalizePhone(in.Phone)

740		}

745			// A bad coordinate should not block a waitlist join — just drop it.
746			in.Lat, in.Lng = nil, nil
747		}
748		return s.repo.upsertWaitlist(ctx, in)

753	// serviceability — GET /consumer/serviceability?lat=&lng=&pincode=.
754	// Consumer-app-gated (same X-Parag-App-Key as /catalog), raw-JSON.
755	func (h *handler) serviceability(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
756		if !h.svc.appKeyOK(r) {
757			writeErr(w, errForbidden("serviceability is available from the PARAG app only"))
758			return

762		lng, err2 := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("lng")), 64)
763		if err1 != nil || err2 != nil {

765			return
766		}
767		res, err := h.svc.serviceability(r.Context(), lat, lng, q.Get("pincode"))
768		if err != nil {
769			writeErr(w, err)
770			return
771		}
772		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)

776	// an out-of-area shopper's interest (upsert by phone).

778		if !h.svc.appKeyOK(r) {
779			writeErr(w, errForbidden("the waitlist is available from the PARAG app only"))
780			return
781		}
782		var body struct {

784			Pincode string   `json:"pincode"`
785			Name    string   `json:"name"`
786			Lat     *float64 `json:"lat"`

795		}); err != nil {
```

```text
229: 	filter := bson.D{{Key: "subscription_id", Value: subID}, {Key: "consumer_id", Value: consumerID}}
230: 	filter = append(filter, guard...)
231: 	set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()})
232: 	after := options.After
233: 	var s subscription
234: 	err := r.subscriptions.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter,
235: 		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
236: 		&options.FindOneAndUpdateOptions{ReturnDocument: &after},

240: 	}

247: // claimSubscriptionDay atomically claims (subscription, day) for order creation:
248: // the guard last_order_date != day admits exactly ONE winner per IST day —
249: // the same exactly-once shape as advanceMandateCharge. Returns whether THIS
250: // call won the claim.
251: func (r *repository) claimSubscriptionDay(ctx context.Context, subID, day string) (bool, error) {
252: 	res, err := r.subscriptions.UpdateOne(ctx,
253: 		bson.D{
254: 			{Key: "subscription_id", Value: subID},
255: 			{Key: "status", Value: "active"},
256: 			{Key: "last_order_date", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: day}}},
257: 		},
258: 		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
259: 			{Key: "last_order_date", Value: day},
260: 			{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
261: 		}}})
262: 	if err != nil {
263: 		return false, errInternal("subscription day claim failed")
264: 	}
265: 	return res.ModifiedCount == 1, nil
266: }

275: // when the RECONCILER cancels a scheduled upcoming order because the plan
```

```text
22	// appKeyOK enforces the consumer-app-only gate: the request must carry an
23	// X-Parag-App-Key matching CONSUMER_APP_KEY (constant-time). FAIL-CLOSED: an
24	// unset server key denies everyone rather than opening the gate — traceability
25	// and the PDF label are for the PARAG app only, and a missing env var on a
26	// deployment must not silently make them public. Local dev sets
27	// CONSUMER_APP_KEY in .env (see .env.example) to the same value the app ships
28	// as EXPO_PUBLIC_CONSUMER_APP_KEY.
29	func (s *service) appKeyOK(r *http.Request) bool {
30		if s.appKey == "" {
31			s.log.Warn("consumer traceability denied: CONSUMER_APP_KEY is not configured on this deployment (fail-closed)")
32			return false
33		}
34		got := r.Header.Get("X-Parag-App-Key")
35		return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(got), []byte(s.appKey)) == 1
36	}

38	// Traceability bridge — the ONE sanctioned Saathi↔consumer touchpoint. It lets
39	// the consumer app resolve a scanned pack QR to its honest cooperative
40	// provenance by REUSING the existing public trace resolver (publictrace.ScanQR),
41	// then maps the operator's QRScanResponse onto the consumer app's MilkBatch
42	// shape (lib/milk.ts) so the shipped lookupBatch() seam composes unchanged. A
43	// code that doesn't resolve returns 404 and the app falls back to its offline
44	// demo seed.
45	//
46	// The bridge reads operator provenance and touches NO operator business flow,
47	// PII, or money. The one incidental write is the public scan-count telemetry
48	// increment inside ScanQR — a consumer scan legitimately IS a public scan, and
49	// this is the exact behaviour the operator's own /public/qr endpoint already
50	// performs (best-effort, async, a bare counter). No new mutation is introduced.

82	// consumer MilkBatch. Pure function (no I/O) so it is unit-testable.
83	func mapToMilkBatch(code string, r *publictrace.QRScanResponse) milkBatchView {

128	// formatTestValue renders a measured test value with its unit (e.g. "3.5%"),
129	// or "" for a boolean adulteration screen that carries no numeric reading.
130	func formatTestValue(v float64, unit string) string {
131		if v == 0 && unit == "" {
132			return ""
133		}
134		return fmt.Sprintf("%g%s", v, unit)
135	}

137	// traceByCode resolves a scanned code to the consumer provenance view, reusing
138	// the operator's public QR resolver read-only. It mirrors the operator's public
139	// scan (ResolvePublicQR): resolves BOTH consignment batch QRs (the QC "send QR"
140	// tokens, lowercase hex) AND product-lot pack QRs (PRG-...). Case-insensitive,
141	// because the app uppercases scanned codes while consignment tokens are stored
142	// lowercase.
143	func (s *service) traceByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*milkBatchView, error) {
144		code = strings.TrimSpace(code)
145		if code == "" {
146			return nil, errBadRequest("a batch/QR code is required")
147		}
148		for _, c := range []string{code, strings.ToLower(code), strings.ToUpper(code)} {
149			res, err := s.trace.ResolvePublicQR(ctx, c)
150			if err != nil || res == nil {
151				continue // try the next case variant; unknown/integrity-failed → fall through
152			}
153			switch v := res.(type) {
154			case *publictrace.QRScanResponse:
155				mb := mapToMilkBatch(code, v)
156				return &mb, nil
157			case *publictrace.BatchQualityReport:
158				mb := mapReportToMilkBatch(code, v)
159				return &mb, nil
160			}
161		}
162		// Not resolvable — 404 so the app falls back to its offline seed.
163		return nil, errNotFound("no traceability found for this code")
164	}

167	// pooled batch) onto the consumer MilkBatch — honest provenance: the contributing
168	// society, the tests it passed, the plant.
169	func mapReportToMilkBatch(code string, r *publictrace.BatchQualityReport) milkBatchView {
170		batchCode := r.BatchCode
171		if batchCode == "" {
172			batchCode = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(code))
173		}
174		district := r.Samiti.District

181			plant = r.Plant.Name
182		}

184			BatchCode:      batchCode,
185			Product:        "Cooperative pooled milk batch",
186			UnionName:      union,
187			Plant:          plant,
188			District:       district,
189			State:          "Uttar Pradesh",
190			MemberVillages: 1, // a batch pools from one contributing society
191			PouringMembers: r.Farmers.Total,
192			Tests:          []qualityTestView{},
193			Verified:       r.Quality != nil && r.Quality.OverallPass,
194		}
195		if r.Collection.PickedUpAt != nil {
196			mb.BatchDate = r.Collection.PickedUpAt.Format("2006-01-02")
197			mb.PackedAt = r.Collection.PickedUpAt.Format("2006-01-02")
198		}
199		if r.Quality != nil {

201				val := ""
202				if t.Value != nil {

204				}

206				switch strings.ToUpper(t.Parameter) {

216			}
217		}

223	func (h *handler) traceByCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
224		if !h.svc.appKeyOK(r) {
225			writeErr(w, errForbidden("traceability is available from the PARAG app only"))
226			return
227		}
228		mb, err := h.svc.traceByCode(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "code"))

236	// traceLabel returns a self-contained HTML provenance label (all values + the
237	// pack QR image) that the app turns into a downloadable PDF (expo-print). Same

239	func (h *handler) traceLabel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

260	// qrDataURI renders `content` as a QR PNG and returns a data: URI for inline
261	// embedding in the label HTML (self-contained — no external image request).
262	func qrDataURI(content string) (string, error) {
263		png, err := qrcode.Encode(content, qrcode.Medium, 320)
264		if err != nil {
265			return "", err
266		}
267		return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(png), nil
268	}
```

```text
492: //               order (status placed, delivery_date=tomorrow, NO delivery task,

494: //               everything: subscription edits reconcile it, pause/vacation

497: //               the LIVE subscription, its line refreshed, the wallet floor

499: //               subscription edits no longer touch it.
```

```text
89	// MarshalJSON flattens the doorstep Preferences (receiver_name, ring_bell,
90	// call_before, instructions, door_photo_uri, geo_label) onto the address wire
91	// object — the app reads them top-level, and an address book that never sends
92	// them back silently blanked every saved doorstep profile on hydration.
93	func (a address) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
94		type plain address // method-free alias, avoids recursion
95		raw, err := json.Marshal(plain(a))
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, err
98		}
99		if len(a.Preferences) == 0 {
100			return raw, nil
101		}
102		var m map[string]any
103		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		for _, k := range []string{"receiver_name", "geo_label", "ring_bell", "call_before", "instructions", "door_photo_uri"} {
107			if v, ok := a.Preferences[k]; ok {
108				m[k] = v
109			}
110		}
111		return json.Marshal(m)
112	}
```

```text
518: func (s *service) insertSubscriptionOrder(ctx context.Context, sub *subscription, addr *address, day string, locked bool, at time.Time) (*order, error) {
519: 	acct, _ := s.repo.findAccountByID(ctx, sub.ConsumerID)
520: 	name, phone := "", ""
521: 	if acct != nil {
522: 		phone = acct.Phone
523: 		if acct.FullName != nil {
524: 			name = *acct.FullName
525: 		}
526: 	}
527: 	subtotal := round2(sub.UnitPrice * float64(sub.Qty))
528: 	// SUBSCRIPTION deliveries carry NO delivery fee — the consumer app quotes and
529: 	// charges the bare subtotal on the Subscribe button (lib/api.ts), so the
530: 	// server must debit the same. A ₹15 fee here over-charged every subscription
531: 	// delivery vs the price the member agreed to.
532: 	fee := subscriptionDeliveryFee
533: 	now := at.UTC()
534: 	o := &order{
535: 		MongoID: primitive.NewObjectID(), OrderID: newOrderID(), UserID: sub.ConsumerID.Hex(), Status: "placed",
536: 		Subtotal: subtotal, DeliveryFee: fee, Total: round2(subtotal + fee), PaymentMethod: "wallet",
537: 		AddressLabel: addr.Label, AddressText: joinAddress(addr), RiderID: nil,
538: 		PlacedAt: now, Priority: "normal",
539: 		// The 05:00–07:30 morning route — same window the FE sweep prints.
540: 		DeliveryWindow: "05:00 - 07:30 AM", Lane: "morning",
541: 		Items: []orderItem{{
542: 			ID: newItemID(), ProductID: sub.ProductID, Name: sub.Name,
543: 			Variant: sub.Variant, Price: round2(sub.UnitPrice), Qty: sub.Qty,
544: 		}},
545: 		ConsumerName: name, Phone: phone, Geo: &geoPoint{Lat: *addr.Lat, Lng: *addr.Lng},
546: 		CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
547: 		SubscriptionID: sub.SubscriptionID, ScheduledFor: day,
548: 	}
549: 	// Flag a free-day trial delivery for DISPLAY + ANALYTICS (badge "FREE" in the
550: 	// app, count free milk in reporting). Peeking the trial ledger never advances
551: 	// it and never gates the wallet/hold — the order is still placed only when
552: 	// funded (unchanged); the actual 0 charge is applied at delivery.
553: 	if isTrialProduct(sub.ProductID) {
554: 		if t, terr := s.repo.getOrCreateTrial(ctx, sub.ConsumerID); terr == nil && trialPhaseFor(t.DeliveredPaid, t.DeliveredFree) == trialPhaseFree {
555: 			o.TrialFree = true
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: 	if locked {
559: 		o.SubLockedAt = now.Format(time.RFC3339)
560: 	}
561: 	if err := s.repo.insertOrder(ctx, o); err != nil {
562: 		return nil, err
563: 	}
564: 	if locked {
565: 		s.createDeliveryForOrder(ctx, o)
566: 	}
567: 	s.repo.setSubscriptionOrder(ctx, sub.SubscriptionID, o.OrderID)
568: 	return o, nil
569: }

571: // cancelScheduledSubOrder cancels a still-unlocked preview (worker path only —
572: // guarded so a locked or already-cancelled order is never touched).
573: func (s *service) cancelScheduledSubOrder(ctx context.Context, o *order) {
574: 	_, _ = s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, o.OrderID, o.UserID,
575: 		bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "cancelled"}},
576: 		bson.D{
577: 			{Key: "status", Value: "placed"},
578: 			{Key: "sub_locked_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: bson.A{nil, ""}}}},
579: 		})
580: }
581: 
582: // refreshSubOrder re-derives a preview's line from the LIVE subscription, so a
583: // qty / price / variant edit made before the midnight lock shows on the
584: // upcoming order (and bills correctly at lock).
585: func (s *service) refreshSubOrder(ctx context.Context, o *order, sub *subscription) *order {
586: 	if len(o.Items) == 1 &&
587: 		o.Items[0].Qty == sub.Qty &&
588: 		o.Items[0].Price == round2(sub.UnitPrice) &&
589: 		o.Items[0].Variant == sub.Variant {
590: 		return o
591: 	}
592: 	subtotal := round2(sub.UnitPrice * float64(sub.Qty))
593: 	fee := subscriptionDeliveryFee // subscriptions never carry the ₹15 fee (see insertSubscriptionOrder)
594: 	updated, err := s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, o.OrderID, o.UserID, bson.D{
595: 		{Key: "order_items", Value: []orderItem{{
596: 			ID: newItemID(), ProductID: sub.ProductID, Name: sub.Name,
597: 			Variant: sub.Variant, Price: round2(sub.UnitPrice), Qty: sub.Qty,
598: 		}}},
599: 		{Key: "subtotal", Value: subtotal},
600: 		{Key: "delivery_fee", Value: fee},
601: 		{Key: "total", Value: round2(subtotal + fee)},
602: 	}, bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: "placed"}})
603: 	if err != nil {
604: 		return o
605: 	}
606: 	return updated
607: }

609: // sweepSubscriptionOrders runs the full lifecycle for one tick: expire stale
610: // previews, LOCK today's, create same-day starts, SCHEDULE tomorrow's (from
611: // 13:00 IST), and reconcile tomorrow's previews against subscription edits.
612: // Exactly-once per (subscription, day) via the claim; returns how many orders
613: // went LIVE (locked) this tick.
614: func (s *service) sweepSubscriptionOrders(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) int {
615: 	nowIST := now.In(istZone)
616: 	today := istToday(now)
617: 	tomorrow := addDaysIST(today, 1)
618: 	placed := 0
619: 
620: 	// 1) EXPIRE — previews whose day passed without ever locking (server down
621: 	//    over midnight, wallet never funded): cancel; stale milk never ships.
622: 	if stale, err := s.repo.listUnlockedSubOrders(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "$lt", Value: today}}); err == nil {
623: 		for i := range stale {
624: 			s.cancelScheduledSubOrder(ctx, &stale[i])
625: 		}
626: 	}
627: 
628: 	// 2) LOCK — first tick after IST midnight. Re-evaluate each preview against
629: 	//    the live subscription (the 11:59 PM edit law): a pause/cancel/vacation
630: 	//    made before the cutoff kills it; otherwise refresh the line, enforce
631: 	//    the wallet floor (unfunded → retried every tick), then create the
632: 	//    store delivery task.
633: 	if due, err := s.repo.listUnlockedSubOrders(ctx, today); err == nil {
634: 		for i := range due {
635: 			o := &due[i]
636: 			sub, _ := s.repo.findSubscriptionByID(ctx, o.SubscriptionID)
637: 			if sub == nil || !subscriptionDueOn(sub, today) {
638: 				s.cancelScheduledSubOrder(ctx, o)
639: 				continue
640: 			}
641: 			o = s.refreshSubOrder(ctx, o, sub)
642: 			if wv, werr := s.wallet(ctx, sub.ConsumerID); werr != nil || wv.Available < o.Total {
643: 				continue
644: 			}
645: 			upd, uerr := s.repo.updateOrder(ctx, o.OrderID, o.UserID,
646: 				bson.D{{Key: "sub_locked_at", Value: now.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)}},
647: 				bson.D{
648: 					{Key: "status", Value: "placed"},
649: 					{Key: "sub_locked_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: bson.A{nil, ""}}}},
650: 				})
651: 			if uerr != nil {
652: 				continue // raced with another replica — it owns the lock
653: 			}
654: 			s.createDeliveryForOrder(ctx, upd)
655: 			placed++
656: 		}
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	subs, err := s.repo.listActiveSubscriptions(ctx)
660: 	if err != nil {
661: 		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "subscription sweep: scan failed")
662: 		return placed
663: 	}
664: 	for i := range subs {
665: 		sub := &subs[i]
666: 		// 3) SAME-DAY — a subscription starting (or resumed) today that never got
667: 		//    a preview still delivers today: wallet floor, claim, create LOCKED.
668: 		if sub.LastOrderDate != today && subscriptionDueOn(sub, today) {
669: 			if addr, aerr := s.subscriptionAddress(ctx, sub.ConsumerID); aerr == nil {
670: 				lineTotal := round2(sub.UnitPrice * float64(sub.Qty))
671: 				cost := lineTotal + subscriptionDeliveryFee // affordability check must match the fee-free debit
672: 				if wv, werr := s.wallet(ctx, sub.ConsumerID); werr == nil && wv.Available >= cost {
673: 					if won, _ := s.repo.claimSubscriptionDay(ctx, sub.SubscriptionID, today); won {
674: 						if _, oerr := s.insertSubscriptionOrder(ctx, sub, addr, today, true, now); oerr == nil {
675: 							placed++
676: 						} else {
677: 							s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "subscription sweep: same-day order failed",
678: 								"subscription", sub.SubscriptionID, "day", today)
679: 						}
680: 					}
681: 				}
682: 			}
683: 		}
684: 		// 4) SCHEDULE — from 13:00 IST, materialise TOMORROW's delivery as a
685: 		//    visible, still-modifiable upcoming order (no delivery task, no
686: 		//    money, no wallet gate — the member can top up until midnight).
687: 		if nowIST.Hour() >= scheduleFromHourIST && sub.LastOrderDate != tomorrow && subscriptionDueOn(sub, tomorrow) {
688: 			if addr, aerr := s.subscriptionAddress(ctx, sub.ConsumerID); aerr == nil {
689: 				if won, _ := s.repo.claimSubscriptionDay(ctx, sub.SubscriptionID, tomorrow); won {
690: 					if _, oerr := s.insertSubscriptionOrder(ctx, sub, addr, tomorrow, false, now); oerr != nil {
691: 						s.repo.unclaimSubscriptionDay(ctx, sub.SubscriptionID, tomorrow) // retry next tick
692: 					}
693: 				}
694: 			}
695: 		}
696: 	}
697: 
698: 	// 5) RECONCILE — tomorrow's previews against their live subscriptions:
699: 	//    pause/cancel/vacation → cancel the upcoming order AND release the day
700: 	//    claim (a resume before midnight re-schedules it); qty/price edits →
701: 	//    refresh the shown line. A shopper's direct cancel is untouched here
702: 	//    (its claim stays, so the day stays skipped).
703: 	if upcoming, err := s.repo.listUnlockedSubOrders(ctx, tomorrow); err == nil {
704: 		for i := range upcoming {
705: 			o := &upcoming[i]
706: 			sub, _ := s.repo.findSubscriptionByID(ctx, o.SubscriptionID)
707: 			if sub == nil || !subscriptionDueOn(sub, tomorrow) {
708: 				s.cancelScheduledSubOrder(ctx, o)
709: 				s.repo.unclaimSubscriptionDay(ctx, o.SubscriptionID, tomorrow)
710: 				continue
711: 			}
712: 			s.refreshSubOrder(ctx, o, sub)
713: 		}
714: 	}
715: 
716: 	if placed > 0 {
717: 		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "subscription sweep placed morning orders", "day", today, "orders", placed)
718: 	}
719: 	return placed
720: }

722: func joinAddress(a *address) string {
723: 	parts := []string{}
724: 	for _, p := range []string{a.Line1, a.Line2, a.City, a.Pincode} {
725: 		if p != "" {
726: 			parts = append(parts, p)
727: 		}
728: 	}
729: 	out := ""
730: 	for i, p := range parts {
731: 		if i > 0 {
732: 			out += ", "
733: 		}
734: 		out += p
735: 	}
736: 	return out
737: }

739: // subscriptionOrderWorker — the background scheduler (no external cron). Ticks
740: // every 15 minutes; each tick runs the full lifecycle: from 13:00 IST it
741: // SCHEDULES tomorrow's visible upcoming orders, keeps them reconciled with
742: // subscription edits until the 11:59 PM cutoff, and at the first tick after
743: // IST midnight it LOCKS them (delivery tasks created) — so the store manager's
744: // queue is filled before the 05:00 route WITHOUT any consumer opening the app.
745: // The day-claim + lock guard make every duplicate tick (or replica) a no-op.
746: func (s *service) subscriptionOrderWorker(ctx context.Context) {
747: 	const tick = 15 * time.Minute
748: 	// Immediate first sweep on boot (covers a server restart mid-morning).
749: 	runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Minute)
750: 	s.sweepSubscriptionOrders(runCtx, time.Now())
751: 	cancel()
752: 	t := time.NewTicker(tick)
753: 	defer t.Stop()
754: 	for {
755: 		select {
756: 		case <-ctx.Done():
757: 			return
758: 		case now := <-t.C:
759: 			runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Minute)
760: 			s.sweepSubscriptionOrders(runCtx, now)
761: 			cancel()
762: 		}
763: 	}
764: }
```

```text
=== order struct ===
package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
)

// Orders — the consumer purchase aggregate. Mirrors the shipped FE Order shape
// (lib/api.ts) exactly so the app's placeOrder/listOrders/getOrder/cancelOrder/
// reviewOrder seams compose without any FE change. The backend OWNS the order;
// money is debited on DELIVERY via the server wallet (the FE's
// settleDeliveredOrders sweep calls /wallet/debit, idempotent by order id), so
// creation never moves money. All rows are scoped to the authenticated shopper.

const collOrders = "consumer_orders"

// Delivery-fee policy — kept identical to the FE (lib/api.ts).
const freeDeliveryOver = 199.0
const deliveryFee = 15.0

// Fair-use order caps — kept identical to the FE (lib/pricing.ts).
const maxQtyPerProduct = 10
const maxItemsPerOrder = 30

func deliveryFeeFor(subtotal float64) float64 {
	if subtotal >= freeDeliveryOver || subtotal == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return deliveryFee
}

// Statuses a placed order may still be cancelled from. "assigned" is included so a
// customer can still cancel AFTER a rider claims/accepts but BEFORE pickup — once the
// order is picked up (out_for_delivery) it can no longer be cancelled or returned.
var cancellableStatuses = map[string]bool{"placed": true, "confirmed": true, "assigned": true}

// ── Documents (bson) + wire shape (json matches the FE Order) ────────────────

type orderItem struct {
	ID        string  `bson:"id"         json:"id"`
	ProductID string  `bson:"product_id" json:"product_id"`
	Name      string  `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
	Variant   string  `bson:"variant"    json:"variant"`
	Price     float64 `bson:"price"      json:"price"`
	Qty       int     `bson:"qty"        json:"qty"`
}

type rider struct {
	ID         string   `bson:"id"          json:"id"`
	FullName   string   `bson:"full_name"   json:"full_name"`
	Phone      string   `bson:"phone"       json:"phone"`
	Vehicle    *string  `bson:"vehicle"     json:"vehicle"`
	Rating     *float64 `bson:"rating"      json:"rating"`
	CurrentLat *float64 `bson:"current_lat" json:"current_lat"`
	CurrentLng *float64 `bson:"current_lng" json:"current_lng"`
}

type orderReview struct {
	Rating    int       `bson:"rating"     json:"rating"`
	Comment   string    `bson:"comment"    json:"comment"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
}

type geoPoint struct {
	Lat float64 `bson:"lat" json:"lat"`
	Lng float64 `bson:"lng" json:"lng"`
}

// order is stored per shopper. json tags reproduce the FE Order EXACTLY; fields
// the FE never reads (owner/geo/audit) are json:"-".
type order struct {
	MongoID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"           json:"-"`
	OrderID        string             `bson:"order_id"                json:"id"`
	UserID         string             `bson:"user_id"                 json:"user_id"` // consumer id (hex)
	Status         string             `bson:"status"                  json:"status"`
	Subtotal       float64            `bson:"subtotal"                json:"subtotal"`
	DeliveryFee    float64            `bson:"delivery_fee"            json:"delivery_fee"`
	MonsoonFee     float64            `bson:"monsoon_fee,omitempty"   json:"monsoon_fee,omitempty"`
	Total          float64            `bson:"total"                   json:"total"`
	PaymentMethod  string             `bson:"payment_method"          json:"payment_method"`
	AddressLabel   string             `bson:"address_label"           json:"address_label"`
	AddressText    string             `bson:"address_text"            json:"address_text"`
	RiderID        *string            `bson:"rider_id"                json:"rider_id"`
	PlacedAt       time.Time          `bson:"placed_at"               json:"placed_at"`
	Priority       string             `bson:"priority,omitempty"      json:"priority,omitempty"`
	DeliveryWindow string             `bson:"delivery_window,omitempty" json:"delivery_window,omitempty"`
	DeliveryDate   string             `bson:"delivery_date,omitempty" json:"delivery_date,omitempty"`
	BuyerGSTIN     string             `bson:"buyer_gstin,omitempty"   json:"buyer_gstin,omitempty"`
	ProofPhotoURL  string             `bson:"proof_photo_url,omitempty" json:"proof_photo_url,omitempty"`
	Lane           string             `bson:"lane"                    json:"lane,omitempty"`
	// TrialFree marks a 2+2 free-day subscription delivery: the sticker Total
	// stands, but the wallet charge at delivery is 0 (trialChargeFor). Set at
	// creation from the trial phase — DISPLAY + ANALYTICS only, it never gates the
	// wallet or the hold. Absent (omitempty) on every normal order.
	TrialFree bool         `bson:"trial_free,omitempty"    json:"trial_free,omitempty"`
	Items     []orderItem  `bson:"order_items"             json:"order_items"`
	Rider     *rider       `bson:"riders,omitempty"        json:"riders"`
	CanReview bool         `bson:"can_review"              json:"can_review"`
	Review    *orderReview `bson:"review,omitempty"        json:"review"`
	// Owner-facing / delivery metadata — never sent back to the shopper client.
	ConsumerName string    `bson:"consumer_name,omitempty" json:"-"`
	Phone        string    `bson:"phone,omitempty"         json:"-"`
	Geo          *geoPoint `bson:"geo,omitempty"           json:"-"`
	CreatedAt    time.Time `bson:"created_at"              json:"-"`
	UpdatedAt    time.Time `bson:"updated_at"              json:"-"`
	// Subscription linkage (worker-created morning orders, subscriptions.go).
	// ScheduledFor is the IST day it delivers — surfaced as delivery_date (the
	// FE Order field), so tomorrow's order shows as UPCOMING in the app from
	// the moment it is scheduled. SubLockedAt is stamped at the midnight lock:
	// before it, the order is a modifiable preview (subscription edits
	// reconcile it, the shopper may cancel it); after it, the delivery task
	// exists and the store owns it.
	SubscriptionID string `bson:"subscription_id,omitempty" json:"-"`
	ScheduledFor   string `bson:"scheduled_for,omitempty"   json:"delivery_date,omitempty"`
	SubLockedAt    string `bson:"sub_locked_at,omitempty"   json:"-"`
}

func newOrderID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "ord_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}
func newItemID() string {
	b := make([]byte, 6)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return "item_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

// ── Repo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```text
67: // ensureIndexes creates the consumer collections' indexes at startup — the
68: // consumer module owns its own indexes so it never touches shared Saathi infra.
69: func (r *repository) ensureIndexes(ctx context.Context) error {
70: 	specs := []struct {
71: 		c    *mongo.Collection
72: 		keys bson.D
73: 		opts *options.IndexOptions
74: 	}{
75: 		{r.accounts, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
76: 		{r.accounts, bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}, nil},
77: 		{r.otp, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: 1}}, nil},
78: 		{r.otp, bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetExpireAfterSeconds(0)},
79: 		{r.refresh, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
80: 		{r.refresh, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
81: 		{r.addresses, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
82: 		{r.wallets, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
83: 		{r.walletTxns, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "seq", Value: -1}}, nil},
84: 		// EXACTLY-ONCE money gate: a (consumer, ref, type) may exist at most once,
85: 		// so a duplicate/concurrent same-ref movement can never double-credit.
86: 		// Partial — only enforced for rows that actually carry a ref.
87: 		{r.walletTxns, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "ref_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "type", Value: 1}},
88: 			options.Index().SetUnique(true).SetPartialFilterExpression(bson.D{{Key: "ref_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: ""}}}})},
89: 		// A payment order id is globally unique — the top-up idempotency anchor.
90: 		{r.payOrders, bson.D{{Key: "order_id", Value: 1}}, options.Index().SetUnique(true)},
91: 		{r.payOrders, bson.D{{Key: "consumer_id", Value: 1}}, nil},
92: 	}
93: 	for _, s := range specs {
94: 		if _, err := s.c.Indexes().CreateOne(ctx, mongo.IndexModel{Keys: s.keys, Options: s.opts}); err != nil {
95: 			return fmt.Errorf("consumer index (%v): %w", s.keys, err)
96: 		}
97: 	}
98: 	if err := r.ensureOrderIndexes(ctx); err != nil {
99: 		return fmt.Errorf("consumer order indexes: %w", err)
100: 	}
```

```text
38	// ── Baseline (mirrors the ~8 core milk SKUs from the consumer app's
39	// constants/products.ts) so the store console can render the products it may
40	// override without shipping the whole app catalog to the backend. Kept
41	// deliberately small: id / name / category / variant / price only. ─────────────
42	type baselineSku struct {
43		ID       string  `json:"id"`
44		Name     string  `json:"name"`
45		Category string  `json:"category"`
46		Variant  string  `json:"variant"`

52	}

65	// effectiveInStock is a SKU's stock as this store actually sees it: a per-store
66	// override (ov) wins over the seeded default; a nil seeded flag means in stock.
67	func effectiveInStock(id string, seeded *bool, ov map[string]bool) bool {
68		if v, ok := ov[id]; ok {
69			return v
70		}
71		return seeded == nil || *seeded
72	}
73	
74	// baselineIDs is the set of baseline sku ids — an ADD must not shadow one (that
75	// would be an override, not a new SKU).
76	var baselineIDs = func() map[string]struct{} {
77		m := make(map[string]struct{}, len(consumerBaseline))
78		for _, b := range consumerBaseline {
79			m[b.ID] = struct{}{}
80		}
81		return m
82	}()

96		// but only when CONSUMER_CATALOG_SEED_SERVE is on (see catalogView).

103	// variantDoc is one purchasable variant hanging off an addition (base) product:
104	// a size/pack of the same product (e.g. "500ml Pouch" vs "1L Pouch") carrying
105	// its own price, photo, stock flag and physical descriptors. The bson keys are
106	// snake_case (storage); the json keys are the camelCase the contract canonicalises
107	// on — so a variantDoc doubles as its own read-view (no separate projection type).
108	type variantDoc struct {
109		VariantID  string            `bson:"variant_id"             json:"variantId"`
110		Label      string            `bson:"label"                  json:"label"`
111		Price      float64           `bson:"price"                  json:"price"`
112		ImageURL   string            `bson:"image_url,omitempty"    json:"imageUrl,omitempty"`
113		OutOfStock bool              `bson:"out_of_stock,omitempty" json:"outOfStock"`
114		VolumeMl   float64           `bson:"volume_ml,omitempty"    json:"volumeMl,omitempty"`
115		Unit       string            `bson:"unit,omitempty"         json:"unit,omitempty"`
116		Attributes map[string]string `bson:"attributes,omitempty"   json:"attributes,omitempty"`
117	}

119	// physicalDoc is the base product's physical envelope (used by delivery/packing
120	// and, later, by the Dolibarr product sync). Same bson=storage / json=contract
121	// camelCase split as variantDoc, so it is its own read-view too.
122	type physicalDoc struct {
123		VolumeMl   float64 `bson:"volume_ml,omitempty" json:"volumeMl,omitempty"`
124		WeightG    float64 `bson:"weight_g,omitempty"  json:"weightG,omitempty"`
125		Dimensions string  `bson:"dimensions,omitempty" json:"dimensions,omitempty"`
126	}

128	// catalogDoc is one overlay row: a per-store override on a baseline SKU, or a
129	// store-added SKU. Unified fields (price / in_stock / hidden) apply to both;
130	// the name/category/variant/photo_url fields carry an addition's identity. kind
131	// distinguishes the two so a baseline override never masquerades as a product.
132	//
133	// An addition is a BASE product that may carry many variants[] (sizes/packs) and
134	// a physical{} envelope. base_id is an optional external/base handle (empty for a
135	// natively-added product) that a future DOLIBARR-SYNC adapter can key on — see
136	// the DOLIBARR-SYNC seam note below.
137	type catalogDoc struct {
138		ID           primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"`
139		StoreID      string             `bson:"store_id"`
140		SkuID        string             `bson:"sku_id"`
141		Kind         string             `bson:"kind"`
142		Price        *float64           `bson:"price,omitempty"`
143		InStock      *bool              `bson:"in_stock,omitempty"`
144		Hidden       *bool              `bson:"hidden,omitempty"`
145		Name         string             `bson:"name,omitempty"`
146		Category     string             `bson:"category,omitempty"`
147		Variant      string             `bson:"variant,omitempty"`
148		Description  string             `bson:"description,omitempty"`
149		Subscribable *bool              `bson:"subscribable,omitempty"`
150		PhotoURL     string             `bson:"photo_url,omitempty"`
151		BaseID       string             `bson:"base_id,omitempty"`
152		Variants     []variantDoc       `bson:"variants,omitempty"`
153		Physical     *physicalDoc       `bson:"physical,omitempty"`
154		// Extended product fields — carried by seeded baseline products (kind=product)
155		// and available to additions. All optional; the consumer view emits them when
156		// present, and the app falls back to its own defaults when absent.
157		MRP            *float64       `bson:"mrp,omitempty"`
158		Unit           string         `bson:"unit,omitempty"`
159		Tag            string         `bson:"tag,omitempty"`
160		Rating         *float64       `bson:"rating,omitempty"`
161		RatingCount    *int           `bson:"rating_count,omitempty"`
162		MostOrdered    *bool          `bson:"most_ordered,omitempty"`
163		PackCount      *int           `bson:"pack_count,omitempty"`
164		BackPhotoURL   string         `bson:"back_photo_url,omitempty"`
165		ImageAsset     string         `bson:"image_asset,omitempty"`
166		BackImageAsset string         `bson:"back_image_asset,omitempty"`
167		Compliance     *complianceDoc `bson:"compliance,omitempty"`
168		// StockCount is the store console's on-hand number. NEVER projected to the
169		// consumer (see additionViewFromDoc / catalogView).
170		StockCount  *int      `bson:"stock_count,omitempty"`
171		SeedVersion int       `bson:"seed_version,omitempty"`
172		UpdatedBy   string    `bson:"updated_by"`
173		UpdatedAt   time.Time `bson:"updated_at"`
174		CreatedAt   time.Time `bson:"created_at"`
175	}
176	
177	// DOLIBARR-SYNC seam (NOT integrated). Additions above are the exact shape a
178	// future Dolibarr → Saathi product adapter would feed: Dolibarr's product +
179	// variant (product_attribute) + weight/volume/dimension fields map 1:1 onto a
180	// catalogDoc addition (base_id ← Dolibarr product ref, variants[] ← its
181	// combinations, physical{} ← its weight/volume/length·width·height). When that
182	// adapter lands it will UPSERT additions through the same repo methods the store
183	// console uses (insertAddition / pushVariants / patchExisting), keyed by base_id,
184	// so Dolibarr-sourced and hand-added products coexist in one overlay. Nothing
185	// here calls Dolibarr today — this is a documented seam only.
186	
187	// ── Consumer-facing view (GET /consumer/catalog) ────────────────────────────
188	
189	// overrideView is the per-SKU overlay the consumer app merges onto its baseline
190	// product. Pointer fields so an unset override key is simply absent (the app
191	// keeps the baseline value).
192	type overrideView struct {
193		Price   *float64 `json:"price,omitempty"`
194		InStock *bool    `json:"in_stock,omitempty"`
195		Hidden  *bool    `json:"hidden,omitempty"`
196		// MRP mirrored from the ERP (price_min) for Dolibarr-mapped baselines — an
197		// explicit 0 CLEARS a stale bundled strikethrough (the app adopts mrp>=0
198		// and hides the strike when it is 0), so an ERP price edit can never render
199		// under an out-of-date bundled MRP.
200		MRP *float64 `json:"mrp,omitempty"`
201	}
202	
203	// additionView is a store-added SKU as the consumer app consumes it. A base
204	// product carries its variants[] and physical{} envelope (both omitted when
205	// empty, so a plain single-SKU addition still reads exactly as before).
206	type additionView struct {
207		ID           string       `json:"id"`
208		BaseID       string       `json:"baseId,omitempty"`
209		Name         string       `json:"name"`
210		Category     string       `json:"category"`
211		Variant      string       `json:"variant,omitempty"`
212		Description  string       `json:"description,omitempty"`
213		Subscribable bool         `json:"subscribable"`
214		Price        float64      `json:"price"`
215		PhotoURL     string       `json:"photo_url,omitempty"`
216		InStock      bool         `json:"in_stock"`
217		Variants     []variantDoc `json:"variants,omitempty"`
218		Physical     *physicalDoc `json:"physical,omitempty"`
219		// Extended fields (present for seeded baseline products). Note: stock_count is
220		// intentionally NOT here — on-hand stock is store-console-only, never shown to
221		// shoppers.
222		MRP          *float64       `json:"mrp,omitempty"`
223		Unit         string         `json:"unit,omitempty"`
224		Tag          string         `json:"tag,omitempty"`
225		Rating       *float64       `json:"rating,omitempty"`
226		RatingCount  *int           `json:"ratingCount,omitempty"`
227		MostOrdered  bool           `json:"mostOrdered,omitempty"`
228		PackCount    *int           `json:"packCount,omitempty"`
229		BackPhotoURL string         `json:"back_photo_url,omitempty"`
230		Compliance   *complianceDoc `json:"compliance,omitempty"`
231	}
232	
233	// catalogResponse is the whole overlay: a map of baseline-SKU overrides keyed by
234	// sku id, the list of store additions, and a version (ms) the app can cache on.
235	type catalogResponse struct {
236		Overrides map[string]overrideView `json:"overrides"`
237		Additions []additionView          `json:"additions"`
238		Version   int64                   `json:"version"`
239	}
240	
241	// ── Store-console view (GET /consumer/stores/{storeId}/skus) ────────────────
242	
243	type storeOverrideView struct {
244		SkuID     string    `json:"sku_id"`
245		Price     *float64  `json:"price,omitempty"`
246		InStock   *bool     `json:"in_stock,omitempty"`

277		if d.Subscribable != nil {
```

```text
1	// Server-side price authority — closes the client-priced-order hole ("₹0 milk").
2	//
3	// Until now orders and subscriptions billed the unit price THE CLIENT SENT
4	// (validated only against < 0), which let a tampered client buy at ₹0-or-any
5	// price. Money amounts must come from the server's own catalog: the same rows
6	// the consumer catalog serves (seeded baseline + store overrides + additions,
7	// later-write-wins across stores — identical semantics to catalogView), which
8	// is also where the Dolibarr ERP sync lands its authoritative prices.
9	//
10	// The index resolves (product_id, variant) → the price the SERVER will charge:
11	//   - a store override's price beats the seeded price (that is how ERP prices
12	//     reach seeded SKUs);
13	//   - an addition prices itself, and a named variant with its own price wins
14	//     over the base;
15	//   - a hidden SKU is not purchasable at all;
16	//   - an unknown product id resolves to nothing — the order is rejected, never
17	//     guessed.
18	package consumer
19	
20	import (
21		"context"
22		"strings"
23	
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	type catalogPriceIndex struct {
29		base     map[string]float64            // sku_id → effective unit price
30		names    map[string]string             // sku_id → server-side display name
31		variants map[string]map[string]float64 // sku_id → normalized variant key → price
32		hidden   map[string]bool               // sku_id → not purchasable
33	}
34	
35	// buildPriceIndex folds catalog rows (oldest→newest, so a later write wins on
36	// cross-store collisions — same rule as catalogView) into a price index. Pure:
37	// unit-tested without a database.
38	func buildPriceIndex(docs []catalogDoc) *catalogPriceIndex {
39		ix := &catalogPriceIndex{
40			base:     map[string]float64{},
41			names:    map[string]string{},
42			variants: map[string]map[string]float64{},
43			hidden:   map[string]bool{},
44		}
45		for _, d := range docs {
46			switch d.Kind {
47			case catalogKindProduct, catalogKindAddition:
48				if d.Price != nil {
49					ix.base[d.SkuID] = *d.Price
50				}
51				if d.Name != "" {
52					// EXACT catalog name, no variant concat: order-line names are the
53					// store inventory's reconciliation key (deriveStock matches rows
54					// by name); mutating them would orphan sold/held counts.
55					ix.names[d.SkuID] = d.Name
56				}
57				if d.Hidden != nil {
58					ix.hidden[d.SkuID] = *d.Hidden
59				}
60				for _, v := range d.Variants {
61					if v.Price == 0 {
62						continue
63					}
64					m := ix.variants[d.SkuID]
65					if m == nil {
66						m = map[string]float64{}
67						ix.variants[d.SkuID] = m
68					}
69					if v.VariantID != "" {
70						m[variantKey(v.VariantID)] = v.Price
71					}
72					if v.Label != "" {
73						m[variantKey(v.Label)] = v.Price
74					}
75				}
76			case catalogKindOverride:
77				if d.Price != nil {
78					ix.base[d.SkuID] = *d.Price
79				}
80				if d.Hidden != nil {
81					ix.hidden[d.SkuID] = *d.Hidden
82				}
83			}
84		}
85		return ix
86	}
87	
88	func variantKey(s string) string { return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)) }
89	
90	// priceFor resolves the authoritative unit price. ok=false → the product is
91	// unknown or hidden and must not be sold.
92	func (ix *catalogPriceIndex) priceFor(productID, variant string) (price float64, ok bool) {
93		if ix.hidden[productID] {
94			return 0, false
95		}
96		if variant != "" {
97			if m := ix.variants[productID]; m != nil {
98				if p, hit := m[variantKey(variant)]; hit {
99					return p, true
100				}
101			}
102			// a variant label with no own price falls through to the base price
103		}
104		p, hit := ix.base[productID]
105		if !hit || p <= 0 {
106			return 0, false
107		}
108		return p, true
109	}
110	
111	// nameFor returns the server-side display name ("" when unknown) so a stored
112	// order line can never carry a spoofed product name into the store console.
113	func (ix *catalogPriceIndex) nameFor(productID string) string { return ix.names[productID] }
114	
115	// loadPriceIndex reads the full catalog (109 rows today — one small query per
116	// order/subscription creation) and builds the index.
117	func (s *service) loadPriceIndex(ctx context.Context) (*catalogPriceIndex, error) {
118		cur, err := s.repo.catalog.Find(ctx, bson.D{},
119			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: 1}}))
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, errInternal("catalog price lookup failed")
122		}
123		var docs []catalogDoc
124		if err := cur.All(ctx, &docs); err != nil {
125			return nil, errInternal("catalog price decode failed")
126		}
127		return buildPriceIndex(docs), nil
128	}
```

```text
591: // upsertOverride sets (or clears) the price/in_stock/hidden overlay on a SKU for
```

```text
package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the consumer backend under /consumer (→ /api/v1/consumer).
// Everything here is ADD-ONLY and isolated from the operator side. The consumer
// app points EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL at .../api/v1/consumer so its bare paths
// (/auth/..., /users/me, /wallet, /addresses) compose onto this subtree.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "consumer"))
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(d, repo, log)
	h := &handler{svc: svc}

	// Own indexes at startup (never touches shared Saathi index setup). This is
	// FATAL on failure: the unique (consumer, ref, type) index IS the wallet's
	// exactly-once money gate — booting without it would let a duplicate webhook
	// double-credit. Fail fast rather than serve money endpoints unguarded.
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := repo.ensureIndexes(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Error("consumer index setup failed — refusing to boot", slog.Any("err", err))
		panic("consumer: index setup failed: " + err.Error())
	}

	// Seed the baseline catalog products (idempotent, single BulkWrite). Runs
	// AFTER the money-gate indexes and is deliberately NON-FATAL: unlike the
	// wallet index above, a transient DB blip while loading catalog DATA must not
	// take the whole backend down — the catalog just serves the store overlay
	// until the next boot re-seeds. Its own timeout, not the index budget.
	seedCtx, seedCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	if err := repo.seedConsumerProducts(seedCtx); err != nil {
		log.Error("consumer product seed failed — serving without the baseline this boot", slog.Any("err", err))
	}
	seedCancel()

	// Repair QR integrity tokens signed under an older QR_SIGNING_SECRET so
	// already-printed QRs keep resolving after a secret rotation (qrresign.go).
	// Best-effort: runs in the background, never blocks or fails boot.
	go resignQRTokens(d, log)

	// Server-owned subscription scheduler (subscriptions.go): every 15 min,
	// turn today's DUE subscriptions (daily/alternate/weekly, minus vacations)
	// into morning-lane orders + store delivery tasks — so the store manager's
	// queue fills even when no consumer opens the app. Exactly-once per
	// (subscription, IST day); money still settles on delivery.
	go svc.subscriptionOrderWorker(context.Background())

	// Dolibarr ERP integration (dolibarr_sync.go): inbound catalog mirror +
		cr.Get("/catalog", h.getCatalog)

		// Catalog product images — PUBLIC, read-only proxy over the PRIVATE B2
		// media bucket, hard-scoped to the catalog/ prefix (catalog_images.go).
		// Unauthenticated by necessity (<Image uri> sends no headers); 302s to a
		// fresh short-lived, prefix-scoped B2 download URL so it can serve product
		// art and never KYC/profile files. The seed stores stable paths that
		// resolve here (photo_url = "catalog/img/<file>").
		cr.Get("/catalog/img/*", h.catalogImage)

		// Dolibarr product photos — PUBLIC read-only proxy over the ERP's
		// document store, scoped to product images (dolibarr_sync.go). Serves
		// 404 when the integration is off; photo_url values of ERP-synced
		// additions resolve here ("catalog/dolimg/<ref>/<file>").
		cr.Get("/catalog/dolimg/*", h.dolibarrImage)

		// Geofence serviceability — consumer-app-gated (same X-Parag-App-Key).
		// The app asks "can we deliver here, how fast?" before checkout, and lets
		// an out-of-area shopper join the waitlist (upsert by phone). (geofence.go)
		cr.Get("/serviceability", h.serviceability)
		cr.Post("/waitlist", h.joinWaitlist)

		// Lead capture (leads.go) — both app-key-gated; the partner form is
		// reachable signed-out, the wishlist tap sends the server-known uid.
		cr.Post("/partner-leads", h.createPartnerLead)
		cr.Post("/wishlist/leads", h.createWishlistLead)

		// Instant ERP→catalog sync kick — target URL for the DoliCloud Webhook
		// module (token-gated; see dolibarrWebhook). GET supported too so the
		// COO can trigger a manual refresh from a browser bookmark.
		cr.Post("/dolibarr/webhook", h.dolibarrWebhook)
		cr.Get("/dolibarr/webhook", h.dolibarrWebhook)

		// ── Authenticated (consumer JWT) ──
		cr.Group(func(pr chi.Router) {
			pr.Use(svc.authenticate)

			// Profile — support the FE's /users/me and the note's /me alias.
			for _, base := range []string{"/users/me", "/me"} {
				pr.Get(base, h.me)
				pr.Patch(base, h.patchMe)
				pr.Put(base, h.patchMe)
				pr.Delete(base, h.erase)
			}
			pr.Post("/me/erasure", h.erase)

			// Wallet — canonical + FE-alias paths.
			pr.Get("/wallet", h.getWallet)
			pr.Get("/wallet/txns", h.walletTxns)
			pr.Get("/wallet/transactions", h.walletTxns)
			pr.Post("/wallet/topup", h.topup)
			pr.Post("/wallet/recharge", h.topup)
			// Marketing grant seam (free-pack funnel): REWARDS-only credit,
			// idempotent by ref, dev-gated like /wallet/topup.
			pr.Post("/wallet/promo", h.promo)
			// Real money-in path (Razorpay): create amount-bound order → verify
			// signature server-side → credit exactly once.
			pr.Post("/wallet/order", h.walletOrder)
			pr.Post("/wallet/verify", h.walletVerify)
			// Server-authoritative spend/refund (promo-first, idempotent by ref).
			pr.Post("/wallet/debit", h.walletDebit)
			pr.Post("/wallet/refund", h.walletRefund)

			// UPI-AutoPay / e-mandate — subscription auto-renewal (mandate.go).
			// Create a recurring authorization (mock token in the dev seam), verify
			// its registration payment, and drive the pause/resume/cancel state
			// machine. Daily EXECUTIONS charge via the SAME exactly-once wallet
			// settle path, idempotent by (mandateId, day). GET /me lists the
			// caller's mandates.
			pr.Post("/mandate/create", h.createMandate)
			pr.Post("/mandate/verify", h.verifyMandate)
			pr.Get("/mandate/me", h.listMandates)
			pr.Post("/mandate/{id}/pause", h.mandateAction("pause"))
			pr.Post("/mandate/{id}/resume", h.mandateAction("resume"))
			pr.Post("/mandate/{id}/cancel", h.mandateAction("cancel"))
			pr.Post("/mandate/{id}/execute", h.executeMandate) // dev-only manual tick

			// Server-owned subscriptions (subscriptions.go) — the backend twin of
			// the app's local subscription rows. The worker turns these into the
			// daily/alternate/weekly MORNING orders (store-routed via the default
			// saved address), so delivery no longer depends on the app being open.
			pr.Post("/subscriptions", h.createSubscription)
			pr.Get("/subscriptions", h.listSubscriptions)
			pr.Get("/subscriptions/me", h.listSubscriptions)
			pr.Patch("/subscriptions/{id}", h.patchSubscription)
			pr.Post("/subscriptions/{id}/pause", h.subscriptionAction("pause"))
			pr.Post("/subscriptions/{id}/resume", h.subscriptionAction("resume"))
			pr.Post("/subscriptions/{id}/cancel", h.subscriptionAction("cancel"))
			pr.Post("/subscriptions/sweep", h.sweepSubscriptions) // dev-only manual tick

			// Subscription welcome trial ("3 PAID then 3 FREE"): the caller's trial
			// standing (phase + paid/free days remaining). The window is spent on
			// DELIVERED days by the delivery settle path (trial.go), never here.
			pr.Get("/trial/me", h.trialMe)

			// Addresses.
			pr.Get("/addresses", h.listAddresses)
			pr.Post("/addresses", h.createAddress)
			pr.Patch("/addresses/{id}", h.patchAddress)
			pr.Post("/addresses/{id}/default", h.defaultAddress)
			pr.Delete("/addresses/{id}", h.deleteAddress)

			// Orders — the backend owns the order; money is debited on delivery
			// via the server wallet. Scoped to the authenticated shopper.
			pr.Get("/orders", h.listOrders)
			pr.Post("/orders", h.createOrder)
			pr.Get("/orders/{id}", h.getOrder)
			pr.Post("/orders/{id}/cancel", h.cancelOrder)
			pr.Post("/orders/{id}/review", h.reviewOrder)
			pr.Post("/orders/{id}/advance", h.advanceOrder) // dev-only status transition
			// Pay an order directly via the gateway (seam): create an amount-bound
			// Razorpay order for the order total. Default payment mode is 'wallet'
			// (settled on delivery); this lets the FE offer a direct-pay path later.
			// Dev-gated until the order-pay verify/capture flow lands.
			pr.Post("/orders/{id}/pay", h.payOrder)
		})

		// ── Operator surfaces (SAATHI operator token + role) ──
		// The store manager and delivery rider are Saathi operators; these routes
		// reuse Saathi's auth + wire format ({data} envelope), consumed by the
		// Saathi FE (store.ts / delivery.ts, service:'consumer').
		cr.Group(func(op chi.Router) {
			op.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

			// Store manager (STORE_MANAGER): orders in the store's vicinity, its
			// rider roster (with distance tiers), and rider assignment.
			op.Group(func(sm chi.Router) {
				sm.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStoreManager))
				sm.Get("/stores/{storeId}/orders", h.storeOrders)
				sm.Get("/stores/{storeId}/riders", h.storeRiders)
				sm.Post("/stores/{storeId}/orders/{deliveryId}/assign", h.assignRider)
```

```text
    fix(subscriptions): waive the ₹15 delivery fee on subscription deliveries
    
    The consumer app quotes AND charges the bare subtotal on the Subscribe button
    (lib/api.ts), but the backend subscription worker still appended deliveryFeeFor()

    order paths (create, reconcile-update, same-day preview affordability) now use
    subscriptionDeliveryFee=0. One-time cart orders are unaffected. Handoff-requested.
```

```text
// SUBSCRIPTION TRIAL ENGINE — the "2+2" welcome trial (2 FREE then 2 PAID).
//
// POLARITY IS LOAD-BEARING. The home banners promise "Your first 2 days are
// completely free" and the consumer app implements free-first. This engine
// originally charged the first two delivered days and freed days 3-4 — the
// exact inverse of the marketing, so every trial member was billed for the
// days the first screen of the app gave away. If you ever change the order
// here, change the app (lib/trial.ts) and the banner art in the same breath.
//
// The free-pack funnel: a new shopper's gold-500ml (Gold full-cream) daily
// subscription pays for its FIRST 2 delivered days at full price, then the NEXT
// 2 delivered days are on us (charged 0), and from the 5th delivered day onward
// it charges normally.
//
// The window is measured in DELIVERED DAYS, never calendar days. A pause, a
// skipped day, or an out-of-stock morning does NOT burn a free day — the free
// window only opens after 2 REAL paid deliveries land, and only advances when a
// delivery actually completes. This is what makes the promise honest: the shopper
// always gets 2 paid + 2 free real deliveries regardless of how the calendar falls.
//
// Money is still gated by the wallet's exactly-once ref (delivery:<orderId>); the
// trial ledger is a SEPARATE per-shopper counter, independently idempotent by the
// delivery key so a retried/duplicated settle can never double-advance the window.

const collConsumerTrials = "consumer_trials"

const (
	trialPaidDays = 2 // full-price delivered days that OPEN the trial (gold-500ml)
	trialFreeDays = 2 // free (charged 0) delivered days AFTER the paid window

	trialPhasePaid = "paid" // inside the FIRST 2 full-price days
	trialPhaseFree = "free" // inside the 2 free days after the paid window (charge 0)
	trialPhaseDone = "done" // trial exhausted — charge normally
)

// trialDeliveryKey is the per-shopper, per-DELIVERED-DAY idempotency key. Stable
// for a given (consumer, UTC day), so a re-run of the same day's settle reuses the
// same ledger entry and never double-counts: "sub:<consumerId>:<YYYY-MM-DD>".
func trialDeliveryKey(consumerID primitive.ObjectID, day string) string {
	return "sub:" + consumerID.Hex() + ":" + day
}

// istZone is India Standard Time (UTC+5:30) as a fixed offset (no tzdata needed).
var istZone = time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)

// trialDay is the IST calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD) a delivery counts toward. The
// morning run is an IST-morning event, so dating in IST (not UTC) keeps one IST
// morning = exactly one trial day, regardless of the 05:30-IST UTC-midnight seam.
func trialDay(t time.Time) string { return t.In(istZone).Format("2006-01-02") }

// isTrialProduct reports whether a product id is covered by the 2-paid/2-free
// welcome trial. THE OFFER APPLIES ONLY TO THE FULL-CREAM SKU the funnel
// subscribes (PYAAS Gold, gold-*): a Taaza/Shakti/Chai subscription neither
// consumes trial days nor earns the free ones — the member stays a 2+2
// candidate until they complete the paid days on the full cream itself.
func isTrialProduct(productID string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(productID, "gold-")
}

// store poll can call it freely without spamming the inbox.
func (h *handler) lowStock(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
```
